sanskrit: jayatyavirato vyāptaviśvaḥ kālo vināyakaḥ prabandhavākyārthatvenātra sūcitamityupadiśanti pūjyapādāḥ nityānāṃ ṣoḍaśānāṃ ca navatantrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ tasmāttu nirapekṣaṃ me tantraṃ tāsāṃ vada prabho gopyaṃ sarvaprayatnena gopanaṃ tantracoditam kādikālītiśaktī staḥ purā tattanmate mayā śṛṇu tatsarvatantrāṇāṃ rājānaṃ sarvasiddhidam tantraṃ maduktaṃ bhuvane navanāthairakalpayat avasāneṣu kalpānāṃ sā taiḥ sārddhaṃ vrajecca mām nityoddhārastṛtīye syāt lalitārcā tayordvayoḥ kāmeśvarī saptamake parato bhagamālinī ekādaśe vahnivāsinyatha vajreśvarī matā kulasundaryyato'nyasmin nityānityā tu ṣoḍaśe sarvamaṅgalanityā'to jvālāmālinisaṃjñikā trayoviṃśe tu vārāhīdhyānāni tadanantare saptaviṃśe śvāsarūpā aṣṭāviṃśe tu lokatā p. 4) ekatriṃśe tadūrddhaṃ ca homāḥ kāmyā mahodayāḥ catustriṃśe tu nāmāni pañcatriṃśe'sya vāsanā pratyadhyāyaṃ śataślokāḥ syādevaṃ tantrasaṃgrahaḥ asaṃśayaḥ saṃśayacchinnirapekṣo gururmataḥ smerapūrvābhibhāṣitvaṃ svacchatā'jihmavṛttitā asaṃśayastatvabodhe tacchaktipratipādanāt evaṃvidho gururjñeyastvitaraḥ śiṣyaduḥkhadaḥ tatvavigrahāḥ ṣaṭ triṃśatsaṅkhyāviśiṣṭatvāt || 9 || 10 || 11 || 12 || 13 vittāpahāraśarīrakleśabuddhivyāmohādibhirityarthaḥ || 19 || 20 || 21

p. 5) alubdhaḥ sthiragātraśca prekṣākārī jitendriyaḥ evaṃvidho bhavecchiṣyastvitaro duḥkhakṛdguroḥ prasīda nātha ! deveti tatheti ca kṛtādaram mukhāvalokī seveta kuryyādādiṣṭamādarāt kāmaṃ krodhaṃ tathā lobhaṃ mānaṃ prahasanaṃ stutim ṛṇadānaṃ tathā'dānaṃ vastūnāṃ krayavikrayam yato guruḥ śivaḥ sākṣāttaṃ stuvan praṇaman bhajet duḥkhakṛt guroḥ akīrtyanarthacittadehakleśādyaiḥ || 22 || 23 kuṭilāni paridevanaṃ pralāpaḥ | bhūṣṇuḥ jijīviṣuḥ | bhajet seveta || 25 p. 6) yathā gurau tathā svātmanyevaṃ bhaktikramaḥ priye ! viśeṣapūjāṃ yogibhyo bhojanaṃ tatpadārcanam ekadeśe nityasevā dūrasthe yojanakramāt tato'dūragate sevā tadājñāparipālanam chāyāṃ kalatramanyacca yattasyeṣṭaṃ tu pūjayet pūjāmadhye samāyāte pūjye natvā sthitiṃ vadet varteta so'pi taccheṣaṃ kuryānniścalamānasaḥ kṛtyamevaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ maunaṃ tairna samācaret p. 7) na kadāpi bhavetsiddhirmantrairvā devapūjanaiḥ tāṃ ca tatpaṭale samyak jñātvā bhaktisamanvitaḥ tathāpyatrocyate kiñcidabhicārādisiddhaye caturo yojayedādyān bindusargau tu sarvagau gaṇayedyatra ṣaṣṭhaṃ vā'pyaṣṭamaṃ dvādaśaṃ tu vā rāśiṣvanyatra ṛkṣeṣu saptapañcatṛtīyagaiḥ p. 8) yataste tattvavijñānarahitāstena coditam koṣṭhāni ṣoḍaśā'tra syusteṣu varṇān kramāllikhet

prathamaprathame tvādyaṃ dvitīyaprathame tathā tattakoṣṭheṣu vilikhet tattatpañcamamakṣaram prāguktāṃśakādyamanugraheṣvavekṣaṇīyamityarthaḥ || 40 || 41 || 42 p. 9) svanāmādyakṣaraṃ yatra koṣṭhe sandṛśyate tataḥ siddhasiddho japātsiddhyet dviguṇātsiddhasādhyakaḥ vyākulakramāṇi dṛśyanta iti prathamaproktakramaśabdasyārthaḥ || 46 sādhyasiddhe'tisaṃkleśāt sādhyasādhyo'tiduḥkhakṛt susiddhasiddho'dhyayanāt phalaṃ dadyādyathepsitam susiddhe tu prasiddhastu pūrvajanmakṛtaśramaḥ abhicāre riporevaṃ yadi svātmavipattaye arisiddhaḥ sutaṃ hanyādarisādhyaḥ svayoṣitam aryariḥ svātmahā mantraḥ samprāptyaiva suniścitam tridhā kṛtvā svarairbhindyāt tadanyadviparītakam svayaṃ ṛṇī cettanmantraṃ tyajet pūrva ṛṇī yataḥ pūrvajanmakṛtābhyāse pāpādasyāphalāptikṛt mantraḥ samprāptimātreṇa prāktanaḥ siddhaye bhavet lakṣmīmadādanādṛtya mantre bhogamavāptavān tasmādṛṇaviśuddhistu kāryā sarvaistu sarvataḥ sphāṭikaiśca pravālaiśca mauktikairhemanirmitaiḥ sarvataḥ mantreṣu vidyāsu cetyarthaḥ || 56 || 57 || 58 || 59 || 60 || 61 ślokairakṣamālādikamupadiśati | tatra kucandanaiḥ raktacandanaiḥ || 63 ādikṣāntairakṣaraiḥ syādakṣamālā yathārthataḥ evaṃ sarvaguṇopeto jāyate sarvasiddhimān aṅgulīparvasaṃsparśādapi vā gaṇayejjapam vidyāṃ japecchataṃ tena tatpāpānmucyate dhruvam

naimittikātikramaṇe sahasraṃ prajapettadā vimukhaḥ paranindāsu devatādarśaneṣu ca dayānvitaḥ sarvajane prekṣākārī gataspṛhaḥ yaḥ sa sarvaguṇopeto vidyāsiddhimavāpnuyāt na tasya sidabhiḥ kutrāpi kadācicca kathañcana nindāsu vimukhaḥ | darśaneṣu vaidikavaiṣṇavaśaivādiṣu || 69 || 70 || 71 ekāntaraṃ tu grathanaṃ vidarbhodvyantarīkṛtaḥ anyathā sa guruḥ śiṣyaṃ nihantyevācirāt dhruvam dvayaṃ yojayedeṣo'nyaḥ | evaṃ traividhyamiti parihāraprakārantu vakṣye yogeṣu tattvataḥ garvitastvavidhiprāptaḥ śatravo vairikoṣṭhagāḥ nirjitā karmabāhulyādahasāḥ satvavarjitāḥ akālaviniyogena prabodhaḥ svāpagā japāt ruddhā visandhikāḥ prāptaduḥkhā vairisamanvitāḥ apūrṇenopadiṣṭā ye hīnavīryāstu te matāḥ rugṇā pralapanairjāpādanyamantraiḥ sahāvilāḥ pañcaviṃśatiruddiṣṭā doṣāṃstān śamayedguruḥ ubhayaṃ bodhayan śiṣyaṃ saṃrakṣedgururātmavān ādimāntyavihīnāstu varṇāḥ syuḥ śaradabhnavat yadahaṅkāravijñānānmatsamojāyate naraḥ tādātmyasiddhiṃ tāṃ viddhi sarvamantrārthavigrahām teṣāṃ ca tatra tatrāpi vidyayā vidhimācaret tena tanmayatāsiddhiḥ sarvatra bhavati dhruvam ādyantākṣaraddvayātmikām || 83 || 84 || 85 vā'cyarūpaṃ sarvadevatātmatāṃ ceti

nidhane vidyayā dāho vidyayā'nyat samācaret yoginaṃ vidyayā siddhaṃ pūrvataśca nimantritam vidyayā visṛjenmantrī svavidyāsiddhaye śive ! svajanmadivasaṃ nāthavyāptivāsarameva ca ṣaṭparvāṇi viśiṣṭāni sadarśaṃ saptaparvakam gurostu jīvite nityavyāpte tatputrakādikam tadabhāve tatkulīnaṃ tadbhaktaṃ vā samarcayet tatprakārasya tatraiva sphuṭataraṃ vakṣyamāṇatvādiha na prapañcitam prātaḥ prabodhasamaye japātsudivasaṃ bhavet vidyāvatārasaṃsidhyai svīkṛtānekavigraha ! sarvājñānatamobhedabhānave cidghanāya te paratantrāya bhaktānāṃ bhavyānāṃ bhavyarūpiṇe prakāśānāṃ prakāśāya jñānināṃ jñānarūpiṇe sadā me cittarūpeṇa vidhehi bhavadāsanam satyarūpāṇām || 96 || 97 || 98 || 99 deśakālākāraistvanmayatāṃ me vidhe hīti śivam p. 19) asyā niḥphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam iti ṣoḍaśanityātantre śrīkādimate prathamaṃ paṭalam vidyāvatārasopānabhūtāṃstatpūjanaṃ tathā nāmabhedādahaṃ loke kalpayan divyarūpataḥ jñānaḥ satyaḥ pūrṇa iti śrīmukhāste samīritāḥ nivasanti tatastebhyaḥ samutpannāstrayastathā te bhūmāveva satataṃ nivasanti madātmakāḥ akalpayat kādiśaktistvadananyā kṛte yuge prasannavadanāḥ smerā varābhayakarānvitāḥ

devī śrīcakrasaṃsthāstu devyākārāstadājñayā svamaṇḍaleṣu nāthāntāḥ śaktyantā devi ! maṇḍale navānāṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ devatānāṃ ca pūjane saptākṣaryā tayā devi ! pūjayennāmapūrvakam śṛṇu devi ! mahāsiddhikarī sarvapriyaṃkarī prāṇo'pi marutā yuktaḥ sa nabhaḥ syāt tṛtīyakam vyāptaṃ marutsakhaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ nabho'gniḥ saptamākṣaram sarvāsāmapi śaktīnāṃ devatānāṃ ca nāmabhiḥ śaktitantrādbahirbhūtatantreṣu namasā sthitiḥ tāni saptākṣarīyogātpratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaram teṣāṃ navānāṃ nāmāni maṇḍalīkaraṇaṃ priye ! tena śuddhena śuddhiḥ syādvidyāyāmanyathā'nyathā devatānāmityuktiḥ puṃviṣayā || 12 || 13 || 14 || 15 nāmānyupadiśati | tatra | ṣoḍaśākṣaram nāmeti śeṣaḥ || 17 saṃbandhataḥ | āptiḥ prāmāṇyam | anvayaḥ santatiḥ dinākṣarāṇyapi tathā amāyo'nantyameva ca prasiddhaṃ bāhyato yacca trīṇi nāmāni sādhake ! pūjāślokastutīḥ kuryāt pāramparyaprasiddhaye pūrṇāyāṃ ṣoḍaśārṇāni nāmānyālikhya pūjayet pūjayettatra tatrāpi vadan saptākṣarīṃ śive ! upacārāstatastāṃstaiḥ pūjayet śṛṇu tānyapi kuryāt || 20 || 21 tāmbūlaṃ namanaṃ stotraṃ svātmaneti samīritāḥ phalakāyāṃ sthale vāpi suśuddhe susame sthire pañcāṅgulāntarālāni tato deveśi ! jāyate

tatsarvamadhye prathamaṃ dvitīyantu purogate evaṃ navanavopetaṃ maṇḍalaṃ saptaparvasu teṣu nāmārṇanavakamālikhyābhyarcayet kramāt svātmanā svātmasamarpaṇāt || 23 || 24 || 25 likhedityarthaḥ || 27 || 28 || 29 || 30 p. 25) ṣoḍaśīkṛtya teṣvevaṃ likhennāmāni tāni vai sthānāni maṇḍalīkṛtya tatra cā'lekhane mate sa deśikavaraḥ siddhaḥ tasmādvidyāptiruttamā vyādhiśastrādipīḍā vā cittabhrāntirjale mṛtiḥ tasmāduktakrameṇaiva kuryāt sarvārthasiddhaye bhaktiyuktān guṇāṃścāpi kramādvarṇeṣu saṅkare anyathā cedvadennāśaṃ saśiṣyo gururāpnuyāt sarvānarthanivāraṇādīnāmupalakṣaṇam || 31 || 32 || 33 || 34 || 35 proktasamācāraśuddhavatvādi || 37 sā tu tattvavidā kāryā sampradāyānurodhinā muhūrte kārayed vidvān pūrṇāyāṃ vā śubhodaye prokteṣu pañcasvanyeṣu sarvadā vā śubhodaye gurvanujñāmṛte mohāllobhād vā kurute yadi tasmāt pūrṇābhiṣekeṇa prāptānujñaḥ samācaret | lobhaḥ vittecchā | nirayaṃ kleśasthānam || 39 || 40 || 41 || 42 p. 27) abhiṣicyātha toyena kvathitenākṣarauṣadhaiḥ nityātattvāptikālotthavidyayā'bhyarcya tāḥ kramāt evaṃ dinatrayaṃ kṛtvā tato nityakramaṃ bhajet trirātraṃ pūjayeddevīṃ yoginīyogibhiḥ samam gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pratyakṣāya śivātmane

na cettacchaktisaṅkrāntiḥ kathamasya bhaviṣyati suvarṇaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ vāso bhavanaṃ vā'nyadīpsitam svavyāpārantadanumatameva kuryādityarthaḥ || 44 || 45 || 46 || 47 || 48 || 49 sarvadāsau tadā'yattastena siddhirbhaviṣyati pañcaṣaṭkūṭavidyābhyāṃ śodhitaṃ bahuvāsaraiḥ ādhāre hṛdaye mūrdhni cakraṃ sañcintya madhyataḥ triṃśo vidyāṃ vadet karṇe devyātmā pūrṇamānasaḥ śataṃ japettadagrastho nikaṭe tridinaṃ vaset tasmāt tadantike taqya pūjādeśādikṛdbhavet tatastadā samārabhya tadāyattodhanādibhiḥ anugrahādi kurvīta siddhaye nānyathā bhavet kvāthodakaiḥ samāpuryābhiṣicyābhirvadenmanum dvitīyamabhiṣekantu kuryāddevyātmasiddhaye trikoṇāni vidhāyātra madhye kumbhaṃ tu vinyaset dhanādibhirityatrādiśabdena gṛhakṣetrādīnyucyante || 52 || 53 || 54 || 55 pūritaṃ khāritoyena kvathitenākṣarauṣadhaiḥ hiraṇyāni satāmrāṇi vāsobhyāmabhiveṣṭayet śatakratulatābaddhaiḥ mātuluṅgaphalānvitaiḥ sārddhaṃ sahasraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśat pañcasaṃkhyāḥ kramoditāḥ kālātmanityāmantrāṃśca japitvā pūrvavāsare sahasraṃ prajapetpaścāddhomaṃ kṛtvā samantataḥ muditairyoginīvṛndairekaikaṃ devatātmabhiḥ svakramaṃ tasya kathayettadā prabhṛti so'pi tam sahasraṃ prajapedvidyāmabhiṣekasamanvitam teṣu śaktīḥ samāvāhya sampūjyaivābhiṣecayet

evaṃ naimittikaṃ nityamavicchinnaṃ samācaret ādhāre hṛdaye śīrṣe vahnau sūrye niśākare nyasecca mātṛkāsthāne tadā taddehasiddhaye kuhūprāptau ripukleśe kuryādevābhiṣecanam kṣudrāṇi krūrakarmāṇi kṛtyāśca ripukalpitāḥ śrīcakre | ekaṃ veti pakṣaḥ kāmyaviṣayaḥ || 58 || 59 || 60 || 61 || 62 || 63 śrīvidyāṃ nyasedityapyupakvaraḥ sampradāyaḥ || 73 saṃkucitatvaduḥkhārttiḥ || 75 || 76 || 77 || 78 brūhi me tadbalaṃ yena kleśā naśyantyaśeṣataḥ naśyantyaśeṣato doṣāḥ tasmātsekasamo na hi tasmādaśeṣaduḥkhārtiśāntyai syādabhiṣecanam kuryātsadakṣiṇāṃ pūjāṃ guroḥ pratyabdameva vā abhiṣiktastu vidhinā pradadyāddakṣiṇāṃ guroḥ gurorguruṃ tadguruṃ ca svāgrato labdhavidyakāt toṣayedanyathā śaktiḥ svīyā tadgāminī bhavet paṅkairvidadhyātsarvatra gurumaṇḍalakalpanam cittānuvṛttiḥ | svīyā śiṣyagatā | tadgāminī gurugāminī || 80 || 81 || 82 dhārayetsarvato lakṣmīṃ rasasyātparameśvarī proktāni tāni sarvāṇi padmāni parikalpayet devyātmatvaṃ gurorlabdhvā ślokadvādaśakaṃ japet devīṃ mantramayīṃ naumi mātṛkāṃ pīṭharūpiṇīm kālahallohalollolakalanāśamakāriṇīm paramārthaṃ budhvetyarthaḥ ravitārkṣyendukandarpaśaṅkarānalaviṣṇubhiḥ vande sarveśvarīṃ devīṃ mahāśrīsiddhamātṛkām

brahmāṇḍādikaṭāhāntaṃ tāṃ vande siddhamātṛkām brahmāṇḍādikāṭāhāntaṃ jagadadyāpi dṛśyate mātṛkāyāmekākṣare'pi saṃsiddhe tattathā siddhyatīti || 88 || 89 jagatkāraṇatvamastītyupadiśya tanmayatā svātmanaḥ siddheti śeṣaḥ jyeṣṭhāṅgabāhuhṛtpṛṣṭhakaṭipādanivāsinīm praṇamāmi mahādevīṃ paramānandarūpiṇīm keyaṃ kasmāt kvakeneti sarūpārūpabhāvanām devīṃ kulakalollolaprollasantīṃ parāṃ śivāṃ paramānandānubhava iti || 94 nodghāṭitam vande tāmaṣṭavargotthamahāsiddhyaṣṭakeśvarīṃ caturājñākośabhūtāṃ naumi śrītripurāmaham devyāstvakhaṇḍarūpāyāḥ stavanaṃ tava tadyataḥ tadavagantavyamārādhyacaraṇamukhāt | itaḥ paramasmadvyākhyā mātṛkāyāstādātmyāditi śivam asyā niḥphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam iti ṣoḍaśanityātantreṣu śrīkādimate dvitīyaṃ paṭalam paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam vārāhyā kurukullāyā ātmano'ṣṭākṣarasya ca procyate sādhusaṅketairlipīnāṃ prāgudīritaiḥ trividhā haṃsabhedena śṛṇu tāśca yathākramam pañcatriṃśatpaṭale proktaiḥ || 1 tṛtīyā prakṛtiḥ saiva turyā tairantyamāyayā iti tripurasundaryā vidyā samyak samīritā

śūnyamagniyutaṃ paścādrayo vyāptena saṃyutaḥ nabho gotrā punaścaiṣā dāhena samayojitā hṛllekhāsahitaiḥ samastākhyā turīyā vidyeti || 4 || āsu catasṛṣu vidyāsu p. 43) eṣā kāmeśvarī nityā kāmadaikā daśākṣarā dharāyuk sacarā paścāt sthirā paścādrasaḥ smṛtaḥ sthirā bhūḥsahitā gotrā sadāhognī rasaḥ sthirā evamuktaprakāreṇaikādaśākṣaretyarthaḥ p. 44) tato rasaḥ sthirā paścānmarutā saha yojitā sthirā dharānvitā haṃso vyāptena ca careṇa ca rasaḥ sthirā tataḥ sāgniḥ śūnyaṃ javiyuto marut rasaḥ sthirā'mbu ca viyat svayutaṃ prāṇa eva ca p. 45) sacaraśca javī pūrvavidyātārtīyataḥ kramāt hṛdambuyuk kṣmayā dāhaḥ sacaraḥ syājjavī ca hṛt sthirā (tu) 'pi marutā yuktā śūnyaṃ sāgni nabhaścarau dāho gotrā carayutā tathā dāhastathā rayaḥ rasaḥ sthirā tataḥ prāṇo rasāgnisahito bhavet śūnyayugmaṃ ca gotrā syāt dāhayuktāmbunā caraḥ gotrā dāhamarudyuktā tvambu vyāptamato bhavet rasaḥ sthirā'mbvagniyutaṃ vāyuyugmaṃ carānvitam grāso bhūḥsahito devi ! raso vyāptaṃ tataśca hṛt śūnyaṃ ca kevalaṃ bhadre ! rasaśca sacarā sthirā devīti sambuddhiḥ | raso bhakāraḥ | vyāptaṃ yakāraḥ | hṛt sakāraḥ bhūmī rasākṣmāsvayutā pañcaikāntaritāḥ sthitāḥ tāni kramāt jyā sacaro raso bhūśca nabhoyutā śūnyayugmaṃ carayutaṃ hṛddāho'mbu marudyutaḥ

śūnyaṃ sāgni nabhaḥ kuryāccareṇa sahitaṃ priye ! śūnyaṃ vyāptaṃ ca hṛdyuktaṃ rayadāhasvavahnibhiḥ haṃsaḥ syāddāhavahnisvairyuktamantyamudīritam kathitā parameśāni ! vanitājanamohinī kāmeśvaryāstṛtīyādivarṇānāmaṣṭakaṃ bhavet ekādaśākṣarī nityaklinnā nityā samīritā śeṣaḥ | parameśānīti devīsambuddhiḥ || 30 jāyate sādhako nityaṃ kandarpādhikasundaraḥ raso dāhena tadyuktaṃ prāṇo dāha vana sva yuk jyā ca dāhena tadyuktā nityaklinnāntato dvayam yasyāḥ smaraṇato naśyedgaralaṃ trividhaṃ kṣaṇāt vanitāḥ artha prāṇādyupakārikā vaśyā bhavanti || 32 || 33 likucarasakarpūrādi tato'mbu śūnyaṃ haṃsāgniyuktamambu marudyutam śūnyaṃ nabhaḥśaktiyutaṃ navārṇeyamudīritā yasyāḥ smaraṇato vaśyaṃ jāyate bhuvanatrayam pañcamaṃ bhagamālādyaṃ bheruṇḍāyā dvitīyakam visarjanīyasahitaṃ maḥ iti || 39 || viśvaghasmarā pralaye viśvagrāsakarī duḥkhasaṅghātatāriṇī avivekatāriṇītyarthaḥ aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ paścādetadādyamitīritam kāntārasāgarakrūraduḥkhasaṅghātatāriṇī ambu syānmarutā yuktaṃ gotrā kṣmāsaṃyutā tataḥ antyārṇau vahnivāsinyā dūtī nityā samīritā śrīkārī śivatāvāptikāriṇī sarvasiddhidā haṃso dharāsvasaṃyuktaḥ tejaścarasamanvitam

yutaṃ tyai iti | antyārṇau vahnivāsinyāḥ nama ityarthaḥ samastāpattāriṇī avivekāpannāśakarī hṛdā rayeṇa dāhena vahniḥ syādaṣṭamaṃ priye ! dyutirnādayutā nityā tvaritā dvādaśākṣarī viṣaduḥkhapraśamanī sarvābhīṣṭāptikāriṇī prāṇo dvitīyaḥ svayuto vanahṛcchaktibhiḥ paraḥ yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa sarvajñatvaṃ prajāyate repha īkāraiḥ strī ityaṣṭamaṃ bījam | priye ! iti devī sambuddhiḥ dvayornāśakarī 51 || yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa japārādhanādivaiguṇyenāpītyarthaḥ vidyayā kulasundaryā yojitaḥ sampradāyataḥ pratilomādibhī rūpairdvāsaptatibhirāhatā nigrahānugrahau cāsya jāyate svecchayā'niśam hṛcca dāhakṣmāsvayutaṃ vajreśī pañcamaṃ tataḥ dvāsaptatirbhedāḥ sambhavanti, teṣvādyā pradhānā seyamiti yogabalādityarthaḥ bhūmī rasākṣmāsvayutā vajreśī ṣaṣṭhataḥ kramāt dyutirdāhacarasvena asyā ādyamanantaram samare vijayaṃ khaḍgapādukāñjanasiddhidā nidhānavilasiddhānnasādhanī kāmadoditā aṣṭamaṃ bījam vajreśī ṣaṣṭhataḥ kramāt saptadaśamityarthaḥ svena yuktā bhavennityāvijayaikākṣarī matā vidhatte smaraṇādeva vijayā viśvavaibhavā ekākṣaryā'nayā siddho jāyate khecaraḥ kṣaṇāt

rayo'gninā yuto jyā'mbu marudyuktā rasā marut vyaktaṃ vakṣyamāṇānyatra prastauti || 59 ambumarudyuktā vakārākārayuktā jvā iti | rasāmarut lā iti p. 56) gotrā careṇa sahitā ambu pūrvākṣaraṃ tathā haṃsaśca marutā dāhaḥ prāṇaśca marutā yutaḥ careṇāmbu ca gotrā hṛtsāgni jyāmburasā svayuk dāhenānena te dviḥ syāt haṃso dāhamarutsvayuk sapta dāhāstato'syāḥ syuraṣṭamādyāstu pañca vai tvaritāntyañca bheruṇḍā aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ tathā vedhākarṣaṇasantāpavaśyāveśakarī bhavet yā siddhidhanadhānyātmanidhilābhāya kalpate ambu paścādrayaḥ sāgnirmarutā'mburayau tathā dāhaśca marutā haṃsastvagniretattrayaṃ punaḥ ityarthaḥ pañcaphalāni copadiśati ātmalābhaḥ svarūpajñānam tejo'gninā punaḥ pañca vātaḥ svena samāyutaḥ śūnyaṃ vyāptena śucinā śunyaṃ śaktyā nabhoyutam etatpūrvamadhaḥ proktacatuṣṭayamataḥ param raso'gninā punaḥ proktacatuṣkāt trayamantataḥ haṃso'gninā prāktritayaṃ hṛdayaṃ svasamāyutam paścādyuktatrayaṃ vātādharayā ca nabhaḥ priye ! vyāptametattrayaṃ paścāddhṛddāhenāmbusaṃyutam dāhena pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ ca pūrvaṃ ca marutā yutam sparśo marutsvasahito hṛddāhenāmbusaṃyutam

hṛdayena svena yutaṃ rasaśca svena saṃyutaḥ vārdāhayuktamambusyādviyadvyāptasvasaṃyutam sthirā rasā vanasvena dāvau haṃso dharāsvayuk haṃsaśca marutā vidyā daśottaraśatākṣarī vārtālī cetivikhyātā stambhanādyakhileṣṭadā vyāptaṃ marucchaktiyutaṃ bhūḥsvayuktā tatastrayam dāhena vahniśaktibhyāṃ yuto haṃsastataḥparam dāvau ṭhakāradvayaṃ ṭhaṭha iti | haṃso dharāsvayuk hu/ iti haṃsaśca marutā yukta iti śeṣaḥ hā iti vārāhītyādinā ślokena devyā nāmapañcakaṃ kathayati p. 61) ambu paścādviyadyuktaṃ marutā tu nabhaḥ priye ! asya ṣaṣṭhādipañcārṇādantyau syādādya īritaḥ tṛtīyaḥ pañcaviṃśārṇaḥ proktā mantrā iti kramāt hṛnmāyayā bhuvā hṛtsyāt svena haṃsaḥ samanvitaḥ sarvābhīṣṭārthasaṃsiddhyai sulabho'yaṃ suradrumaḥ saptapañcaviṃśārṇo mantraḥ tṛtīya ityarthaḥ samanvitaḥ haṃ iti | kuru kullāntyavarṇau ca svāhā ityarthaḥ p. 62) prāṇāgnīlā'mbuśākhābhiḥ śaktisaptākṣarīyutaiḥ yeṣāmālokato viśvaṃ vartate sacarācaram ambunāgnirvāḥ sa śūnyaṃ prāṇo jalarayānvitaḥ prabhāvādityarthaḥ | vartate adyāpi kriyate ityarthaḥ rasaḥ kṣmayā rayo yuktaścareṇa parameśvari ! pūrvāntyavarṇāvityuktaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇo balermanuḥ asyā niḥkālanāt citte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam | prāṇo jalarayānvitaḥ kakāro ṛkāratakārābhyāṃ sahitaḥ kṛt iti

ṣoḍaśanityānāṃ balimantra ukta ityarthaḥ kathayāmi krameṇaiva nityaṃ sarvārthasiddhidam yenātipāpayukto'pi siddhimeti suniścitam āvāhanamanuṃ paścāt samastārcāmanuṃ tathā dhyānaṃ saparivārāyā nityapūjāvidhikramau mantrātmayogamarcāyā upacārān japakramam hṛdvanena samāyena tṛtīyaṃ prathamā tvasau sampradāyaḥ | samastārcāmanuṃ bījadvayarūpam hṛcchiraśca śikhāvarma netramastraṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam tṛtīyā saiva śaktyādyā devyātmāsanametayā haṃsahṛdbhyāṃ pañcamī ca sarvamantrāsanaṃ tathā dvitīyayā vidyayeti śeṣaḥ tṛtīyeti parigaṇanakramaśca saukaryārthaḥ tasya śakteśca madhyasthā yā sā ṣaṣṭhī samīritā saptamyā'vāhanaṃ kuryānnamasoktatrikhaṇḍayā vakṣyamāṇatvāt sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāmupalabdhisthānamityarthaḥ madhyame dāhayogastu vyañjanānte samīritaḥ tadādikāḥ sarvaśaktīścakrasthā nāmabhirjapet prāṇorasāśaktiyutaḥ kāmeśvaryakṣaraṃ mahat vyāptaṃ rasākṣmāsvayutaṃ vimalābījamīritam pūjānāmamantraiḥ sarvāḥ śaktīḥ pūjayediti lakāra hṛllekhābhiḥ kūṭaṃ klhrī/ iti p. 68) haṃsaḥ sahṛdrasāmbuḥ syādvyāptakṣmāsvairyuto manuḥ vādeṣu vyavahāreṣu samareṣu ca niścitam sarveśvaryāḥ samākhyātaḥ sarvasiddhikaraḥ sadā

etairmanubhiraṣṭābhiḥ śaktibhirvargasaṃyutaiḥ martyopi pūjyate devaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvatra sarvadā īkārabindūnāmanyonyamuktakramayogāt jmrī/ iti ūkārabindubhiḥ lmryū/ iti nābhāvādhārake pādadvaye mūlāgrakāvadhi prāṇena dāhabhūsvenānantaraḥ saptamaḥ punaḥ aṣṭamo haṃsahṛtprāptavanasvaiḥ samudīritaḥ ete ekākṣarā mantrā mudrārūpā maheśvari ! namaḥ pade ityākṣepapūrvaṃ vidhānāt vāsanā gurumukhādevāvagantavyā vyāptaṃ dāho rasātvambu hṛnmarutsvayutaṃ pṛthak śāktāḥ śaivāśca vijñeyāḥ pañcapañca samīritāḥ sthalāḥ akṣarātmikāḥ sūkṣmāḥ vāsanātmikā parā ityuktatvāt tattraividhyaṃ pañcame paṭale vakṣyati || 26 p. 71) haṃsagairdāhavahnisvaiḥ sasvena marutā tathā sarvastambhakarasvteko mudrā ṣaṣṭho'ṅkuśastayoḥ sannidhāpanasaṃjñaṃ ca hetimudrā namaskriyā khecarī bījayonyākhyā saktyutthāpanamityapi yābhirviracitābhistu mantrāḥ siddhyanti yatnataḥ tannakhe tarjanīgraste trikhaṇḍā lalitāvahā kṣaramekamucyate | tatra mudrāṣaṣṭhaḥ krauṃkāraḥ || 28 bāṇadhanuḥpāśāṅkuśā ucyante, tena catasromudrāḥ || 30 || 31 vekṣyaṇamiti sampradāyaḥ | anyat sugamam vidadhyāt sthāpanī mudrā sarvā saṃsthāpanī matā karau susliṣṭanakharau mudraiṣā sannirodhinī

vyatyasyaupakarābhrāntyopakrame tau niveśayet mudrāñjalistu vijñeyā prasṛtā mukulāpi vā pāśamudrā tu tenaiva tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogataḥ kuṭilā ṛjumadhyasthā mudrāsāvaṅkuśābhidhā sannirodhanaṃ nāma devatāyā ananyacittatvaprārthanam || 34 nāmābhimukhyenopacārāṅgīkaraṇaprārthanaparam || 36 tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayoragrayogata ityarthaḥ tarjanyau ṛjusaṃśliṣṭe mudraiṣoktā namaskṛtau kṛtvā'ṅguṣṭhau kaniṣṭhāsthau ṛjū kuryācca tarjanī etasyā madhyame devi ! tarjanīvatkṛte sati tanmantropetaṃ viracayediti sampradāyārthaḥ mūlavidyātṛtīyakhaṇḍena kuryāditi sampradāyaḥ sarvayoṣitāṃ ca etaddarśanāt hṛdayollāso bhavatītyarthaḥ tābhyāmaṅkuśarūpābhyāṃ saṃśliṣṭā'karṣaṇī matā aṅguṣṭau tarjanīśliṣṭau nakhairāveśakāriṇī tadagrāśleṣato bhugne madhyame'nāmike ṛjū iyamunmādinī mudrā sarvonmādanakāriṇī eṣā mahāṅkuśā mudrā stambhanā'karṣakāriṇī maṇibandhe ca badhnīyādañjalī madhyapṛṣṭhayoḥ sthairyamityarthaḥ devatābhāvodbodhanakāriṇī sarvonmādakāriṇī sarvayoṣitāmunmādakarī kledanakarītyarthaḥ tatra asyāḥ unmādinīmudrāyāḥ | bhugne aṅguṣṭhāgrāśleṣataḥ kaniṣṭhā'nāmike kuryādvyatyastekarapṛṣṭhage asyā viracanenaiva sarvāḥ siddhyanti devatāḥ

anāmike'dhovyatyaste tarjanyāvaṅkuśākṛtī kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhasaṃśleṣā mahāyonistrikhaṇḍikā valitāvūrddhayogena ṛjutarjanikau karau mūrtīkaraṇaṃ devatāyā mūrtitvena svadehasya kalpanamityarthaḥ kopapratipādikā muṣṭireveti mūrttīkaraṇametasyā racanena samīritam sthūlasūkṣmaparākhyātā stattraividhyaṃ śṛṇu priye ! tattvarūpāṇyaṅgulayo bhūtānyaṅguṣṭhataḥ kramāt tava māyābahirbhūtastvatprasādādahantviti svalpabhedāt kopaharṣau prāṇināṃ janayatyataḥ pūjākāle darśanīyā mudrāstāḥ sarvadā śive ! vidyātmatāpādanam || 60 ṣaḍaṅganityātārtīyairekaikaṃ daśavārataḥ svātmapūjopakaraṇānyaśeṣaṃ vidyayā śive ! dadhānaṃ kāmarājāṃke yantritāṃ muditāṃ smaret nityārcaneṣu sarvatra proktaṃ naimittikārcane navāvaraṇaśaktīnāṃ dhyānaṃ devyā samaṃ bhavet tatsamaṃ parameśāni ! cakrasthānāmaśeṣataḥ nityanaimittikārcanayordhyātavyetyarthaḥ || 62 p. 78) tatheśitvaṃ vaśittvaṃ ca prākāmyā bhuktisaṃyutā bījadvayādyāḥ siddhyantāḥ saptākṣaryā ca saṃyutāḥ vārāhī ca tathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā tadanantaram etāścāṣṭau taddvayādyāḥ saptākṣaryantagāḥ kramāt prādakṣiṇyena tāḥ sarvāḥ pūjayetprathamāvṛtau rūpaṃ rasaṃ tathā gandhaṃ cittaṃ dhairyaṃ smṛtiṃ tathā

bijadvayasvarādyāśca ākarṣiṇyantakāḥ kramāt prathamāvṛtau caturasre || 66 || 67 || 68 || 69 || 70 kalāpādukāṃ pūjayāmi | evamanyepi pañcadaśamantrā ūhanīyāḥ paścāddalaṃ samārabhya vāmāvartena sundari ? rekhā ca veginī paścādaṅkuśā mālinīti ca prācyādidikṣu svāgryādikoṇeṣvarcyāḥ pradakṣiṇam antaścaturddaśārādau paścimādapradakṣiṇam ākarṣiṇyāhlādanikā tataḥ sammohinīti ca unmādinī tato jñeyā tataḥ syādarthasādhanī anaṅgakusumāpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ityādi || 75 trayodaśamantrān yojayet || 77 || 78 dvayasarvādikāḥ sarvā śaktisaptākṣarīyutāḥ antardaśārayugme tu devī saptākṣarātmikā caturthī śaktirākhyātā tathā maṅgalakāriṇī mṛtyupraśamanī paścāttathā vighnanivāriṇī daśaitāḥ śaktayaḥ pūjyā dvayasarvādikāḥ kramāt proktā sā pañcamī śaktistathā vyādhivināśinī uktaivamānandamayī tathā rakṣāsvarūpiṇī yojanīyāḥ dvayasarvādikāścaitāḥ ṣaṣṭhā'varaṇagā yajet vaśinyādīn yajet prāgvat saptākṣaryā namaḥ pade pāśamaṅkuśamityetaccatuṣkaṃ tadbhujāntike nāthā/śca pṛṣṭhato devyā jayinīvimalāntare pūjayāmi | evamanyānapi navamantrān yojayet || 84 || 85 anyatrānuvidhānāt sarvatra

yatastasmāttanau tasyā anyāḥ pañcadaśārcayet kāmeśvarīṃ savajreśīṃ tathā ca bhagamālinīm tato nāmāni śaktīnāṃ devīsaptākṣarīyutam dvayaṃ samastāṃ vidyāṃ ca pīṭhadevyabhidhāyutām praticakraṃ ca madhyasthāṃ vidyayā navanāmabhiḥ nāthānāmarcanasthānamupadiśati śrīśabdaprayogaḥ sampradāyāt dvayametā iti proktā guṇānyoginya ityapi devyā gṛhṇantviti bhavettatraividhyaṃ śṛṇu priye śrīśabdadvayaprayogaḥ prāgvat sampradāyāt pararūpaṃ tvarpaṇena viditaṃ pūjanaṃ śive tatturīyasvarūpaṃ tu bindutrayavadīritam tadbhāvanāṃ śṛṇu prājñe ! mahodayakarīṃ śubhām mahāśabdaprayogaḥ sampradāyāt || 94 pūjayet | evamanyeṣvaṣṭasvapi boddhavyam || 96 kucarūpañca taccheṣaiḥ śeṣāṅgāni ca bhāvayet asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam tadātmatvabhāvanām | mahodayakarīṃ akhaṇḍātmasvarūpalābhāt siddhyantyeveti | gurormantrātmakatvaṃ tanmukhādavagantavyam mantrātmanaste sāyujyaṃ siddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ pādyārghyācamanaṃ snānaṃ vasanābharaṇāni ca tāmbūlamarcanāstotraṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca namaskriyām sāyujyaṃ tādātmyam sampradāyaḥ ṣoḍaśasaṅkhyākān pūjopacārān kuryādityanvayaḥ

japetsahasramathavā śataṃ taddinajantu vā nyāsatrayaṃ vidhāyātha devyātmā viharetsukhī na tasya kutracit kaścit kadācit kleśasambhavaḥ tasyāvayoḥ prasādena tāni syurlakṣaṇaṃ hi tat śṛṇu yairatulā siddhistattaccakreṣu pūjanāt sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇaṃ sarvasaubhāgyaparidāyakam stavābhyāṃ kṛtena prasādena sambhavantīti tatra yaiḥ nāmabhiḥ sarvarakṣākaraṃ sarvasiddhipradamataḥ param evaṃ navāni nāmāni guṇayogīni pārvati ! sampradāyāstadantasthāḥ kulakaulanigarbhikāḥ atipūrvarahasyāstu madhyasthāḥ sthūlavigrahāḥ śrīmālinī ca siddhāmbā mahātripurasundarī sarvamadhyamityarthaḥ | guṇayogīni anvarthāni | pārvatīti sambuddhiḥ vidyāsaptākṣarīmadhyayojitairebhirarcayet sādhakavratacaryāṃ ca siddhicihnānimeva (?) ca jyotirūpaṃ ca nāthāṅghrimūrtiṣṭe (?) nyastavigrahāḥ sarvadā sarvagāḥ sarvasiddhidā balidānataḥ āvarakavadbhāta ityāvaraṇamityupahvaraḥ sampradāyārthaḥ paṭale'bhihito'smābhiḥ || 14 tadviśeṣān saṅkocakramarūpān | siddhicihnāni vidyāsiddhicihnāni prasannacetāḥ karpūravāsitā syāvarāṅgavān ṣoḍaśākṣaramantreṇa baliṃ dattvā'rcayedgurun nāthaṃ ca tanmayībhūtaṃ dhyātvā'tmānaṃ tadātmakam mātṛkādyena tannāmnā namontena samarcayet

īśānmarakataṃ vajraṃ gomedaṃ padmarāgakam indriyāṇyaśvarūpāṇi tatra paścimato yajet paścimādi tu madhyāntaṃ vilomānnavaratnakam tattvaṃ grahāśca mūrtiśca cakreśvaryantanāmakaḥ atra prakaraṇe indriyārthāvadhi namontenaiva tattannāmnā pūjayet namaḥ | navaratnakamarcayediti || 24 cakreśvaryantanāmakāḥ karuṇātoyaparikhaṃ madhyamāṇikyamaṇḍapam rūpiṇīśaktisahitaṃ tataḥ saṃgītiyoginīḥ saptākṣarairupetāstu pūjayet sarvamātaraḥ hemādipātre sādhāre sthāpayedarghyamambunā japecca daśavāraṃ tattarpayettena yoginī namaḥ atrāpi namaḥśabdayojanaṃ sampradāyāt śaktiśabdayojanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ ca prāgvat lohitaṃ tatprabhāvedhāllohitaṃ ca nijaṃ vapuḥ ādyayā'tha tṛtīyādiṣaṣṭhyantābhiḥ tathāsanam devī iti karpūram | laghuḥ aguruḥ pratitrivāraṃ cābhyarcya japitvā arghyodakena proktakāryāṇi kuryāt tato dvitīyayā proktaṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret proktā śikhā tathā samyagadhoṅguṣṭhena muṣṭinā tarjanīmadhyamānāmā proktā netratraye (ca) kramāt saśabdaṃ tarjanījyeṣṭhāyogādastramudīritam tataḥ kṛtvā vaśinyādi nyāsaṃ prāguktayogataḥ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ ai/ klī/ sauḥ astrāya phaṭ || 33

agrasthamadhyacakrasthayonimadhye niveśya tām proktāḥ saptadaśāthaināmupacāraiḥ samarcayet tato devyāḥ svamūrtitvānnityāḥ pañcadaśāpi ca ārabhya paścimadvāradakṣaśākhāmathārcayet tathā brāhmyādikā aṣṭau pūjayet prathamāvṛtau pūrvapaṭalapratipāditavaryakūṭākṣarādiyogataḥ || 35 || 36 || 37 pañcopacārāstu gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyāni || 93 navasvāvṛttiṣu proktairnavabhirmanubhiḥ kramāt ṣoḍaśāre tvaṣṭadale tathā taccaturāvṛtau madhyayoneragramūle pārśvayorbahirarcayet bāhyādīśāntamabhito vāmāvarttena saṃsthitaḥ sthūlāḥ puṣpamayāḥ, sūkṣmāḥ mantrātmānaḥ samīritāḥ kamalaṃ kairavaṃ raktaṃ kahlārendīvaraṃ tathā mānmathakṣobhajanakaṃ pūjāhomavidhānataḥ pūjāṃ prāguktām | ekaikaśaḥ pratyāvaraṇamitiśeṣaḥ madhyasthāvakāśa ityarthaḥ || 46 || 47 || 48 || raktaśabdaḥ kairavaviśeṣaṇam || tathāvidhaṃ syāttaccāpaṃ sthūlaṃ puṇḍrekṣukāṇḍajam kāmeśvaryyādikāḥ śaktīḥ tathā madhye śivāṃ yajet upacārān vidhāyātha proktayogasamanvitam smaretsvātmani tāḥ pañcadaśa nityāḥ samarcayet ātmāṣṭākṣaramantreṇa pūjayitvā tato japet sandhyātrayaṃ ṣaṣṭhisaṅkhyamuktaṃ vā proktarūpataḥ ātmamantrasya saptākṣarīyojanaṃ ca na bhavet sampradāyāt kuṇḍe sthaṇḍilamadhye vā samprokṣyārghyāmbunā kuśaiḥ madhye tathā'gnimādhāya kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajet

pratyekaṃ saptajihvāsu kuryānnava ghṛtāhutīḥ tatastāṃ binduge dhāmni vilīnāṃ paribhāvayet annavyañjanapuṣpāmbudānenoktasvarūpataḥ svamudrayā śakticakraṃ khecaryātmani yojayet japitvā stotrayugalaṃ devyātmā vicaret sukhī aśaktānāṃ tu vistāre tathā'patsu ca śasyate hetibhirmadhyamādyaṃ syāt dvitīyaṃ navayoniṣu pañcamaṃ sarvaduḥkhārtināśanaṃ vāñchitapradam devyātmā nyāsatrayāditaḥ sukhīkṛtākhilakartavyatvāt aśaktādīnāṃ rājavanitādīnām | āpatsu agnipātajvarādiṣu iti pañcaprakārā'rcā proktā sarvārthasiddhidā tadābhimukhyacihnāni vighnāni prāktanādyataḥ yena martyopi siddhyeta jīvanmuktobhavanmayaḥ guruṃ vittena santoṣya raktāgāre kramaṃ bhajet mocāguḍasitopetaṃ payaḥpāyasamarpayet dvāviṃśe kurukullāpaṭale vakṣyate | tatraiva tāṃ śṛṇu ityarthaḥ tāni śṛṇviti | yena phalarūpeṇa bhavanmayaḥ devīvigrahaḥ santuṣṭena guruṇā anuśiṣṭa eva kuryāt | kramaṃ nityakramam śarkarāḥ | arpayet nivedayet pratisandhyamiti śeṣaḥ homaṃ daśāṃśataḥ kuryāttarpaṇaṃ cendumajjalaiḥ kuryāttena bhavet pūrṇaṃ lakṣaṃ pūrṇāntamīśvari ! tretāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ tadvat dvāpare triguṇaṃ smṛtam tārtīyasaptasaṅkhyā sā tena syādekaviṃśatiḥ vanitākṣobhatobhogānna vighnaṃ jāyate yadi varjyāni śṛṇu deveśi ! taddineṣu sadāpi ca

nidrāśokau tathā'lāpaṃ deśāntaraparibhramam śṛṇu sarvatra sarveṣāṃ sarvadā nāśakāni ca striṣu rāṣaṃ prahāraṃ ca duṣṭāsvapi na yojayet puraścaraṇajapasaṅkhyāviśeṣānuktāvevāṅgīkaraṇīyam prastauti | tatra taddine puraścaraṇadineṣusarvadā sarvasmin kāle ca paranindanāni | duṣṭāsvapi avidheyāsvapi ānukūlyasya cihnāni śṛṇu sādhayatastadā gajādrisaudhaśṛṅgeṣu vihāro rājadarśanam utsavaṃ sasurāmāṃsadarśanaṃ sparśanaṃ tathā kṛṣṇavarṇairbhaṭaiḥ svapne prahārastailalepanam rāṣṭrakṣobho vahnivāyujalabhībandhunāśanam anyamantrārcanaśraddhā vighno nityārcane'niśam śraddhāsthairyaṃ sampradāyasiddhinityārcanaṃ bhavet sādhayataḥ sādhanaparasya | tadā prāgukte sarvakāle nṛtyagītayordarśanamityanvayaḥ | sparśanaṃ tathā tayoriti śeṣaḥ || 82 sa nāpnoti phalānyuktānyanyathā nāśameti ca sa caturddhā tatoloke tatprakārān śṛṇu priye ! grāmagogṛhagaśceti caturdhā tadvyavasthitiḥ prāgādi paścimāntaṃ tu kādimāntāni vinyaset īśe dvayamathomadhye svarātprāgādi vinyaset manīṣitārthaprāptikarīvidyā satsampradāyavatīti tataḥ dvitīya iti uktaprakāreṇa | tadvyavasthitiḥ kūrmavyavasthitiḥ tanmukhaṃ pārśvayoḥ pāṇī kukṣī pādau tatastataḥ mukhe sarvārthasiddhiḥ syātkarayoralpasiddhikṛt pucche mṛtyustu niyataṃ pṛṣṭhe sarvārthadāyakam

vyañjanaṃ deśakūrme * syāt gṛhakūrme svarāstathā nityaṃ pūrvamukho yasmāttena tatsiddhirīritā tasya kūrmasya karayugaṃ tadanantaraṃ koṣṭhadvayaṃ tasya jaṭharam mantrāṇāṃ tena siddhiḥ syātsarveṣāṃ sarvatastadā vijñāya vargaṃ teṣvekamādyaṃ nāmni prakalpayet tattatsthāneṣu niyatamanarthaṃ śūnyatā tathā asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam tadavayavāvasthānādhīnā || 97 || yena kūrma vibhāgajñānena śūnyatā niṣphalatā naimittikaṃ ca kāmyaṃ ca vakṣye'haṃ śṛṇu sundari ! anyathā bhajanaṃ cecchan karotyāpatparamparām tadvidhānamato vakṣye caitrādyaṃ phālgunāvadhi pūrvapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ niśi saṃsthāpya vidyayā anyathā bhajanaṃ uktakramaviparyāsabhajanam, etatsarvasādhāraṇam guṇavidhānaṃ tatprakāraṃ ca prastauti asminmāse ca pūrṇāyāṃ vasantotsavapūjanam saugandhikaiḥ sakāśmīraiḥ pūjāṃ pūrvavadujjvalām api vā candrakastūrīcandanaiḥ śiśirodakaiḥ phalaistu pūjayeddevīṃ pūrvavat sarvasiddhaye elā kakkolajātībhirupetaiḥ pūjayecchivām tadvidhānamidaṃ bhadre ! śṛṇu saubhāgyadāyakam yathāśakti vittairgurupūjanaṃ ca kuryāditi pūrvavat prāguktādhivāsapūrvakam pūrvavat sādhivāsam sādhivāsaṃ pūjayet

kārpāsasambhavai raktairnavadhā guṇitaiḥ śubhaiḥ navāṅgulairvā tatsaṅkkhyai saragranthyādisaṃyutam kṛtvā'dhivāsapūrvaṃ tu pūjayettairyathākramam aṣṭottaraśataiḥ sūtraiḥ kuryācchaktyā * ca tārakam vārāhīkurukullādiśaktīnāṃ mūlaśaktivat 10 || vā pakṣāntare | raktaiḥ kuṅkumacandanādyaruṇitaiḥ kramāgamajñaśiṣyāṇāmātmavatsamudīritam paridhānapramāṇena maṇḍapasyaikasūtrataḥ kṛtvā pavitratritayaṃ tāni devyai samarpayet na kuryānmānasāṅkaryaṃ yadi kuryādvinaśyati prasūnairarcayeddevīṃ pūrvoktavidhinā yutam ārabhya pūjayeddevīṃ gandhapuṣpopahārakaiḥ sahasraṃ juhuyānnityaṃ japaṃ caiva samācaret || paridhāna pramāṇena śaktiyoginīnāṃ mānena tatra pūrvoktavidhinā yutaṃ adhivāsapūrvam amāvāsyānantarapratipattithim | upahāraḥ nivedyam datvā bhūṣaṇavastrādi dakṣiṇāṃ ca samuddharet tena vidvān bhavetsiddho nṛpatiṃ kurute'rcakam rātrau pradīpakairhomaiḥ kuryāt ghṛtasamedhitaiḥ śaktīnāmekamekaṃ tu sthāpayettattadagrataḥ kṛtvā nivedayenmūlavidyayā saprasūnakam nivedyābhyarcayenmāṣapiṣṭāpūpairyathāvidhi samācaredityarthaḥ | sampūjya nityoktakrameṇa kanyakāpūjanaṃ kuryāditi pakṣāntaraṃ eṣa gauṇaḥ pakṣaḥ

māṣapiṣṭāpūpaiḥ pūjayedityarthaḥ | yathāvidhi adhivāsapūrvam pūjayediṣṭasaṃsiddhyai gavyaṃ dugdhaṃ nivedayet pūjayeddugdhanaivedyasitāpūpādibhiḥ sadā cūtasaugandhimadhukaiḥ pūjayedīpsitāptaye kuryādvaiśeṣikaṃ puṇyeṣvāgamokteṣu teṣvapi procyante kāmyarūpāṇi ṣaṭkarmāṇi samarcanaiḥ proktāni kāmyakarmāṇi prayoge'nyatsamarcayet ajamahiṣyādikṣīravyāvṛttyartham ādiśabdaḥ phalādiviṣayaḥ | sadā sarvadinārcaneṣu tatra svarṇarājataiḥ puṣpairiti śeṣaḥ āgamokteṣu gurujanmadivasādiṣu ṣaṭkarmāṇi tadaṅgatvādanyeṣāṃ na pṛthak sthitiḥ pūjādravyairdeśakālaiḥ kathyante sādhvanukramāt jayāya dahanāgāre lābhāyānilamaṇḍale dravyaiḥ ṣoḍhā vibhajyāhaḥ kramādrātriṃ ca pūjayet tāni pūjāvidhau proktairdevyāstairnavanāmabhiḥ caitrādimāsanāmāni teṣu tairdānapūjanaiḥ saparyāviśeṣeṇaiva vāñchitāptikathanamiti vaśyākarṣaṇavidveṣaṇādīnām | deśakālairityatra kālaśabdomuhūrtādivāco vrīhimāṣayavakṣaudraghṛtatailapayombaraiḥ caitrādiṣu rutaṃ nādaṃ dadyādvidyāvide'rcayet bilvovaṭaśca mātṝṇāṃ pādapāḥ samudīritāḥ teṣu caitrādiṣu yajedājñāsiddhirdṛḍhā bhavet āyuḥ kāntiṃ śriyaṃ bhūmiṃ vijayaṃ śaśvadaśnute

mocāṃ guḍaṃ nārikelaṃ pūrṇāntaṃ homayedapi darśe tvekamathaivaṃ syāt kṛte lakṣmyā nṛpo bhavet lakṣmyānṛpobhavedityanvayaḥ bhaume raktotpalaiḥ saumye vāre tagarasambhavaiḥ utpalaiḥ śanivāreṣu pūjayedabdamādarāt pāyasaṃ dugdhakadalīnavanītaṃ site ghṛtam grahapiḍāṃ vijityāśu mukhāni ca samaśnute unnatonnatamāmadhyāccakraṃ syānnidhanaṃ dhanam eka dviṣaṭkramonnāmaḥ śriyai kīrtyai ca kalpate ratne hemani rūpye ca tāmre dṛṣadi ca kramāt upacārāntarāṇyucyante caturasrot padmadvayamunnataṃ tasmāccaturdaśārādikaṃ samunnatam lakṣmīkāntiyaśaḥputradhanārogyādisiddhaye phalakāyāṃ paṭe bhittau sthāpayenna kadācana kulavittamapatyaṃ ca nirmūlayati sarvathā siddhadravyaiśca (?) saptāhāt khecarīmelanaṃ bhavet kadambajātīpuṣpābhyāṃ siddhadravyaiḥ śivāṃ yajet ketakīkusumaiḥ siddhāśceṭakā vāridhestaṭe vasūni mālābhūṣādi dadyādasyecchayā'niśam sarvanityārcanaprastārasādhāraṇāni || 54 || sthāpayet pratiṣṭāṃ kuryāt || mohena avivekāt | ajñānataḥ niṣedhājñānataḥ śālmalīkusumaiḥ siddhadravyairmāsaṃ tu nirbhayaḥ aśmapātaprahārādyairasya ghnanti dviṣaściram yajeddevīṃ cakragatāṃ siddhadravyasamanvitām tena siddhyanti vetālāstā nāruhya svecchayā caret

madhyarātre yajeddevīṃ kṛṣṇavastrādibhūṣaṇaḥ sādhyayoniṃ tadagre tu baliṃ dadyānnivedayet jāyante bhīṣaṇāḥ kṛtyāstābhyaḥ sādhyaṃ nivedayet devyā lalāṭanetrāḥ syuḥ prārthanena tirohitāḥ dadyāt, ekaika iti śeṣaḥ || 61 || nirbhayaḥ piśācādidarśanāt acakitacittaḥ || 62 || piśācikāḥ piśācikā nāma kāścana bhīmavigrahā devatāḥ udyāne nirjane devīṃ cakre sañcintya pūjayet siddhadravyasamopetairmāyāḥ siddhyanti māsataḥ yābhirviśvamayoviśvacārī viśvavinodavān candracandanakastūrīmṛganābhirmahodayaiḥ pūrṇapratītau bhavyāni vikale'bhavyamīritam mātṛkāsahitāṃ vidyāṃ trirāvṛttyāmṛtātmakam abdāccaturvidhaṃ tasya pāṇḍityaṃ bhuvi jāyate siddhamasmatsamīhitam, yathāgataṃ gacchata iti prārthanena || 68 indrajālādipradarśanena āyudhavarṇāvayavādivaikalyasphuraṇe | abhavyaṃ amaṅgalam sa yogī brahmavijjñānī śivayogī tathā'tmavit campakendīvarairmāsādārogyamupajāyate dantakarṇajvaraśiraḥśūlagulmādikukṣijāḥ sarve tayā samaṃ yānti pūjayā parameśvari ! sindūraṃ gairikaṃ lākṣā daradaṃ candane'pivā daradenāsya madhyasthāṃ pūjayetparameśvarīm nānārūpakathanaṃ lokoktyanumatyartham rogāḥ sarvarogā iti śeṣaḥ || 79 śrīcakranirmāṇadravyasaptakamupadiśati | tatra candane śītarakte

kusumairmāsamātreṇa nāgakanyāḥ sametyatam yakṣarākṣasagandharvasiddhavidyādharāṅganāḥ siddhyanti pūjanāttatra tathā tatproktakālataḥ raktotpalairaśvasiddhyai kumudaiḥ kharasiddhaye jambīrairmahiṣāvāptyai lakucairajasiddhaye bakulairaṅganāsiddhyai kalhāraiḥ putrasiddhaye saurabhādyaiḥ prasūnaistu nityaṃ saubhāgyasiddhaye etaccakrārcanaṃ lalitānityāyā eva, nānyāsām | taṃ sādhakam yakṣetyādayo devatāviśeṣāḥ || 83 || tatra vīrā manuṣyasiddharūpāḥ syandanāndolikādisiddhaye || 85 || 86 || 87 yāvatphalāpti vā kṣīraśarkarāghṛtapāyasaiḥ tarpayet kusumaiḥ sārghyaiḥ sarvopaplavaśāntaye dugdhairārogyasaṃsiddhyai tribhiraiśvaryasiddhaye sarvārthasiddhaye toyai rabhiṣiñcenmaheśvarīm nivasaṃstatra tatpuṣpairjāyate manmatho'paraḥ kṛtyāḥ pareritā mantrā vimukhāstān grasanti vai sarvanaivedyānītyarthaḥ nityapūjāmantraistatkrameṇa dadyāt tena sarvopaplavaśāntirbhavati tribhiḥ proktaiḥ || 91 || prītyai svanirvṛttaye pūjayanniṣṭamakhilaṃ labhate'tra paratra ca pūjayenmāsamātreṇa prāgjanmāghairvimucyate vimuktaḥ sarvapāpaughaistāṃ paśyati ca cakṣuṣā mucyate pāpakṛtyādiduḥkhairghoratarairapi bhāvayanviṣayaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayaṃstanmayo bhavet ṣaṭprakārabhajanamupadiśati | tatra tatpuṣpaiḥ pūgaprasūnaiḥ || 93

janitairduḥkhairityarthaḥ tanmayobhavet tadahaṅkāre svāhaṅkāraṃ vilāpayedityarthaḥ bhāvayanviṣayaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayaṃstanmayo bhavet asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattatvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam kāmeśvarīti tāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ śṛṇu tattvataḥ tadyogabedāṃstadyantrāṇyabhīṣṭārthapradāni ca mūlavidyākṣarairevaṃ kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭkramāt caturbhirnayanaṃ tadvadastramekena coditam ca ityantena ślokadvayena paṭalārthānupadiśati | tatra tatvataḥ yathāvat tacchaktīḥ tadāvaraṇabhūtāḥ śaktīrityarthaḥ vyāpakatvena sarvāṅge mūrdhvādi prapadāvadhi samastena vyāpakantu kuryāduktakremeṇa vai yena devī suprasannā dadātīṣṭamayatnataḥ hāragrevaiyakāñcībhirūrmikānūpurādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhujāṃ trīkṣaṇāmindukalākalitamaulikām mandasmitollasadvaktrāṃ dayāmantharavīkṣaṇām ityādibhiḥ punarapi kuryādityarthaḥ pañcadaśānāṃ nityānāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ nāma ratapātraṃ sudhāpūrṇaṃ varadaṃ bibhratīṃ karaiḥ prayogādiṣu sarvatra vakṣye dhyānāni tatra vai śoṣaṇaśceti kathitā bāṇāḥ pañca puroditāḥ anaṅgapadapūrvāstāḥ pañcamī madaveginī rekhā gaganapūrvā'nyā pūjyā patreṣu cāṣṭasu

mānaviśeṣaśca upariṣṭādvakṣyamāṇatvādiha na prapañcitaḥ vāmadakṣiṇakrameṇādharahastayordakṣiṇavāmakrameṇa ca kalpayet tatra vai prayogopadeśasthāneṣu pañcabāṇaśaktīḥ pūjayet manoharā'ṣṭamī proktā devī sā'tra manorathā śoṣaṇī ca vaśaṃkārī siṃjinī subhagā tataḥ pūjyāstāḥ pratipattraṃ tu pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśacchade vṛddhisaumyā marīciśca paratastvaṃśumālinī tuṣṭyā'mṛtākhyyā kathitāḥ kalāḥ syuḥ sasvarā vidhoḥ bahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇakoṇeṣu ḍākinyādyāstathā'rcayet aṣṭamī ṣoḍaśedalapūjyāḥ śaktīrupadiśati | tatra aṣṭamī manorathetyanvayaḥ ṣoḍaśa priyadarśanā ityarthaḥ caturthāvaraṇe bahiḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu pūjyāḥ śaktīrupadiśati baṭukaṃ gaṇapaṃ durgāṃ kṣetreśaṃ cābhito yajet tannāmabbhirbaliṃ tebhyo dadyādgandhādi coditaiḥ prāguktairupacārādyairhomaṃ kuryāttatastathā kākinīśākinīhākinīti śaktitrayamarcayet iti gandhādicoditaiḥ vakṣyamāṇairdravyairiti śeṣaḥ annādyābhyāṃ prajuhuyāttataḥ prāgvat samāpayet mahācamatkārakarāṃstrailokyakṣobhaṇakṣamān sasarja bāṇānuktāṃśca trividhān prāgudīritān prāgvat tripaṅktikasya nāthanavakasya pūjanaṃ ca kuryādityarthaḥ prāgudīritān pañcame paṭale bāṇāḥ syurityādibhiḥ proktān yairviśvaṃ vaśamāyāti kṣaṇāttadbhāvanādinā

kandarpastattṛtīyo'bhuttato makaraketanaḥ dhyānaṃ teṣāṃ śṛṇu prājñe viśvavikṣobhakāriṇām sarve dvinetrā dvibhujāḥ smarevaktrasaroruhāḥ viśvākārā viśvamanovikṣobhaniyatātmakāḥ yairekaikaiḥ saṅgataiśca yantrāṇi syuḥ pṛthak pṛthak prāṇorasāvahniyutastathā svenāpi manmathaḥ ādiśabdo'bhiṣekanyāsādiviṣayaḥ || 29 || tattṛtīyaḥ teṣu tṛtīyaḥ dhūmranīlakau | pañcabhūtaśaktirūpatvāttattadbhūtavarṇāḥ bhūtātmakatvādeva yantrāṇi kṣmayā svena ca samproktaḥ so'yaṃ makaraketanaḥ bhālavaktrasahṛnnābhiguhyeṣa nyāsatastvamī bhālāntaṃ vinyasennityaṃ yaḥ sa sarvāṅganāsmaraḥ tāni krameṇa kathayāmyākarṇaya samāhitā śaivabāṇamantrān tattatsthānādi namo'ntān vinyasediti tatra krameṇa proktakūṭamantrakrameṇa yojayedaṣṭabhistaistaiḥ svarān ṣoḍaśa māyayā tairyantrāṇi vidheyāni pañcānāṃ kramataḥ śive likhet sādhyākhyayopetaṃ ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu tat punaḥ svaravikṛtākṣaraiḥ vṛttāntarālayorbāhye catuḥṣaṣṭyā dvirālikhet pañcabhiścaikamastyanyadyantraṃ sumahadadbhūtam bahistṛtīyarūpeṇa ṣaṭkoṇena praveṣṭayet veṣṭayet pañcamenaiva tadyantraṃ sarvamohanam manīṣiteṣvartheṣu viniyuñjāt || 42

guruktakramataḥ samālikhya vāñchitārtheṣu viniyuñjyāditi yantrāntaraṃ tu janayedbahirmātṛkayā'pi ca tairasādhyaṃ jagatsveṣu na kiñcinna kadācana aṣṭasūkteṣu madhyasthaṃ bhāvayet svena tejasā tena te vaśagāḥ kṣipraṃ yāvajjīvaṃsuniścitam prāgvadādikṣāntānyakṣarāṇi samālikhedetadaṣṭamaṃ yantramiti sampradāyarahasyārthaḥ svātmasvarūpeṇa tanmantrārṇaprakāśaiśca tathā'ruṇatarairvṛtam tena te vaśagāḥ kṣipraṃ dadyuḥ prāṇān dhanāni ca prāgvannijasuṣumṇāntarbhāvayedyonimudrayā yenābhiṣiñcet daurbhāgyarogadāridryamuktaye kṛtvā cakrāṣṭakaṃ bhūmau phalakāyāṃ śilāsu ca tatkrameṇārcayediti kāmeśvarītadagrastho japellakṣaṃ payovrataḥ asmin janmani sallakṣmīmavāpya sukhamedhate deśaṃ janapadaṃ viśvaṃ tanmadhye pravilikhya tat naivedyaiḥ kadalīdugdhaśarkarāpāyasādibhiḥ kandarpasamasaubhāgyo jāyate niyataṃ naraḥ lakṣmīkāntidhanārogyairāyuḥ pūrṇamavāpnuyāt ityarthaḥ | asmin janmani tādātvikakāle saptavidhatvādekonapañcāśaddināni sarvairucyante saṃlikhya yantraṣoḍaśakamiti śeṣaḥ dvānavatyā śataṃ varṇā jāyante mantrasambhavāḥ kriyate parameśāna tanme kathaya sāmpratam

pañcatriṃśat samākhyātaṃ tayoranyonyasaṅgataiḥ tatprāṇayojanaṃ viddhi rahasyaṃ parameśvari prāṇāḥ svarāḥ samākhyātā bindusargau tu cetanā tena tadyuktito varṇāḥ prasīdanti na cā'nyathā bhāratyā mātṛkādehe viddhi caitanyajṛmbhaṇam svaravyañjanayoranyonyasaṅgataireva samākhyātamityarthaḥ 65 || hasau hakārasakārau | netre śivaśaktirūpatvāt | cetanā cidrūpam tena kāraṇena | tadyuktitaḥ hakārasakārasvarairyogataḥ niṣprāṇadehavat kāryakaraṇeṣvakṣamāḥ smṛtāḥ ye ye mantrāḥ proktavarṇavihīnāstaiśca yojayet tasmāt sarvatra saṃyogāt svaraiḥ sarvārthasiddhidāḥ dvātriṃśadviniyogā/śca vakṣye teṣāmanukramāt māyāgarbhaṃ samālikhya veṣṭayenmātṛkākṣaraiḥ svarayogena ca sarveṣāṃ balayojanaṃ ca bhavati svaravarddhitairdvānavatyadhikaśatasaṅkhyairakṣarairityarthaḥ tṛtīye kanyakāsiddhiścaturthe bhūparigrahaḥ saptame bhavanāvāptiraṣṭame dhenusaṅgamaḥ ekādaśena vijayī naraḥ samarasīmani dvādaśe'bhīpsitā'vāptiḥ pareṇārivināśanam bhujaṅgameṣamahiṣavājināntvāśu nāśanam sthāpitaṃ maṇḍalānmāsāt saptarātrādathāpi vā krodhavairasamudyogagamanāderapi dhruvam sambhūya dvātriṃśadyantrāṇi kriyanta iti trayodaśena yantreṇa || 77 tataḥ pareṇa yantreṇa khātena dharaṇitale

anantarābhyāṃ khananāt kalahodvegayordvayoḥ deśānāmapi cānyonyakalahāt pīḍanaṃ bhavet rāṣṭrasandhitale tasya khananenālpakālataḥ dvāviṃśena gavāṃ rogastrayoviṃśena dantinām ṣaḍviṃśena pradhānānāṃ rogāvāptirdṛḍhaṃ bhavet aṣṭāviṃśena yantreṇa kṛtyāpratinivartate taḍāgakūpavāpyādiṣvarpaṇādyāti sā dhruvam tata ūrdhvena yantreṇa vairivākstambhanam bhavet rakṣā bhavati tadbhūṣu khananāḍdhāraṇādapi tatratatra gajādīnāmālānasthāneṣu | maṇḍalāt prāgvat || 79 || 80 kleśanāśanam || 83 || 84 || 85 || 86 pāraṃ prayānti cā'kleśādvicitrā yantraśaktayaḥ tattattithau tadbhajanaṃ japahomārcanādinā kṣaudraṃ guḍaṃ nālikeraṃ phalaṃ lājāṃ tilaṃ dadhi pratipattithimārabhya kramātpañcadaśasvapi ādyāyā lalitāyāstu sarvāṇyetāni sarvadā vidyāśaktimatāṃ nityamabhīṣṭāvāptaye'niśam saṃpiṣya guṭikāṃ kṛtvā tābhiḥ sarvatra sādhayet phalapradānītyarthaḥ || 88 || 89 || 90 tarpaṇā'bhiṣekā ucyante pañcadaśanityāmayatvāt || 93 || 94 || 95 paṭīrasaṃyutaṃ bhāle dhāraṇaṃ sarvasiddhikṛt snāne pāne dhāraṇe ca gulikāyojanena vai na bādhante tato nityamarcayet svagṛhe kvacit asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam

parāmṛṣṭam devatāsaparyāsthāne || 100 parāmṛṣṭam vyākhyāgranthāḥ satripādāḥ caturdaśaśatadvayam śṛṇu devi ! pravakṣyāmi sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ kramāt tatpūjāyāḥ kramaṃ homaṃ yantrāṇi vividhāni ca aṅgāni mantravarṇaiḥ syādādyena hṛdudīritam catuṣṭayatrayaiḥ śeṣāṇyaṅgāni ṣaḍiti kramāt trinetrāṃ bāhubhiḥ ṣaḍbhirupetāṃ kamalāsanām cetyantena ślokadvayena paṭalārthānuddiśati ṣaṭnyasediti śeṣaḥ | ādyena mūla vidyāyā ādyenākṣareṇa kavacanetrāstrāṇi | atrāpi prāgvajjātiyojanaṃ kuryāt ambujāsane sthitām | vāmabāhubhirūrddhādikramataḥ dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ padmamaṅkuśaṃ puṣpasāyakam akṣarothābhiranyābhiḥ smaronmādamadātmabhiḥ saptākṣarīṃ ca saṃyojya śaktīstatsaṅkhyakā yajet hlādinīṃ drāviṇīṃ prītiṃ ratiṃ raktāṃ manoramām analpāṃ vyaktavibhavāṃ vividhakṣobhavigrahe tābhirvṛtāṃ tu tāṃ devīṃ pūjayedvāñchitāptaye sarvaśaktigaṇasādhāraṇam śaktayaśca sambhavanti yena viśvaṃ vaśe bhūyādapi sthāvarajaṅgamam tanmadhye'bjaṃ pañcadalaṃ kṛtvā tatkarṇikāgatam pañcatriṃśacchataṃ saṅkhyāyonayaḥ paritaḥsthitāḥ madhye vṛttatrayaṃ kuryāttatra viṃśatirekhayā

vṛttāntarāle tvabhitā yajedaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt āvaraṇadvayamityarthaḥ saṃsthāpanādirbhiyuktāmarcayedupacārakaiḥ dvārasya pārśvayorāgadveṣaśaktīstathā'rcayet tadantavṛttayormadhye ṣaḍaṅgāni tathā'rcayet madhye ca devīmabhito (ṣaḍe) yajetānyāyudhānyapi pūjayedādyavarṇena vidadhyāttadviladvayam mūlataḥ mūlavidyayā | pūrvavat svarūpiṇīti tryakṣarasahitam prāgvadagnimukhaṃ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryāddaśāṃśataḥ svātmanyudvāsayeduktaprakāreṇa maheśvarīm kāmyahomamatho vakṣye nānābhīṣṭāptidāyakam āragvadhaistu rājānaṃ karavīraistu vaiśyakam bilvairlakṣmīrbhaveddhomairbhūmyādyaiḥ kamalairhutāt saubhāgyaṃ campakaiḥ siddhai raktasaugandhikaṃ hunet madhukaiḥ kanyakāsiddhyai palāśaiḥ svarṇasiddhaye kuryāditi sampradāyārthaḥ raktotpalaiḥ sarvāsiddhyai homayetparameśvari candanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṅkumairliket suvarṇe rajate tāmre tvaṃśuke bhūrjapatrake nidhāya kvāpi pūjāṃ vā kuryādyantrāṇyaśeṣataḥ yoniṃ vilikhya tanmadhye māyāṃ sādhyasamanvitām ekaikavṛttayormadhye śeṣārṇāni samālikhet evaṃ yantrāṇi mantrārṇairdaśabhirdaśabhirbhavet hutasaṃkhyaṃ mūlamantraṃ japediti sarvatrasamayaḥ || 25 || 26 || 27 raktotpalaiḥ raktakumudaiḥ

yantrādhikaraṇāni yantradhāraṇaprakārā/ścopadiśati || 30 || 31 jyā kāṃdāvo'mbu hṛtsvena māyayā'mṛtapañcakam taiḥ ṣaṇḍhahīnaiḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ syānmāyayā ca tathā bhavet teṣāṃ sarvatra tantre'smin viniyogovidhīyate māyāmadhye ekamekaṃ mantrākṣaraṃ ca likhediti sampradāyaḥ || 33 vaśyamākarṣaṇaṃ stambhamārogyaṃ vijayaṃ śriyam naranārīnṛpāṇāṃ ca proktayogena sādhayet nityācaturdaśārṇaiścāpyekaṣaṣṭiśatena ca tairyantraracanāyogaṃ phalāni ca śṛṇu priye caivaṃ pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatākṣarāṇi samālikhediti proktayogena sādhayet dhāraṇanikṣepādinā || 39 catuḥśatamudīritamiti tatra taiḥ proktasaṃkhyairakṣaraiḥ vidhāya madhye māyāsthaṃ kṛtvā nāmatrikoṇagam caturdaśārṇamālikhya vṛttamadhye tu mātṛkām trayastriṃśattamaṃ yantraṃ saśaktyamṛtapañcakaiḥ sphoṭe masūrikāyāṃ ca netrābhyāṃ kukṣisaṃbhave sarvatrākṣarayantreṣu vidhānam bālagrahārtau daurbhāgye bandhyātve vairipīḍane ḍākinyādigaṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirākrāntyāṃ brahmarākṣasaiḥ yojayeduktavidhinā trayastriṃśaditīśvari śṛṇu devi ! pravakṣyāmi sarvāṅgāṅgitvayogataḥ śatadvayaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiṃ taiścakraṃ tatra pūjanam tena koṣṭhāni jāyante caturasrāṇi pārvati kāgade || 46 || 47 || ṣaḍbhirākrāntyāmiti ṣaḍvidhāni phalānyucyante

arcājapādinā kāmeśvaryādinityānāṃ pañcadaśānāmiti śeṣaḥ proktasaṅkhyairakṣaraiḥ pradeśagatyā vilikhedyāvatsaṅkhyaṃ yathāntaram avaśiṣṭaṃ bhavetteṣu dikstheṣvekīkṛteṣu ca ekonapañcāśatkoṣṭheśvekībhūte(na)ṣu tatra vai likhitvā karṇikāmadhye yoniṃ māyodarāṃ likhet bhagamālāṃ madhyaśaktyāmāvāhyābhyarcayedbahiḥ yathākramamidaṃ cakramāsāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ bhavet yathākrameṇa citrāntāḥ pūjayeduktavigrahāḥ catuṣkacatuṣṭayeṣu ekīkṛteṣu, madhyarekhātrayamārjaneti śeṣaḥ dvārāṇāṃ pārśvayoḥ koṇeṣvarcayeddvādaśa kramāt komārīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ saumye vārāhyaindrīṃ ca pūrvage deśakālau tathākāraśabdau proktakrameṇa vai upacārairāsavaiśca māṃsairmatsyaiḥ susaṃskṛtaiḥ caturdaśanityānām || 58 || 59 || 60 || pūrvage dvāre iti śeṣaḥ || 61 kadalīpanasādyaiśca phalairmadhubhireva ca ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā pañcarātraṃ tu sapta vā varṣaṃ vā phālgunāntaṃ vā syātsamastārtināśanam devatānāmathotpāte trividhe tvabhicārake kṛcchreṣvanyeṣu ghoreṣu pūjaiṣā sarvakāmadā kṛtvaitatproktarūpaṃ ca proktadravyaistathā'rcayet tatpūrvanityāntaṃ tathā'rcayet iti mallikāmālatījātīśatapatrotpalādibhiḥ etadvidyābhaktirūpāstiyutānanyāṃśca pūjayet

vitavalīṃ māṣudhvīgaucate sarvatra vaiparītye utpāte trividhe divyāntarikṣabhaumatvena prokte (rgurgu) yocanā | hyāśantaḥ likṣilatasatanaḥ ghanaḥ māpulo pusa prosyarvaśivet tvayotobhaso nmayā yonyarṇavākhyaṃ vanitāgavaparvatavajrakam nasalesi śeddhāva prāk tarca cogaḥ di(śapraṃ satrayo diśadvīlikā ścamṛtaṃ ṇadīturirgumucam lāraitrarddehāvataḥ dāsasiddhiryārvasaḥ syāja edho vayat vā kṛt klekānyamathā sada tatra dvyaṅgulamāneṣu sūtrāṇyekādaśārpayet catvāriṃśacca catvāri teṣu mantrākṣarāṇi tu madhye'vaśiṣṭanavake navavargasamanvite sarvatra vilikhedbhūyo bhūyostvāvartanena tu dahyamānāṃ hṛtasvāṃtāṃ mastakasthāpitāñjalim vāyupreṅkatpatākākhyapaṭopamakalevarām cintayennārcayeccakramadhye devīṃ digambarām anyaiḥ sugandhiśe(ṣat)phāli kusumādyaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ yāvaccharīrapātantu chāyevā'napagā'sya sā asyā niṣphālanācitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam iti śrīṣoḍaśanityātantreṣu śrīkādimate'ṣṭamaṃ paṭalam navavargā navanāthātmakāḥ || 94 || 95 || 96 || kalevaraṃ śarīram || 97 proktaphalamavāpnuyāditi paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam nityaklinnāvidhānānāṃ tanmantraṃ prāgudīritam homatarpaṇabhedāṃśca yantrāṇi phalabhedataḥ

ādyena mantravarṇena hṛdayaṃ samudīritam kuryāccheṣāṇi cāṅgāni karayośca nyaset kramāt nyasedaṅguṣṭhamūlādi kaniṣṭhāgrāntamūrdhvagam tvaci dhvaje ca pāyau ca pādayorvarṇakaṃ nyaset sārddhamitiśeṣaḥ | nirdiṣṭaṃ arthajātamiti śeṣaḥ aruṇāsṛgvilepāṃ tāṃ cārusmeramukhāmbujām virājamānāṃ mandāralasadarddhenduśekharām abhayaṃ vibhratīṃ padmamadhyāsīnāṃ madālasām kṣobhiṇīmohinīlīlātrikoṇāśriṣu śaktayaḥ madadravā drāviṇī ca vidhānācāṣṭapatragā mohā'modā mānamayī māyāmandāmanovatīḥ madhyanityā samākāravarṇabāhāyudhānvitāḥ sarvāṅge | dhvaje mehane | pāyau gude | pādayorekamakṣaramiti śeṣaḥ caturbhirbāhubhiḥ vāmorddhādivāmadakṣiṇakrameṇa || 7 || 8 tanmadhe'ṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tanmadhye tryasrakaṃ tathā caturasre paścimādinir-ṛityantaṃ yajecca tām tadantarā'ṣṭapatreṣu paścimādipradakṣiṇam agrāt pradakṣiṇaṃ tisraḥ śaktīścoktavidhānataḥ nir-ṛtyāṃ puratodikṣu yajedaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt upacārairarcayecca baliṃ dadyācca pūrvavat tato'bhyarcya śivāṃ homaṃ kuryādukrameṇa tu tatra cakranirmāṇaṃ sukaraṃ kṛtvā'rcayeditiśeṣaḥ kṣobhiṇyādyāḥ | uktavidhānataḥ evamuktakrameṇetyarthaḥ juhuyātprāgvaduditasaṅkhyaṃ prāgvatsamāpya tat nyāsaṃ kṛtvā stotrayugaṃ japitvā tanmayaścaret

śṛṇu devi ! pravakṣyāmi prayogārho yato bhavet prāgvallakṣaṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ kuryāddhomaṃ ca tarpaṇam candracandranakastūrīvāsitaistarpayejjalaiḥ sahasrajāpī tadbhaktaḥ kuryāduktaṃ na cā'nyathā sarvanityāsādhāraṇaḥ | tanmayaḥ prāgvat ślokairvidyāpuraścaraṇaprakāramupadiśati | tatra yataḥ sādhanataḥ lakṣaṃ vidyāyā yugānurūpamakṣaralakṣakrameṇa prayogādyabhijñaḥ nānyamiti (nānyatheti) sarvadevatāsādhāraṇam tathaiva kairavairaktairaṅganāstu vaśaṃ nayet mallikāmālatījātīśatapatrairhutairbhavet āragvadhaprasūnaistu kṣaudrāktairhavanādbhavet ājyāktaiḥ karavīrotthaiḥ prasūnairaruṇairhutaiḥ bhūṣāvāhanavāṇijyasiddhayaścāsya vāñchitāḥ tattailāktairniśāmadhye tvānayedvāñchitāṃ vadhūm māsādarāteḥ tīvrārtijvareṇa bhavati dhruvam śatrordehe vraṇāni syurduḥsādhyāni cikitsakaiḥ tathā tattailasaṃsiktairbījairaṅkārakairapi samānarūpavatsāyāḥ śuklavatsāyā ityarthaḥ || 27 || 28 || 29 || 30 itaraiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ | vā pakṣāntare | tattailāktaiḥ sarṣapadvayatailāktaiḥ vāñchitāṃ vanitāṃ kāmajvarārtāmānayed dhruvam dhairyamānakulairnityaṃ duṣprāpāmānayedvadhūm tenānnapūrṇabhuvanobhoktā ca bhavati priye ! mudgaiḥ mudgaṃ dhṛtairājyamiṣṭairiṣṭaṃ hutairbhavet rājīmarīcaloṇotthāṃ puttalīṃ juhuyānniśi nābheradhastāddhṛdayādbhinnenākaṇṭhatastathā

evaṃ dvādaśadhā homānnaranārinarādhipāḥ prayānti nidhanaṃ cāsya vāñchayā'nanyayogataḥ vanitākarṣaṇahomamupadiśati | tatra sugamo'rthaḥ || 36 kṛtvā puttalikāṃ sādhyanāmayuktāmatho hṛdi spṛśannijakarāgreṇa sahasraṃ prajapenmanum naranārīnṛpāstasya vaśyāḥ śyurmaraṇāvadhi sādhyanāma sphuṭaṃ kṛtvā prāgvat saṃpācya bhakṣaṇāt kṛtvā'bhipācya bhakṣyāttu vaśayettā/stadarddhakam svātmaikyabhāvanayetyarthaḥ | hṛdi puttalikāhṛdaye, prāgvallikhitasādhyasaṃjñāmityarthaḥ saṃpātaghṛtābhyaktam | taddhiyā sādhyabhakṣaṇadhiyā karpūravāsitaistoyairmanuṣyāḥ syurvaśe sthitāḥ tathā lavaṇayuktena toyena vanitā vaśāḥ tarpayedyasya nāmnaiva sa tasya syādvaśo'niśam tarpaṇādvanitā vaśyā dadyuḥ prāṇānnijaṃ dhanam campakairvāsitajalaiḥ tarpaṇaṃ sarvarañjanam sarvalokacamatkārakārī bhavati nityaśaḥ inducandanasaurabhyavāsitāmbhaḥpratarpaṇam saktumiśrajalairāḍhyo dhanadhānyādibhiściram | tadardhakaṃ ṣaṇmāsam | prāgvat dvitīyā ṣaṇmāsenetyarthaḥ āḍhayaḥ dhanadhānyādibhirityarthaḥ ciñcāphalarasopetairjalairdveṣāya tarpayet kevaloṣṇodakaistasya tīvrajvarasamudbhavaḥ jāyate'nyonyavairasyaṃ tena te nāśamāpnuyuḥ atisārādibhirdoṣairaudaraiḥ kleśamāvahet

yaiḥ kṛtaiḥ siddhayo haste bhavanti bhajanādapi vidyādyavarṇaṃ vilikheddvitīyādīni ṣaṭ kramāt vṛttayorantarā dikṣu likhetkoṇāntarālataḥ evamekādaśavidhaṃ madhye'nyeṣāṃ niveśanāt ślokairvairinigrahatarpaṇamupadiśati | tatra ciñcāphalaṃ tintiḍīphalam 58 || 59 || atisārādibhiḥ raktaśleṣmādibhiḥ pañcakaṃ parameśāni ! śṛṇu tāni yathākram vilikhedabhitaḥ paścādviniyogamathocyate madhye nāmākṣaranyāsabhedāttadbhedakalpanam śeṣāṇi śṛṇu deveśi ! krameṇa viniyogataḥ māraṇaṃ vyādhibhiḥ kleśaṃ kulotsādakaraṃ tathā gavāṃ narāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ vijayaḥ samaradviṣām dyūte ca rakṣānagaragrāmamaṅgalake tathā ekādaśa syustaiḥ prāgvat svarayogānmaheśvari proktayantreṣu vilikhedekādaśavibhāgataḥ ṣoḍaśānāṃ ca yantrāṇāṃ viniyogamathocyate pañcapañcāśadyantrāṇi ekaikaṃ saptaviṃśatividhaphalapradāni iti tenaiva tāsāmārttiṃ ca śamayetsekadhāraṇaiḥ tanmayīṃ(tatsthāṃ ca ) bhāvayetkanyāṃ dhūpaiḥ sarjjarasairdahet pṛcchetsvavāñchitānarthānācaṣṭe sā'tmanaḥ sadā tāsāmavasthāmanyaiśca śamayedasya dhāraṇāt likhettena jayedvāde prativādinamantarā stabdhajihvo nirudyogaḥ śuṣkāsyo lolalocanaḥ devatāviṣṭāṃ kanyakām | ācaṣṭe sā devatā'viṣṭakanyaketiśeṣaḥ patedvā pādayoḥ kṣipraṃ jito'smīti tvayā vadan

karpaṭe kharpare vāpi sthāpitenoṣṇabhūtale roṣaṃ gatiṃ matiṃ jihvāṃ samaraṃ sarvameva ca baliṃ dadyāttu tadyonyā tannakṣatroktayā punaḥ bhītā na tanmukhā jātu ghaṭate yantravaibhavāt likhitena puroktena sthāpitena puraṃ ripoḥ teṣu teṣu prayogeṣu kuryādrakṣāmathātmanaḥ navamena ca kurvīta rakṣāṃ rāṣṭrapurālaye piṣṭaharidrārasenetyarthaḥ | karpaṭe vastre | kharpare mṛṇmaye kapāle ripuṃ jñātvetiśeṣaḥ | idaṃ tṛtīyayantram || 84 || ghaṭate ceṣṭate abhiṣekāditaḥ madhye ca sthāpayedyantraṃ tāmrapaṭṭeṣu kalpitam svarāṣṭre nagare rājagṛhe proktakramāt khanet praveṣṭumatrāśaktāste nāśayanti prayojakam raṇaṃ vīraḥ praviśyāśu nāśayed drāvayecca tat karpaṭe sthāpitaṃ śīghraṃ śamayedbhabhṛtāṃ raṇam bhūrjapatrapuṭe samyak sarvarakṣā bhavennṛṇām tālaliptena kuḍyāntaḥ sthāpitenārcitena ca rājato vairito bādhādanyakṣudrāditastathā bhṛtena kāminīnāṃ tu saubhāgyamatulaṃ bhavet syuriti | prayojakaṃ prayoktāraṃ vairipakṣasthaṃ tatpratibalamityarthaḥ vandhyāpi labhate putraṃ guṇāḍhyaṃ dīrghajīvinam sapatnīṣvapi kāntena bhartuḥ sā'tyantavallabhā rakṣā bhavati martyānāṃ rājacauragrahāditaḥ asyā niṣphālanātcitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam iti śrīṣoḍaśanityātantreṣu śrīkādimate navamaṃ paṭalam

vairita ityādāvapi | kṣudrāditaḥ vairikṛtakṣudraprayogāditaḥ || 96 || 97 devatāgaṇaviśeṣāḥ | ādiśabdaḥ śatrukṛtakṣudraprayogādiviṣayaḥ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe ! kathayāmi yathāvidhi pūjākramaṃ ca yantrāṇi tathaiva ripunigraham rakṣāṃ puragajāśvānāṃ rāja(jya)rakṣāṃ ca vai kramāt randhrājñāmukhakaṇṭheṣu hṛnnābhyācārapaddvaye tataḥ śaktīrāvṛtisthā dhyānaṃ ca śṛṇu pārvati ! sādhyanakṣatravṛkṣādikīlakasthāpanena vairinigrahaviśeṣān (t) || 1 || 2 upariṣṭādvakṣyamāṇamātṛkānyāsapuraḥsaramityarthaḥ tadantaraṣṭapatreṣu vijayāṃ vimalāṃ subhām tadantaraṣṭakoṇeṣu kamalāṃ kāminīṃ tathā kalyāṇīṃ kālakolāṃ ca pūjayeduktayogataḥ sākinīṃ lākinīṃ ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu parito'rcayet aṣṭakoṇāntarāleṣu pūjayedāyudhāṣṭakam tadantaraṣṭapatrābjaṃ vṛttayugmamathāntarā ṝtadigādi || 9 tadantastādṛśaṃ kuryāt ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vā tu vigraham bheruṇḍāṃ pañcamīṃ nityāmuktaśaktibhirāvṛtām baliṃ ca ṣoḍaśārṇena dadyādādyantayoḥ kramāt tadāvṛttisthaśaktīnāṃ krameṇa śṛṇu pārvati cārusmitāñcitamukhīṃ divyālaṅkārabhūṣitām devīmuktakrameṇa pūjayediti dbalidravyaṃ mudrāsahitam rasanānūpurormyādibhūṣaṇairatisundarīm

karairdadhānāmāsīnāṃ pūjāyāmanyadā sthitām pūjayettadvadabhitaḥ smitasaumyamukhaḥ sadā balimādyantayordadyāt pūrvoktavidhinā yutam taddaśāṃśaṃ hunedagnau trimadhvaktaiḥ kuśeśayaiḥ arcayennityaśo devīṃ sahasraṃ prajapedapi anyathā niṣphalaṃ bhūyāt pratyutainaṃ nihanti ca dakṣiṇādhohastāntaṃ vāmādidakṣiṇakrameṇāyudhāni kalpayet || 15 17 || anyadā prayogeṣu || 18 || tadvat pūrvoktavat atra vyañjanādikaṃ kathayati 21 || 22 || pratyuta na kevalaṃ naiṣphalyaṃ svavināśamapītyarthaḥ nigrahārthamathānyaistu tribhirantyadvayena ca dvitīyārṇaṃ sādhyayutaṃ koṇeṣvanyatrayaṃ likhet vṛttayorantarā sādhyasametaiḥ pavanārṇakaiḥ śmaśāne sthāpayettatra lagne vidveṣaṇaṃ bhavet pṛṣadākhutvaci ca vatatsahasradvayajāyata (?) samālikhya svasaṃjñāṃ tu pūrvasminnuttare ripoḥ antyadvayena ca śāntikaṃ kuryāditi śeṣaḥ dvitīyatṛtīyacaturthaṣaṣṭhākṣarāṇi catvāri | tatra aṣṭamalagnodaye vidveṣaṇaprayogakathanam japitvā proktasaṅkhyaṃ ca jayettaṃ prativādinam niruttaraḥ palāyeta jito'smīti vadettu vā vilikhedvā(da)ravijaye(dyu) yuktamuktameṇa vai proktakāle khaneduktakramapūjājapānvitaḥ nṛcarmaṇi ca tadraktalikhitaṃ tachmaśānake māsena yāti vairī tu dāhajvarayuto yamam

sādhyarkṣayonestvacitanmadhūcchiṣṭena pīḍitam proktakālasamopetaṃ nāśayetsalile ripum vai vādavijaye stambhanaproktapārthivadaśākṣarairveṣṭayet || 32 || 33 uktakālataḥ prāgvadaṣṭame rāśāvityarthaḥ likhitaṃ gotvaci kṣiptaṃ cullyāmupari vahninā tṛtīyena tu madhyena veṣṭitairitarairapi gardabhatvaci tat khātvā kuṇḍamadhye tadūrdhvataḥ kadrutailaplutairhomānmatto'rirmriyate dhruvam kharasnāyubhirābaddhaṃ khātaṃ vairipure niśi kākolūkabakaśyenakaṅkatittiripādayoḥ khanenmaṅgalavāre tu proktakāle catuṣpathe tānyeva tattaccarmasthaṃ tadālayabhuvi sthitam saptāhāttadva(dbha)yānmāsā (?) niyataṃ yantravaibhavāt yantranirmāṇaṃ sukaram tanmantravarṇairyantrasthaiścintāmantrārthavaibhavāt likhitvā'ṣṭasu patreṣu catuṣkaṃ taddvirālikhet prāguktaireva tairdravyaiḥ saṃpūjya viniyogataḥ vijayaṃ samare rājñāṃ śṛṇu vairivināśataḥ tena mantrākṣarāṇi syuḥ saṅkhyayā ca śataṃ punaḥ prāguktopadravaśāntikārīṇīti apunaruktākṣarayojanaṃ nātra vivakṣitam || 50 || 51 tena tāvanti koṣṭhāni sambhavanti samantataḥ akṣarāṇi śivādyantu nir-ṛtyantamanukramāt bahiraṣṭasu koṇeṣu dvitīyārṇādi sa/llikhet tānyeva mātṛkākhyābhirvidarbhitamatho nyaset

darśayettena ripavaḥ palāyante diśo daśa tadeva vairiśibire nikhanedudaye śaneḥ tadeva svapure madhye sthāpayeddhiṣaṇodaye saṃspṛśanti purāntasthādyantraśaktyanubhāvataḥ sthāpayet sādhyabhūbharturekādaśasamudyame antaḥpure nagaryāstu dikṣu madhye ca tat khanet kārayettena tat sarvaṃ śaśvataṃ vṛddhaye bhavet madhye daleṣu parito likhedekaikaśaḥ kramāt svajanmarkṣādinavake kuryācchāntimanukramāt rogato vairito vā'pi tasmin tattena śāmayet vṛddhaye vṛddhyai bhavedityarthaḥ rakṣāṃ kurvīta sarveṣāṃ sarvāpattāraṇāya vai grahajaṃ vairijaṃ duḥkhaṃ śāmyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ tasmātattadgrahakleśaṃ tattadyantraṃ (na) (ca) śāmayet vividhāni viṣāṇyebhiryantrairjalanive(śitaiḥ) śanaiḥ ebhistu navabhiryantrairya(ttat)nna sādhyaṃ na kutracit prathamaṃ madhyataḥ khātvā prāgādiṣu tato'ṣṭasu dharmārthau cātisaṃvṛddhau bhavetāmuktayogataḥ dhārmikāstena tatrasthāḥ prasīdanti ca devatāḥ putrajñānadhaiścāḍhyāḥ prabhavanti ca nityaśaḥ dhyānairmṛto'pi māhātmyānmantrasyottiṣṭhate dhruvam vilikhya devīṃ tatrasthāṃ navākārāṃ navasvapi prāguktaparivārādirahitāṃ pūjayannapi strībālavṛddhāśaktānāṃ gatireṣā ca (sva) siddhaye nirviṣo jāyate'cintyā mantrāṇāṃ śaktayaḥ śive !

na kadācittu sā proktā tāṃ me brūhi maheśvara ! vyāptarūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvamidamadbhutam bhajantyenaṃ yathā māṃ tvaṃ tatprayogabalāddhruvam pratyekaṃ puṭitān kṛtvā mantrānvidyā athāpi ca (vā) proktaṃ tadyantranavakaṃ kumbhe saṃsthāpya caitayā sugamaḥ || 64 || 65 || 66 || 67 || 68 || 69 || 70 || 71 || 72 || 73 || 74 || 75 || 76 || 77 sugamaḥ kucandanairgairikairvā daradaiścandanestathā navānāṃ navabhiḥ kuryādebhiryantraprakalpanam rakṣottarākṣayorjanmatritaye varṣayoḥ kramāt anyovāśa(bha)ktiśīlāḍhyaḥ kārayedabhiṣecanam vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yadi kurvīta lobhataḥ tasmātsarvatra tantre'smin vittaśāṭhyaṃ na cintayet somasūryāgnirūpeṇa jalenepsitamantrataḥ yathākramaṃ nava copadiśati | tatra etayā trailokyamohanīvidyayā || 85 navānāṃ yantraprakalpanamiti svātantryāt durlakṣaṇasamutthāni tathā duṣkarmajāni ca nāśayettatkṣaṇāddevī salilairiva pāvakaḥ labhate ca bahūn putrān sukhī ca ciramedhate yobhṛśaṃ nityadā vidyāt kliṣṭaḥ so'pi śriyaidhate anītyā vairivihitairabhicārādibhistu vā kāntilakṣmīdhanārogyavidyāvijayakīrtibhiḥ navābhiṣekaṃ navasu prokteṣu vidhinā caran jīvanmuktaściraṃ yogī bhuvi jīvati manmathaḥ asyā niṣphālanāt citte tattatvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam

manmayaḥ śivātmā p. 191) iti śrī ṣoḍaśanityātantreṣu śrīkādimate daśamaṃ paṭalam paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam sā vidyā vahnivāsinyāḥ kathitā te navākṣarā tatsādhanavidhiṃ tasyāḥ prayogānvividhānapi vidyādvitīyabījena svarān dīrghānniyojayet navākṣarāṇi vidyāyā navarandhreṣu vinyaset sarvāsvapi ca vidyāsu vyāpakaṃ tat samācaret tasyācireṇa devānāṃ prasādāt sambhavanti ca tṛtīye paṭale | anyat sugamam || 1 sarvāsāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvā paścāttatroditaṃ nyaset tena tasyāstu lipiśo nyāsannaiva(?) samīritam cārusmeramukhāmbhojāṃ visalannayanatrayām padmarāgakirīṭāṃśusambhedāruṇitāmbarām ratnamauktikasaṃbhinnastabakābharaṇojjvalām dadhānāṃ bāhubhirvāmaiḥ kahlāraṃ hemaśṛṅgakam svasamānābhirabhitaḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritām jvālinīvisphuliṅginyau maṅgalā sumanoharā navākṣarāṇi dakṣiṇapūrvaṃ nyaset | vyāpakaṃ prāgvat || 3 || 4 || 5 pañcadaśe kulasundarīpaṭale vakṣyamāṇatvādiha na vyākaromi || 7 ūrddhvādivāmadakṣiṇayoḥ kalpayet || 9 || 10 || 11 || 12 a.qṭakoṇeṣu sampūjyāstadagrāttu(tsu) pradakṣiṇam meṣāṃ vṛṣāhvayāṃ śaktiṃ mithunāṃ karkaṭīmapi kumbhāṃ mīnāṃ yajetprāgvadagrādārabhya śāṅkari anyayośca diśoḥ śaktīḥ proktā daśa samarcayet

ghasmarā sarvabhakṣā ca viśvāsā vividhodbhavā acintyavaibhavā raktā daśamī parikīrtitā yatra noktā devatā tu balikarmaṇi tatra tām vṛttayornavayoniṃ tu kṛtvā tadbahirambujam tadbahiścaturasre dve dvāradvayasamanvite tatra kīṭaṃ vṛścikamityarthaḥ || 14 || 15 || 16 || 17 || koṇadikṣu vāyavyādiṣu || 18 || māyā hṛllekhā || 19 || 20 || 21 || saptākṣaryā kurukullādyavidyayā || anukteṣvaṅgamūlābhyāmarghyaṃ saṃsādhayettathā saṅkhyānuktau sahasraṃ syācchataṃ vā tantracoditam vidyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ tadvattantre'smin parameśvari kāmyahomavidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu vāñchitadāyakam samānavarṇavatsāyā raktāyā gopaya (?) stathā ghṛtena siktaṃ sikthaṃ tu kṛtvā tatsasitaṃ kare evaṃ homo mahālakṣmīmāvahetpratipatkṛtaḥ pañcamyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa prāgv`ddholaṃ samācaret pūrvāparaproktāṅgīkāreṇa śarkarāsahitam || 27 || 28 || 29 annājyābhyāṃ tu niyataṃ hutvānnādyobhavennaraḥ ghṛtahomādavāpnoti tathaiva tilataṇḍulaiḥ pratipattithimārabhya pañcadaśyantamambike yatastena svasvatithau tāstā pūjyā hutādibhiḥ tenāyuḥśrīdhanārogyavidyākīrtisamanvitaḥ yattithau yā samākhyātā sutā samamavāpnuyāt samprāpya japahomārcāyogatarpaṇasekataḥ vastūni avāpnotītyanvayaḥ || 33 || vratī bhavet svasaṅkalpasahitaḥ

ekaikavigrahāḥ ekaikatithirūpāḥ | vratasaṅkalpaḥ prāgvat || 35 vidyāprāptividhiṃ deva brūhi samyak mamādhunā śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te devi vidyāprāptividhiṃ śubham tadbhāvamāyayoraikyarūpamānandavigraham kucandanaiḥ kuṅkumairvā sindūrairgairikaiḥ śubhaiḥ yasyā yaccakramāravyātaṃ nityapūjāvidhikrame proktakramasamopetaṃ pūrvedyurgītanṛtyakau tattithau prāṅmukhaṃ śiṣṭamuktalakṣaṇasaṃyutam tajjalaṃ prāgudaṅmadhyadikṣugaṃ sarvasiddhidam vahnidāhaṃ mṛtiṃ rogaṃ dāridryaṃ deśamocanam tato'sau paridhāyāsu śubhreśuddhe ca vāsasī abhyarcya pādayornāthaṃ pañcaślokaiḥ stuvaṃstriśaḥ tatogurustamāhūya cakramdhye niveśya ca proktakrameṇa tāṃ devīṃ vidyārūpāṃ mahādyutim saṃsthāpya proktarūpāṃ tāṃ dhyātvā'bhyarcya vadenmanum tatastatraiva tāṃ vidyāṃ śataṃ japyāttadātmavān praṇamya trirupāsīta mūrddhabaddhāñjaliḥ stuvan ādiśeddeśikastasmāddinādārabhya so'pi tām evaṃ pañcadaśānāṃ ca nityānāṃ krama īritaḥ tāsāṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ lalitoktavidhānataḥ pūrṇābhiṣekaśca tattannityasaparyācakreṇa āsāmanyonyamaṅgāni pūjāsu parameśvari anyadā proktarūpāstāstatratatrārcane matāḥ evaṃ sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ sādhāraṇavidhānakam śṛṇu devi viśeṣantu sandarbhaṃ vai same'pi vā

tvaddaivatyāḥ smṛtā vidyā maddaivatyāstu mantrakāḥ vidyākṣareṣvanāvṛttānyakṣarāṇyaṣṭa taistathā vidhāya vṛttayormadhye tvaṣṭakoṇe tatodvayam || 59 || tatpaṭaloditaṃ dhyānapaṭaloditam | evaṃ ukta prakāreṇa maddaivatyāḥ pundaivatyāḥ || 61 māyāṃ nāmānvitāṃ kṛtvā tāṃ tāreṇa praveṣṭayet karmānurūpān pañcāśallikheduktakrameṇa vai evaṃ ṣoḍaśa yantrāṇi jāyante tairyathākramam prathamaṃ kharpare raktavahnimūlena saṃyutam likhitvā khadirāṅgāre tāpayenniśi jāpavān taddevatena tāmre vā vā kāṃsyo vā prāgvadālikhet tairmanīṣitaṃ sādhayediti dvitīyaṃ kharpare tena vilikhya niśi tāpayet tṛtīyaṃ tena tatraiva likhitvā niśi tāpayet tadeva dampatī dagdhavahnyāgāraṃ tu nimbaje śmaśāne vairiṇāṃ proktakāle kruddhāśayo japet caturthaṃ vilikhetkṛṣṇapaṭṭacīre'sitāmbare dāhajvareṇa saptāhādripuryāti yamālayam kālolūkajapakṣotthalekhalyā kharparadvaye nadyāṃtu vāriṇā pūrṇā yāṃ dveṣāsyāttayormithaḥ śiraḥkapāle niḥkṣipya śmaśāne nikhanenniśi aṣṭamaṃ kharpare kṛtvā ripudvāre khanenniśi navamaṃ hemni kṛtvā tadūrmikāyāṃ vare dine kṛtyāpamṛtyurogādiduḥkhebhyomucyate naraḥ nidhāya pūjayedveśmanyaśmapātādiśāntaye

ekādaśe likhedbhūrje pāṭīrendudravaistu tat sitasikthamaye liṅge saṃsthāpyābhyarcya tat punaḥ sandhyāsu susitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ saurabhādyairvidhānataḥ amlasauvīramadhyasthe vidveṣayati vairiṇau śuṇṭhīmarīcapippalyaḥ susūkṣmāḥ paricūrṇitāḥ dvādaśaṃ kharpare rātrirasenālikhya tatpunaḥ sthāpayeccaṇḍikāgehe śāsturāyatane'pi vā stambhayedvairiṇoroṣamudyogaṃ vā'tha cintanam trayodaśena bhūrjasthenāśu dhāraṇato'ṅganā caturdaśagataṃ nāma kṛtvā bhūrje catuṣpathe saptāhādvaśamāyānti striyo vā puruṣā nṛpāḥ pareṇa nāmnā yuktena phalakālikhitena vai amlasauvīre || 89 || 90 || rātrirasena haridrārasena || 91 || 92 || 93 || 94 || 95 ṣoḍaśe nāma saṃlikhya dhāraṇātprāṇināṃ tathā tadeva svarṇapaṭṭasthaṃ vidhāya vidhinā yutam ādhivyādhivinirmuktoniḥsapatnojitendriyaḥ yonitattvamayī vyāptiritisamyaksamīritā ekādaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇam pīḍā | atra dvādaśatamaḥ ślokaḥ ṣaṭcaraṇāgāthā ekādaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam catuḥṣaṣṭiritiprekṣya proktamekādaśe'khilam tasyā vidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvārthasādhakam tadaṅgāni lipinyāsaṃ dhyānaṃ śaktibhirarcanam proktakrameṇa sakalaṃ kathayāmi yathāvidhi māyayā puṭitaṃ kṛtvā kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭkramāt

dṛkśrotranāsāvāgvakṣonābhiguhyeṣu ca kramāt caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām tatra prāgeva tṛtīyapaṭale || 1 || 2 nāma mehanam || 4 dadhānāṃ bāhubhirnetraiḥ dayā (para) damasuśītalaiḥ cakramadhye sukhāsīnāṃ smeravaktrasaroruhām siṃhāsane'bhitaḥ preṅkhatprotasthābhiḥ svaśaktibhiḥ kurvāṇāmaruṇāmbhodhau cintaye (dvajra)nmantranāyikām ḍākinyādyāḥ ṣaḍasrasthāḥ padmadvādaśapatragāḥ nirañjanā rāgavatī tathaiva madanāvatī tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrasthāḥ śaktīrākarṇayāmbike kirātāṃ kālakadane kauśikāṃ kambuvāhinīm sukhāsīnāṃ tāṃ cintayediti || 8 || 9 || aruṇāmbhodhau śoṇāmbhodhau parivāraśaktīrupadiśati tatra ṣaḍasrasthāḥ nair-ṝtyādikrameṇa caturasrasthitāṃ cāpi śaktīrākarṇaya kramāt ratiḥ śraddhā bogalobhamadonmatte manasvinī dvādaśaitā mahādevi caturasre'bhitojapet śoṇābdhiṃ hemapotaṃ ca siṃhāsanamanāntaram māyāsaptākṣarīmadhyaṃgatairnāmabhirarcayet devyāstu kurukullāyā homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi prāgvat samāpayeditthamarcanaṃ te samīritam prādakṣiṇyenārcayet | sarvatrāvaraṇeṣu agrātprādakṣiṇyena pūjayet agnisomasūryātmakabhāvanādiyutam | śoṇābdhiḥ śoṇasāgaraḥ tejorūpayā svātmayojanāditi haviṣyāṣī payobhakṣaḥ phalamūlāśano'tha vā

candracandanakāśmīracarcālohitavigrahaḥ mukhārpitenduśakalo hṛṣṭacetā jitendriyaḥ naktāśī hutaśiṣṭena japedvidyāṃ samāhitaḥ trayādahīnā madhuraṃ pāyasaṃ bhojyabhaktimān gurujīvaṃ samāsādya praṇamyā'sakṛdātmavān kṛtārambho nityaśaśca pūjayettaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ vittaśāṭyaṃ ca darpaṃ ca dambhaṃ cāsatyameva ca evaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā taddaśāṃśaṃ hunet ghṛtaiḥ haviṣyāśo nirlavaṇapakkavrīhitaṇḍulāhārī || 22 || 23 madhūkajaiścampakairvā trimadhvaktaiśca nityaśaḥ tarpayet salilaistāvaddinaśobhaktimān dṛḍhaḥ gurubhaktonityakṛtyakṛtasaṅkalpasaṃyutaḥ yaḥ so'pi kāmyān kurvīta prayogānnānyathā śive anarthān kleśanāśādi pīḍāṃ prāpnoti niścitam maṇḍalāllabhate lakṣmīṃ mahatīṃ ślāghyavigraham(hām) juhuyānnityaśobhaktyā sahasraṃ vikacaiḥ śubhaiḥ tāvacca japyāddhomānte yāvatsaṅkhyāhutaṃ kṛtam || 32 || evaṃ uktaprakāreṇa labhate svarṇaniṣkāṇāṃ śataṃ māsena pūrvavat darśādisāsā/llabhate citrāṇi vasanāni ca vastūni labhate hṛdyairanyairbhogopa(bho)yogibhiḥ tena śālisamṛddhiḥ syāt māsaiḥ ṣaḍbhirasaṃśayam svajanmasu triṣu tathā dūrvābhirjuhayāttathā guḍūcītiladūrvābhistriṣu janmasu vā hunet ghṛtapāyasadugdhaistu hutaisteṣu triṣu kramāt

saptamyāṃ kadalīhomāt saubhāgyaṃ labhate vṛtaḥ nānāvidhaphalāvāptimupadiśati | tatra maṇḍalān prāgvat juhuyāddinaśoghore sannipātajvare gade tribhirvā nityaśohomaṃ kuryāttrisvādusaṃyutaiḥ taddineṣu japedvidyāṃ nityaśaḥ salilaṃ spṛśat pākādyamapi taireva kuryādrogavimuktaye piṣṭaṃ ca sādhyapādottha rajasā ca samanvitam prāgvacchittvā'yasaistīkṣṇaiḥ śastraiḥ puttalikāṃ hunet sādhyo vaśo bhavecchīghramapi dūrasthito dṛḍhaḥ uparyagni nidhāyātra vidyayā dinaśo(vaṃ) hunet pakṣāntare triṣu janmasvitiśeṣaḥ | kramāt yathākramam || 45 śatayojanadūrādapyānayedvanitāṃ balāt kṛtaprāṇapratiṣṭāṃ ca śmaśāne nikhanenniśi kṛtābhiṣekastāṃ vidyāṃ prajapecca śatatrayam rogairbhūtādisaṃkleśairnāśameti suniścitam kleśaistaiḥ sa vinirmuktaḥ sukhī jīvati bhūtale toyamadhye nidhāyaitatkvāthayeduktavāsaraiḥ tāmeva caṇḍikāgehe tathā baliyutaṃ khanet tadvidhānena sahitaṃ śatrurunmādavān bhavet sādhyarkṣavṛkṣacūrṇādibhiḥ samuditaiḥ || 52 || 53 || 54 tathā baliyutaṃ sādhyayonibaliyutam prayogānapi vakṣyāmi samāhitadhiyā śṛṇu tena koṣṭhāni jāyante tvekaṣaṣṭyā śatatrayam catvāriṃśattatra śeṣaṃ vajrākāraṃ yathā bhavet kuryāccheṣāṇi koṣṭhāni pañcaṣaṣṭyā śataṃ bhavet

prāgvatsvaravibhinnāni prāguktavidhinā tathā(taḥ) ekaviṃśatikoṣṭhāni śiṣṭāni punarambike aṣṭamarāśyādi ghaṭikāyugavarṇau ca likhet prāguktayogataḥ sādhyākhyamālikheduktakrameṇa puṭayordvayoḥ dvitrikrameṇa prākpratyakkoṇayostu trayaṃ trayam spṛśan japenmanuṃ paścāttrisahasraṃ tatastu tat(tam) bhūtākṣarāṇi ca punarlikhetkāryānurūpataḥ vijayastambhavidveṣavaśyoccāṭanakarmasu deśarāṣṭrapuragrāmaniveśāderviśeṣataḥ madhye devīṃ samāvāhya pūjayennityaśaḥ śivām kuryāt trirātraṃ dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ kāmyarūpataḥ vibhave maṇḍape tasya proktavajaṃ likhenmahat nṛtyagītādibhīḥ sārddhaṃ sandhyāsu ca viśeṣataḥ vairināśena vā tasya bhaṅgādvyasanato'pi vā pratīyā(parīyā)ddeśikaṃ tvagre gaje jivecciraṃ sukhī(m) evametasya vajrasya vaibhavaṃ konu varṇayet māsādibhiḥ | gaje sthāpayitveti śeṣaḥ || 80 yena hastagatena syuḥ siddhayo'pi svahastagāḥ tenaikāśītikoṣṭhāni jāyante ta(cca)dapūrvavat trikoṇāni caturdikṣu teṣu tā(nyeva)vacca pūrvavat ekasminmadhyame śaktiḥ jaṭhare sādhyamālikhet na bhedastvanayorasti prayogeṣu tu sarvataḥ daśake hṛdaye śīrṣe saṃsthāpya samare kṛte akṣatārogasarvāṅgo yaśolakṣmīdhanānvitaḥ

etattāmratale kṛtvā sthāpayedabhivṛddhaye bāhye kṛtvā ca vidyāyā bījamādyamathāntim ekaikaṃ pārśvakoṇeṣu dve dve vṛttāntarā punaḥ madhyabījasya madhyasthaṃ likhettaṃ nijavāñchitam kaṇṭhe vā dhārayetsadyo vallabhā tasya jāyate vṛttāṣṭapatrayuktāni ṣoḍaśāni manoharam tatphalāni copadiśati | tatra daṃśakaḥ kavacaḥ | anyat sugamam || 87 || 88 rephāṃśena kuryāt, anyatra caturthasvarāṃśena kuryāt || 91 || 92 || 93 karṇikārṇasya madhyasthaṃ kuryānnāma nijepsitam ahorātraṃ ṣoḍaśadhā kṛtvā tāṃ teṣu yojayet dhārayedabhiṣiñcecca ja(yurja)pediṣṭārthasiddhaye koṣṭhāni ṣoḍaśāni syusteṣu padmāni kārayet devīṃ tu sthāpayedbhūmau sarvasampadavāptaye asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam prāgvadvilikhya pūjanācca prāguktā siddhiriti || 95 || 96 || 97 || 98 || 99 paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam dvādaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājña samīhitaphalapradam tadāvaraṇaśaktiśca taddhyānaṃ tatprapūjanam prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidyāṃ ca tadvidhānaṃ ca tatphalam yairmantrairbhuvane khyāto nigrahānugrahakṣamaḥ tenaiva puṭitairarṇairnyasecchrotrādipañcasu prāgvadarghyaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ tacchaktī śṛṇu pārvati nyasedityarthaḥ vinodā kautukā puṇyā purāṇā caturasragāḥ

vīrā vighnaharā vidyetyuktā yantrāṣṭaśaktayaḥ samayā sarvagā siddhetyuktā aṣṭāsraśaktayaḥ mūladevīsamākāravarṇāyudhasamanvitāḥ nādāṃ manomayīṃ ṣaṭsu patreṣu parito'rcayet madhye devīṃ hetivṛttāṃ pūjayedaṣṭamīṃ śivām tathāpi bhaktasantrāṇahetoḥ kḷptāṃ parāṃ tanum dvitīyākṣarādināmaśaktayaḥ | tyaivigrahavatī tyaivigrahetyarthaḥ prādakṣiṇyena navaratnakirīṭāṃ ca trīkṣaṇāmaruṇāmbarām śucismitāmaṣṭabhujāṃ stūyamānāṃ maharṣibhiḥ dakṣiṇairaṅkuṣaṃ khaḍgaṃ kuṭhāraṃ kamalaṃ tathā dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ dūtīṃ durnītināśinīm tathā ṣaḍasramaṣṭāsraṃ tadvadaṣṭadalāmbujam āvāhyābhyarcya tāḥ śaktīḥ prāguktavidhinā sthitāḥ sādhanaṃ coktamārgeṇa kuryāllakṣamatandritaḥ yenāsau vāñchitaṃ kṣipramavāpnoti suniścitam durnītināśinīṃ samyak vivekapradānāt || 13 || 14 || 15 || 16 nālikeraphalopetairguḍairlakṣmīmavāpnuyāt trimadhvaktaiścampakaiśca prasūnairbakulodbhavaiḥ punnāgajairhutairvastrāṇyājairiṣṭamatāpnuyāt avāpnoti hutaiḥ sājyai ratnai ratnaṃ ca sādhakaḥ hṛddeśanyastanāmārṇāṃ pacettailājyayorniśi saptarātraprayogena naro nārī nṛpo'tha vā hayāripuṣpairaruṇaiḥ sitairvā juhuyāttathā chāgamāṃsaṃ trimadhvaktairhomātsvarṇamavāpnuyāt

yugānurūpamakṣaratrilakṣādikaṃ prāgvat tailājyayormiśrībhūtayoritiśeṣaḥ || 26 || anaśnan annamitiśeṣaḥ padmākṣairhavanāllakṣmīmavāpnoti tribhirdinaiḥ śṛṇu teṣu vidhānāni samāhitamanāṃ śive taiḥ ṣoḍaśasvarayutaiḥ ṣaṣṭyāśatamudīritaiḥ tadantaraṣṭakoṇaṃ ca tadantarvṛttayugmakam vṛttayorantarāśeṣaṃ bahiḥ koṇeṣu cāṣṭasu karmānurūpān bhūtārṇān daśabhūpuramadhyataḥ antyaṃ caturṣu koṇeṣu śeṣāṇāṃ ca vilekhane chāgamāṃsairityanvayaḥ | chāgomeṣaḥ || 29 evaṃ yantrāṇi jāyante daśasiddhyā spadāni vai saptamyāṃ triṣu sandhyāsu sitāpūpasamanvitam dadhibhaktantu sāyantu kṣīraṃ mocāphalaṃ tathā vāñcchitaṃ prāpnuyāddevyāḥ prasādenālpayatnataḥ supakvaṃ chāgamāṃsena kṣaudramannaṃ nivedayet tathaiva vanitāṃ hṛdyāṃ vaśayedyāvadāyuṣaḥ tāvaddinaṃ tathā'bhyarcya vaśayeddvividhān ripūn daśa susamā(nā)nīti || 31 || 32 || 33 || 34 || 35 || 36 saptāhādāpadaḥ sarvāḥ prayāntyasyāḥ prasādataḥ kevalaṃ pāyasaṃ mocāṃ sitāṃ ghṛtasamanvitām jitvā sukhī ciraṃ jīveccheṣamāyurnirāmayaḥ kṛtvā tasmai dakṣiṇāṃ ca dadyā(ddravyaṃ)dbhūri svaśaktitaḥ yenāsau toṣamāyāti tāvadvittaṃ samarpayet masṛṇe vā śilāpaṭṭe pīṭhe vā saudhabhūtale pūjayettriṣu sandhyāsu japanvidyāṃ tathā vaśī

mucyante prāṇino'cintyāḥ śaktayo mantrayantrayoḥ sthāpayenmandire tasmilla/kṣmīrāste'tisusthirā navamaṃ hemagaṃ kṛtvā bhūṣādau dhārayecchive yadyaddhi vāñchitaṃ kāryyaṃ tattanmadhyagataṃ tathā taddinaistadavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā sikthanirmitapātrasthakṣaudramadhye niveśya tat sādhyasyābhimukho vidyāṃ japannitthamanusmaran(ret) nyastāñjalikaraṃ śīrṣe dāsohamitivādinam tadeva koṣṇaṃ kṛtvā ca sandhyāsu triṣu nityaśaḥ kulaṃ lajjāṃ vivekaṃ ca parityajyāsya kiṅkarāḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhāvidyāṃ te vakṣye'haṃ śṛṇu pārvati || 49 || annādi pratisandhyaṃ sarvam | japan śataṃ sahasraṃ vā || 50 || 51 tattallikhitākṣaraiḥ | sikthaṃ madhūcchiṣṭam | tat yantramitiśeṣaḥ javī dāhamarudyukto vyomāpi marutā yutam jyāvahniyuktārtho'mbu syāt ṣaṣṭhasaptamakau punaḥ hṛdāhāmbucaraiḥ svena gotrādāhāgnibhiḥ param punarādyatrayaṃ cāmbumaruddyu nabhasā yutam agnirhaṃso marudyukto vyāptaṃ ca marutā yutam haṃsaśca marutā yuktaścatvāriṃśallipirmanuḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhā vidyāṃ prastauti tvagādiṣu ca tānyeva nyasecchaktipuṭasthitam aruṇākalpamukuṭāmaruṇādharapallavām prasūnapiṇḍaṃ pāśaṃ ca dadhānāṃ pāṇiyugmataḥ anantaśaktiyuktābhiḥ pūjayetpadmamadhyataḥ īkāraḥ | haṃsomarudyuktaḥ hā iti | vyāptaṃ ca marutāyutaṃ yā iti

prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantraḥ sthāneṣu hṛdaya eva vā nyasediti sampradāyārthaḥ prāṇādibhiḥ | anantaśaktiyuktābhiḥ pratyekamitiśeṣaḥ || 70 || 71 nāgā kūrmā sakakarā devadattādhanañjayā tadantardaśapatrābjaṃ tadantastaddvayaṃ tathā lakṣaṃ japetpayobhakṣastaddaśāṃśaṃ hunettathā tarpayetsaurabhādyena jalenetthaṃ susādhayet anayā vidyayā sādhya prāṇāṃstatra niyojayet yena puttalikā jīvaspandayuktā manorbalāt koṣṭhānyekonapañcāśajjāyante teṣu vinyaset śiṣṭeṣu madhyanavasu likhedaṅgāditaḥ kramāt tatra pradhānāprāṇaśaktireṣāṃ samaṣṭirūpā | tatra taddvayam vṛttadvayam | anyaccakranirmāṇaṃ sugamam kṛtārghyaḥ prāgvat || 75 || sitaiḥ gauraiḥ sādhyajīvāgamataḥ | vinyaset prāṇapratiṣṭhāvidyākṣarāṇītiśeṣaḥ sañjapya vidyāṃ hastena sajīvena spṛśan śatam sādhyajīvādyānayanaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te'dbhutam jñānakarmendriyāṇyarthān manojīvaṃ tanuṃ tathā raktarajjvāśaktimayyā(dhyā) tānyānīyārpayeddhiyā evaṃ niyojitāṃ vidyāṃ sahasraṃ prajapetspṛśan evaṃ saṃsthāpitaprāṇā puttalī spandate'bdataḥ tajjanmalagnasañjātanavāṃ(ṣṭa)śarkṣapradhānakam teṣu teṣu prayogeṣu vakṣyāmyaparahomake anyāni cāṅgaromāṇi puttalyāṃ yojayenmṛtau evaṃ sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ prāṇākarṣaṇakarma te

tatonirdiṣṭaputtalyāṃ tatra tatroktamācaret uktānāṃ tu na varkṣāṇāṃ tathaivāṣṭakavargakam saṃsthāpya sādhyajīvādyānayanaṃ kuryāditi nakṣatraṇāmitiśeṣaḥ | saca rāśyanvayaḥ homake homapaṭale śeṣaḥ anavekṣya kṛtaṃ karma svātmānaṃ hanti tatkṣaṇāt vadānyaṃ sadayaṃ nityamabhicāre na yojayet abhicārasya viṣayānākarṇaya vadāmi te prajānāṃ ghātakān sarvakleśakarmasu saṃsthitān nindakaṃ samayānāṃ ca piśunaṃ rājaghātakam niyojayenmāraṇeṣu karmasvetairna pātakī pādatovā guruṃ viprānārādhya svena nityayā janmatraye pyabdamātramabhiṣekaṃ samācaret nānyatra viśeṣaṇam | a`hicāre māraṇe, anyat sugamam itiśeṣaḥ || 95 || 96 || 97 etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dūtīnityāvidhānakam asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam haviṣyabhuk haviṣyaṃ nāma nirlavaṇapakvavrīhitaṇḍulānnam || 99 tatpāpaiḥ abhicārakaraṇapāpaiḥ | eṣa sādhakaḥ | 101 trayodaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam sārddhasaptadaśaiva syuḥ paṭale'smi/strayodaśe proktaiva tvaritā vidyā prāgeva dvādaśākṣarā yena mantrī manmathābho vikṣobhayati bhūtalam kuryādaṅgāni yugmārṇaiḥ ṣaṭkrameṇa karāṅgayoḥ

ūrvorjānvorjaṅghayośca pādayośca krameṇa vai tārādyaiḥ śṛṇu taddhyānaṃ tacchaktīstatprapūjanam dvidvikramādaṣṭanāgaiḥ kalpitābharaṇojjvalām ślokadvayena paṭalārthānuddiśati | tatra prāgeva tṛtīyapaṭale vikṣobhayati svātmanā prasiddhiṃ karoti ṣaḍaṅgayojanaṃ ūrujānujaṅghāpādayorekaikam || 3 viprakṣatriyaviṭśūdrajātibhirbhīmavigrahaiḥ valayairbhūṣitabhujāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām guñjāguṇalasadvakṣaḥkucakuṅkumamaṇḍanām pāśāṅkuśavarābhītilasadbhujacatuṣṭayām tadagrasthāṃ ca sphāṭkārīṃ śaracāpakarojjvalām yataḥ sā tvaritetyuktā māyānityā navamyasau varmādi phaḍantān daśasaṅkhyān prokteṣu daśasu sthāneṣu nyasediti cāturvarṇyotpattikrameṇābharaṇakalpanamiti boddhavyam vāmaurddhādidakṣiṇādharahastāntaṃ vāmadakṣiṇakrameṇa dhanurbāṇojjvalakarayugalām kiṅkaraścāgratastasyāḥ pūjyaḥ sarvārthasiddhaye śaktī tatsadṛśe svarṇavetravellatkarāmbuje strīhuṅkāryau kṣemakarī lokapālasamā imāḥ yābhirnityārcitābhiḥ syānnaronārīṣu manmathaḥ prāgvadarghyaṃ vidhāyeśāmaṣṭasiṃhāṅghrike śubhe paścimadvārasaṃyuktaṃ tadantarvṛttayugmakam prāgvadāvāhya paritaḥ śaktibhirveṣṭitāṃ tathā prasāde ābhimukhye | anena ślokena devyā nāmanirvāhaḥ kāmavat svātmadarśanena kṣobhayatītyarthaḥ

sarvādhiṣṭhātrīm | aṣṭasiṃhāṃghrike aṣṭasiṃhapādasahite agrapatrāgrake vṛttamadhye vā'rcyau puroditau svasamānagaṇākīrṇamaṇḍalasthasya bhaktitaḥ śataṃ vā kṛtahomastu pūjāṃ prāgvatsamāpayet bailvairdaśāṃśāṃ juhuyātpatrādyaiḥ sādhane jape phaṇidaṃṣṭrāmṛtānāntu mukhe santāḍya jīvayet santāḍya śīrṣe sahasā mṛtamutthāpayediti kṛtvā yoniṃ kuṇḍamadhye tatrāgnau vidhivaddhunet etaduktaṃ bhavati āvāhya karṇikāmadhye iti śeṣaḥ yugānurūpamakṣaralakṣasaṅkhyāke daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādityanvayaḥ trimadhvaktairekaśovā sametairvā samṛddhaye kairavairmallikākundamadhukairindirāptaye navairnīlotpalairaśvaripujaiḥ karṇikārajaiḥ yadyaddhi vāñchitaṃ sarvamavāpnoti suniścitam sitārkaṃ plakṣajaṃ hutvā rogānmuktonaro'cirāt acalāṃ labhate lakṣmīṃ bhoktā ca bhavati dhruvam ekaikairvanitā vaśyā yāvajjīvaṃ dhanādibhiḥ tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ kṣīrāktaistairhutairmartyā vaśe tiṣṭhantyaśeṣataḥ tadaktairvairiyonyutthamāṃsairapi ca tatkṛte āruṣkaraghṛtopetaṃ phaṇiśīrṣasru cā hunet niśāmadhye hunetsadyo nihantuṃ vairiṇaṃ haṭhāt saptarātrādarātestu gajāśvā rogamāpnuyuḥ saptāhādrogaduḥkhārtaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ tathāpi daddiśā kiñcidvarṇyate tacchṛṇu priye
