śatrunakṣatrayonimāṃsaiḥ | tatkṛte vairimṛtyave tāni sarvāṇi deveśi ! kuru citte krameṇa vai tadagrāṇyabhitaḥ kuryāttiśikhānyasya madhyage prādakṣiṇyapraveśena dvādaśāvṛtti māyayā śriyai kīrtyai ca vaśyāya saubhāgyāyākhilāptaye naranārīnṛpādīnāṃ vaśyāya bibhṛyācca tat jāyante ca catuḥṣaṣṭikoṣṭhāni parameśvari ! vaibhavam | diśā ekadeśena | tatvaibhavaṃ sṛṇvityanvayaḥ sarvamadhyasthe koṣṭhe || 41 || 42 || māyayā hṛllekhayā sārddhamitiśeṣaḥ || dvādaśakṛtvaḥ samālikhya proktakrameṇa vibhṛyāditi || 44 bahistūrṇākṣarairante vaṣaḍyuktaistu (pūjayet) veṣṭayet sarvatobhadravinyāsānuṣṭubhaṃ sarvasiddhidam nabhaśca marutopetaṃ vyāptaṃ tena samanvitam dvitīyādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ syādbhuvā śūnyaṃ dvitīyakam pratilomaṃ tathaiteṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ caraṇaṃ bhavet tvaritākṣarairveṣṭayediti || 46 marudyutā prāgvadetatpratilomaṃ tṛtīyakam etaccaturthaṃ caraṇaṃ śrīvidyāyāṃ maheśvari yatra sthitā'sau cakrasthā na tatrāśubhasaṅkathā pādobhavedityarthaḥ | tṛtīyakaṃ caraṇamitiśeṣaḥ | pāda-ityarthaḥ jyādharāsvairmāyayā hṛttato'mbu sparśagā ilā prāgvattūrṇāmṛtārṇaistairveṣṭayedvṛddhiyojitaiḥ vṛttadvayena niṣpādya kumbhaṃ padmādharottaram sthāpayejjapasaṃsiddhiṃ teṣu pūrvoditeṣu vai caturthapādaśca dṛśyata iti | asau śrīvidyetiśeṣaḥ

gajāścā paśavastvanye prāṇinaḥ mukhino'niśam alakṣmīśāntaye vaśyasiddhaye sarvasampade svalpenaiva tu kālena bhavantyeva parāsavaḥ dāhagarbhe nāma kṛtvā tathā digvīthiṣu kramāt manīṣiteṣu viniyogāt proktāni phalāni ca syuriti || 60 yaiḥ sadyovairiṇaḥ svīyaṃ vimuñcanti kalevaram prabhā dāhakṣmāsvayuta haṃsodāhādisaṃyutaḥ kālyā yamasya kramato vidyāṃmantramasaṃkramam śṛṇu vakṣyāmi parato yamānuṣṭubhamīśvari nabo marudyutaṃ dāhaścaturṇāṃ pratilomataḥ nabhobhuvā grāsa etat pratilomāt dvitīyakam rayasteṣāṃ vilomaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ caraṇaṃ manoḥ caturthaṃ caraṇaṃ proktaṃ vidyaiṣā sarvanāśinī nāda eṣāṃ vilomaṃ ca prathamaṃ caraṇaṃ yame eteṣāṃ pratilomaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ caraṇo manāḥ rasaḥ kṣmayā vahnidāhau pratilomāt tṛtīyakam pratilomaṃ tu teṣāṃ syāccaturthaṃ caraṇaṃ śive veṣṭayedvyāptadāhābhyāmuktakramasamanvitam japtaṃ vinikṣipedakṣavivare catvare'tha vā śmaśāne proktasamaye proktakramasamanvitam mārītu susthirā sādhyā sarvaiḥ devāsurairapi sthāpitairakaṃ prāgvat kṛtaprāṇapratiṣṭham || 78 kṛtvā teṣvīśarakṣodigārambhātkālikāmanum veṣṭayitvā bahiścakraṃ sthāpayet tadadhomukham anukteṣvapi nāmāni yojayetkoṣṭhamadhyataḥ

śmaśānāṅgāranimbotthaniryāso viṣamīritam puruṣaścet kālyādyāyatanāgra evādhastācca khanediti bahiḥ kālīmantraveṣṭanaṃ ca boddhavyamiti sampradāyārthaḥ bījadvayena bindusahitarephayakārābhyāṃ pūrvavadveṣṭayet aṣṭacchedeṣu phaṭvarṇamālikhedaṣṭavarṇakam bahiḥ kumbhaṃ vidadhyācca proktākṣaravidhānataḥ vidadhyānnava yantrāṇi daśānāṃ ca phalaṃ śṛṇu ! stambhaṃ lakṣmīyaśohemavāsāṃsi (ca) samavāpnuyāt sthāpayet | tena pūrvoktānyeva phalāni syuriti citrakam | anyadārādhyamukhādavagantavyam evaṃ daśayantrāṇi kuryāt iti || 84 tatra arthaḥ sugamaḥ || 86 svarabinnairbhavet saṅkhyā ṣaṭsaptatyā śataṃ smṛtam śṛṇu vakṣyāmi deveśi ! sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhaye tanmadhye karṇikāmadhye śaktiṃ sādhyasamanvitām vṛttayorantarā bāhye kumbhaṃ proktaṃ samālikhet viniyogānathaiteṣāṃ krameṇa śṛṇu pārvati ! tṛtīyaṃ nṛparakṣāyāṃ caturthaṃ daṇḍarakṣakam sārddhamekādaśayantrāṇi bhavantīti p. 252) ṣaṣṭhaṃ sacivarakṣākṛt saptamaṃ purarakṣakam phaṇicoragrahādibhyo bhayebhyaḥ śatrutastathā uttārakaṃ syāddeveśi ! prākproktavidhinā yutam sthāpayecchītale toye ghaṭādau savidhe'tha tam ghorābhicārakṛtyādijāto dāhajvaraḥ kṣaṇāt evametāni yantrāṇi nāmataḥ sarvakāryakṛt

pūjādau ca baliṃ dadyāt ṣoḍaśārṇena pārvati ! asyā niṣphālanātcitte tattatvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtam prāṇapratiṣṭhābhiṣekodhāraṇamarcanaṃ cocyate ṣoḍaśārṇena tṛtīyapaṭalāvasānoktena mantreṇetiśeṣaḥ || 99 caturddaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam vidyoktā kulasundaryāstasyāḥ pūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇu tatsādhanaṃ tathā rūpabhedān yāgāṃśca vākpradān lohitāṃśukabhūśāsṛglepanāṃ ṣaṇmukhāmbujām anarghyaratnaghaṭitamāṇikyamukuṭojjvalām raktastabakasambhinnalasadvakṣasthalāṃ śubhām bhujairdvādaśabhiryuktāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvavāṅmayīm vasupūrṇaṃ saccaṣakaṃ luṅgivyākhyānamudrikām vidyādevatayoḥ || 1 haimīṃ ca lekhanīṃ ratnamālāṃ kambuvaraṃ bhujaiḥ yakṣarākṣasadevarṣisiddhavidyādharādibhiḥ sitāṃ kevalavāksiddhyai lakṣmyai hemaprabhāmapi nīlāṃ ca mūkikaraṇe(tāṃ) smaretta(tta)dapekṣayā ādimadhyāvasāneṣu pūjājapavidhau kramāt kuryātkarāṅgavaktrāṇāṃ nyāsaṃ proktaṃ yathāvidhi vyādhyādikleśāya | tattadapekṣayā tattatprayogānuguṇyena nyāsakālāḥ sarvasādhāraṇāḥ | kramāt yathākramam śucinatyantarasthaistaistadātmasu yathākramam tṛtīyaṃ śrotracibuke caturthaṃ ghrāṇatāluṣu mūlamadhyāgratonyasyennavadhā mūlavarṇakaiḥ tṛtīyakūṭākṣaraṣaṭkonaproktakramāt nyāsatrayaṃ kuryāditi

nyāsān kuryāditisampradāyaḥ khaḍgarūpā vittarūpā ramyāpyānandakautuke bahiraṣṭacchadāmbhoje brāhmyādyāśca samarcayet indrāgniyamarakṣobhirvaruṇānilasomakān śaktyantairnāmabhiḥ prāgvat pūjayet sarvasiddhaye tanmadhye vṛttayugmasthaṃ kuryādaṣṭacchadāmbujam kṛtvā'tra tāṃ samāvāhya prāgvatsamyagathārcayet daśamīmekādaśīṃ ca pūjayet || 18 || tathā vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa śaktyantairnāmabhiḥ indraśaktītyādiprāgvat * saptākṣaryantaiḥ tathaiva lokapālāntaśaktī dvāradvaye'rcayet saptākṣaryā baliṃ dadyātpūjānte kurukullayā prātaḥ salilapānaṃ ca kuryādvidyātmasiddhaye kāśmīrakālāgurubhirmṛgasvedamadairapi caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā tatra uktakrameṇa tāṃ pūjayediti || 21 prādakṣiṇyenārcayediti yāvat | sāmānyaṃ pūrvoktavadityarthaḥ yāvat copadiśati | tatra mṛgasvedamadaiḥ mṛgasvedaiḥ mṛgamadaiśca citrabhūṣāmbaraḥ sragvī japedvidyāṃ niśāmukhe sarvābhirapi nityābhiḥ prātarmātṛkayā samam anyairapi ca matraistairvidyābhistatprasiddhyati sugandhisalilairhomaṃ tāvattṛmadhurāplutaiḥ siddhavidyā(=)punaḥ kuryātkāmyakarmāṇi sādhakaḥ vidyāsvarūpabhedā/stu śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhi bhavatītyupahvaraḥ sampradāyārthaḥ vṛttasthaiḥ

vācyavācakarūpasya prapañcasyāmitātmanaḥ kathayāmi śṛṇu prājñe ! vidhivistaravaibhavāḥ yajurveda ikārādisteṣāṃ saṃyogataḥ śuciḥ vilikhya yojayetpūrvaṃ śabdaśāstrānusārataḥ vṛddhisandhyā samāyujyādityutpannaṃ śucervapuḥ ādyakṣaraprasūtāni sarvāṇyanyāni yena vai sitāṃ kevalavāksiddhyai ityādipūrvoktena devīrūpavarṇabhedena paramotkṛṣṭattvam | ameyattvaṃ deśakālākārairaniyantritattvam kāraṇatvāt tanmayatvādaikārasya ca trayīmayatvamuktamiti || 35 || 36 prāgvatkāraṇakāryatvayogādvācakarūpakam iti vācakavācyatvarūpādviśvātmatoditā evameṣā viśvamayī vidyārūpabhidāḥ śubhāḥ bindusargātmanoraikyarūpā sātvāvayorvapuḥ evamabhinnarūpo'nayā vidyayā vyāpta iti || 39 vidyāyāḥ svarūpabhedān śṛṇu ityarthaḥ vanaṃ tṛtīyamākhyātaṃ māyayā svena vā yutam jñātṛjñānajñeyadoṣaguṇatejastrayātmikā vācyavācakarūpātmā prapañcasya hi kāraṇe haṃsahṛdyogasteṣu jaṅgamā sthāvarātmatā jñātuṃ na śakyate saṃkhyā vidyānāṃ parameśvari sampūryāvatiṣṭhata iti saṅketavidyāyāḥ kāraṇeti svātantryoktiḥ | kāraṇatetyarthaḥ saṅketavidyāyā jaṅgamasthā varātmatvavāsanokteti tathāpi bhaktasantrāṇahetoḥ kāñcana vacmi te aihikāmuṣmikajñānamayī sakalasiddhidā

vijayākhyā mahāvidyā viśvasaṃtrāṇatatparā dvayorniyojanātteṣu jāyate (sā) āvayorvapuḥ teṣu dāhasamāyogādviśvākhyā viśvavigrahā tāsāṃ saṃkhyāsvarūpaṃ jñātuṃ vaktuṃ vā na kenāpi śakyamiti asamīcīnataddvayapratipādakavidyābhyoviśeṣayati khecarāmburasopetamāyābhyāṃ puṭitā tu sā māyādyā mohinī proktā tanmadhyā kṣobhiṇī matā trayodaśeti kathitātripurā(rinama)vidhayaḥ smṛtāḥ tāsāṃ vidhānaṃ te proktamaśeṣaṃ lakṣasāgare tāṃ vakṣye śṛṇu deveśi sādhābhīṣṭasiddhaye tripurāratnākhyā samīritā iti vidhānaṃ lakṣasāgarākhyāgame samupadiṣṭamiti copadiśati vātena ca carasvābhyāṃ dvitīyamapi pārvati evaṃ trivarṇā sā vidyā vidhānaṃ cātha kathyate kuryātkarāṅgayoḥ prāgvaditthaṃ dhyāyecca tāṃ tataḥ caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ prasannasmeravaktrakām trikoṇe svastikāsīnāṃ karuṇānandamandirām pustakaṃ ca varaṃ(daṃ) hastairdadhānāṃ sarvamaṅgalām kulāsane halakṣārṇamadhye tadvidyayā'nvite dakṣiṇordhvādi vāmādharāntaṃ dhāryāṇi pārśvakrameṇa kalpayet madhye trikoṇakoṇeṣu ratiprītimanobhavān(m) caturasre lokapālān prāgvacchaktīḥ samarcayet balidvayaṃ ca homaṃ ca prāgvadanyat samunnayet brāhmīrasavacādugdhe śṛtaṃ sarpistribhirdinaiḥ proktakrameṇa proktāḥ śaktīḥ pūjayediti

dinaśovilihet prātarabdānmūkobhavet kaviḥ kuberoravicandrārajñāgurūsitasaurayaḥ nāmasaptākṣarīyuktyā pūjayettarpayeddhunet mātṛkānyāsasahitaṃ spṛśedrakṣākṛte manum tena te sukhinobhūyaḥ sānvayā yāvadāyuṣam tadghṛtaṃ lihataḥ saṃvatsarāt proktaphalasiddhiriti || 68 tattanmaṇḍale pūjātarpaṇahomādinā vāñchitasiddhīḥ riti navakoṣṭhe nava proktān rāhuketusamanvitān koṣṭhetāṃstairyajetsadyomuktarogaḥ sukhī bhavet utpāte samarodyoge kuryāduktārcanādikam tena sarvāpadunmuktaḥ sukhī jīvati bhūtale kathayāmi dvayaṃ te'dya vakṣye tatpaṭale'khilam kuryādaṅgāni ṣaḍvargaiḥ pañcapañcadaśākṣaraiḥ uktaprakārairdinanityāsaptākṣarīmadhyagatairnavabhirnāmamantraiḥ sarvāpadbhyovimuktaḥ sukhī bhavatīti tatpaṭale mātṛkāpaṭale | akhilaṃ anyaditiśeṣaḥ karāṅgayorvidhāyetthaṃ ādikṣāntākṣarāṇi vai oṣṭhadantaśirojihvāsvekaśovinyasetsvarān vinyaseccaturovargān pañcamaṃ pārśvapṛṣṭhataḥ tvagsṛṅmāṃsamedo'sthimajjāśukrāntagāmiṣu hṛdayasparśināṃ teṣāṃ smaran dhātuśu vinyaset hṛdayādhastathāpādajaṭhare vadane nyaset jātiyuktairmantraiḥ karāṅganyāsaṃ kuryāditi || 79 prapadāṅgulisandhī ucyete | pañcamaṃ vargamitiśeṣaḥ || 81 hṛdayādipādayugāgrāvadhi parāmṛśan hakāraṃ ca nyasedityarthaḥ

vidhāya vilikhenmadhye haṃsahṛdvanaśaktijam pañcapañcākṣaropetān dārucāmbuni dikṣu ca savyañjanāvyañjanatvabhedato'bhūddviranvayaḥ anyānyekādaśa śive sandhimātrādi sambhavā prātarmurddhnismaredindubimbasthaṃ sarvasampadam sthāpanādgṛhadeśādau yantraṃ sarvārthasiddhidam sannidhiṃ phaladānaṃ ca sādhakānāṃ vitanvate ādiśabdogrāmādi viṣayaḥ sambhavatītyupadiśati nityaśojapapūjādyaiḥ kāle matsamatāṃ vrajet praviṣṭovidvadgoṣṭhīṣu yujyate vāgmibhirjanaiḥ vibhāvayannitimanuṃ japedekāgramānasaḥ vādādiṣu tu sarvatra devatātma jayī bhavet prayogajātamanyonyaṃ vidadhyādaikyayogataḥ ṣoḍaśasvapi nityāsu yantrādanyatsamīritum ādyaśabdastarpaṇahomādiviṣayaḥ | matsasatāṃ śivasamatām devatāhambhāvanayā tattatkaraṇādvijayo bhavedityarthaḥ nityānityāsādhāraṇam nāmālikhya bahiḥ ṣaṭsu tattrayaṃ svena māyayā jihvāyāṃ bhāvanāt sarvagoṣṭhīṣvagraṃ vigāhate asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam sādhāraṇānīti proktāni phalānyavāpnoti iti pañcadaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam

nityānityāṃ śṛṇu prājñe yadāyattamidaṃ jagat yāsau samastajīvānāṃ deha sthitividhāyinī yantrāṇi vajrarūpāṇi ṣaḍādhāreṣu saṃsthitim dīrghasvarasametābhyāṃ haṃsahṛdbhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam tadadhiṣṭhātṛrūpatvena nityānityāyāḥ sthitiṃ ca vakṣyāmīti vidyākṣarāṇi kramaśonyasedvinduyutāni tu vai dhyāyet samastasampattihetoḥ sarvātmikāṃ śivām padmarāgakṛtākalpāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīm prativaktraṃ trinayanāṃ bhujairdvādaśabhiryutām vahantīṃ varadāṃ vāmairaṅkuśaṃ pustakaṃ tathā dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastairdhyāyeddevīmananyathā lalitāśaktivṛndo'yaṃ bijadvayamathokramāt javirājitāṃ ṣaḍvaktrapadmavirājitāmityarthaḥ bhujeṣvāyudhānyūrddhādi kalpayet | kheṭaṃ carmaphalakam maṇḍalāgraṃ saḍgiviśeṣaḥ | nṛkapālaṃ śiraḥkapālam saptākṣaryā yutā saṃjñā vidyāḥ syurdvādaśākṣarāḥ ṣaṭkoṇakoṇeṣvāsīnāṃ ḍākinyādyāstathā'rcayet ḍākinīṃ śākinīṃ paścāllākinīṃ kākinīmapi hetīstāmabhitaḥ śaktirūpāstanmukuṭānatāḥ kuryācca nityahomantu japedvidyāṃ yathoditam svātmasvarūpatvāt | kāścana ākarṇaya vakṣyamāṇaśaktīritiśeṣaḥ ṣaṭkoṇeṣvatroktāni sthānāni pūrvameva vyākhyātāni || 12 || 13 kucabharanamrāḥ tattadbhujasthānasthitāḥ | sarvasādhāraṇametat arghasaṅkalpa prāgvat | īritakramāt proktakramāt | yathoditaṃ prāgvat kṛtvā teṣvapi tābhistu vṛttāṃ pūjāsu madhyamāḥ

padmairāvṛttaṣaṭkoṇe yajelladhvīsmṛtārcanāt vidhāya teṣu śākhāsu śaktīnāṃ viṃśatiṃ yajet anantabrāhmaniyatikālarūpā vigarhitāḥ tābhiḥ akārādikṣakārāntaikapañcāśadakṣarāṇāṃ śaktibhiḥ trisvādusiktairaruṇairambujairhavanaṃ tathā kuryāduktān prayogā/śca nacettaddhātudevatāḥ anayā vidyayā loke yanna sādhyaṃ na tat kvacit śataṃ dvādaśasaṃyuktaṃ tairyantrāṇi vadāmi te vidhāya madhye māyāsthamekamakṣaramākhyayā kṛtvā navabhirevaṃ syuḥ kramādyantrāṇi ṣoḍaśa pūjākrameṇa prāgvadarcayet ityevaṃ trayaḥ pakṣā iti || 19 sarveṣāṃ ṣaḍdhātvadhīśatvāt || 22 || tasya prayoktuḥ vistāramupadiśati | tatra sapta anāvṛttāni tāni prathamakūṭākṣarāṇi dvitīyena śirorogā naśyanti parameśvari pañcamena bhujārogāḥ prayāntyūrddhvena pādajāḥ dhṛtenāṣṭamayantreṇa jñānendriyagatā gadāḥ ekādaśena pittotthā dvādaśena kaphodbhavāḥ prayānti vilayaṃ sadyo yantrāṇāṃ śaktivaibhavāt prayānti bhītāḥ kṣaṇataḥ sarve'nyepi grahāḥ śive pūrvoktena saha ṣoḍaśa yantrāṇi bhavanti || 24 ūrddhena ṣaṣṭhena yantreṇetiśeṣaḥ | prāgvat pādajā rogā iti śeṣaḥ anukteṣu viśeṣyeṣu rogā ityetadviśeṣyam ṣoḍaśena dhṛtena syādāyurārogyamīśvari sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ samyaganukteṣu gadeṣvapi savaṃdanaṃ saviśvāsaṃ phalatyevānyathā'nyathā

vāksiddhimanyatsakalaṃ kurute na bhidā tayoḥ tairvajrayantranirmāṇaṃ phalāni ca śṛṇu priye | evaṃ kṛte phalatyeva anyathā na phalatyeva taistu koṣṭhāni jāyante navāśītiśatadvayam madhye vajraṃ yathā bhūyāttathā kuryāt samantataḥ tryasrāṇi catvāryagrāṇi catuḥkoṣṭhaistu pūrvavat prādakṣiṇyapraveśena kūṭa(a/ stānā)ntasyādyakhaṇḍajān pratilomānulomātmavidyādvayamathālikhet karmamadhye'dhare sādhyamālikhedapi sarvataḥ ṣaṭyantrāṇyupadiśati tatra ṣaṭtriṃśat pratikoṇamitiśeṣaḥ || 38 madhyavadvilikhetteṣu vajrayantramitīritam iti ṣaṭvajrayantrāṇi proktāni kramaśaḥ śive kuryādityarthaḥ || 42 || pratilomānulomakrameṇa likhedityarthaḥ p. 284) paṭṭe vā phalakāyāṃ vā ṣaṭkaṃ ṣaṭsu prakalpayet itarāṇi tu saṃsthāpya yajettatraiva tāṃ śivām navahastāyāmatataṃ patākātoraṇānvitam utsedhāyāmavistārahastāṃ vedīṃ ca madhyataḥ īśaprāgvahnirakṣāṃ tu vāyudikṣu yathākramam nivedya gandhapuṣpādyairnṛtyagītādibhistathā hutvā japitvā jīvocce bhānūcce vā sthirodaye pūrvoktena sārddhaṃ ṣaḍvajrayantrāṇi sambhavantīti devyātmā tacchilābhistu dṛḍhamābadhya tatra vai mūrtisaptakamutpādya pratiṣṭhāpya samarcayet yatra tatra gadālakṣmīripugrahapiśācakā,h na kadācitsambhavanti vidyāyantrānubhāvataḥ

dhārmikāścaiva rājānaḥ pūrṇasaptāṅgasaṃyutāḥ vāñchitaṃ samavāpnoti maṇḍalānmāsato'pi vā prāguktarakṣovāyuśakravahnīśavaruṇadikṣu sthāpanādityarthaḥ mūrtisaptakaṃ (ḍā)rākinyādīnāṃ ṣaṇāṃ devyāśceti śeṣaḥ kleśāḥ | vidyāyantrānubhāvataḥ ubhayoḥ sāmarthyāt || 56 suṣumnāmadhyasaṃstheṣu ṣaḍādhārāmbujeṣu tāḥ bahiśca maṇḍale pūjānugrahānigrahātmikā(m) dhūmravarṇāmbuje devīṃ ḍākinīṃ tatsamākṛtim tayā sarvajñatāsiddhirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ prāpnoti deheṣu sthitim | tāḥ devyaḥ ityatrānvayaḥ ,dākinyādaya iti śeṣaḥ mūladevatāsamānaḥ rākinīṃ dvādaśadale kādiḍhāntākṣarātmabhiḥ maṇipūrakasaṃjñe ca nābhisthe daśapatrake lākinīṃ pūjayedvairivi jayaśrīsamṛddhaye vādiṣaḍvarṇaśaktībhirāvṛtāṃ ḍākinīṃ yajet ādhārākhye catuṣpatre suvarṇābhe saroruhe pāyudhvajāntarā tryasramadhye tejaḥ samanvitām sevitāṃ hakṣaśaktibhyāṃ hākinīṃ pūjayettatha viśvasṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsaśaktidāmapyayatnataḥ pūjanaṃ sarvaduḥkhārtināśanaṃ sampadāspadam tayā pūjayā || 62 || 63 || 64 || 65 || 66 || dhvajamūle mehanamūle samanvitāṃ kuṇḍalinītejorūpām || 68 || tathā samuccaye bhūtabhaviṣyavartamānakāryajñānasāmarthyapradāyinīmityarthaḥ madhye ca tatra tāṃ nityānityā gandhādinā'rcayet

bāhyeṣvapi ca tāḥ prāgvatproktavarṇāḥ samarcayet ṣaṭtriṃśattāḥ samādevyāḥ sarvarūpāyudhādibhiḥ pareṣu yavalakṣārṇarahitā staistathā'rcayet ca kuryāditi tatra madhye brahmasūtraṃ kṛtvā tasyārddhamānataḥ vidhāya cihnayugalaṃ cihnāccīhnaṃ dvayorapi brahmasūtrasthapūrvāgrāvadhi sūtradvayaṃ bhavet paścimabrahmasūtrāntamitthaṃ ṣaṭkoṇakaṃ bhavet (tatheśāni)taddigādi ca rakṣontaṃ brahmasūtradvayaṃ bhavet kṛtvābhito'tha vṛttāni tattadarddhāṃśatobhramāt kṛtvā taddaśamāṃśeṣu ṣaṭsūtrāṇi nipātayet vṛttaspṛksūtrayugmāraṃ madhye madhye nipātayet kṛtvā trirbrahmasūtrāṇi mārjayeccakramuttamam pūjā nigrahasaṃjñā syāt sā śatrūṇāṃ vipattaye kkāthatoyābhisampūrṇān kṛṣṇāmbarasamanvitān kṣipraṃ tvagādibhiste syuḥ pūrṇāḥ śatroḥ kalevarāḥ homaṃ ca kuryāttenaiva phaṇiśīrṣasrucā ruṣā praharantīḥ piśācebhyovikirantīśca tattanum dhyātvaivaṃ nigrahaṃ kuryādripūṇāṃ māraṇāya vai dhūmrasindūranīlodyadbhānuhemendu (bhāṃsi)bhāni ca udyadaryamabimbābhe nityānityāṃ ca madhyame nigrahānugrahavidhau yatamāno vinaśyati tathā manīṣitaprāptau siddhirasyārcanādbhavet ---------------------------- ataḥ paraṃ vyākhyeyāni kāṃsye sīsepi vā kṛtvā sthāpayedvairibhūmiṣu

ekāśītipadāni syusteṣu koṇacatuṣṭaye caturdikṣu trikoṇāni catuḥkoṣṭhaiḥ prakalpayet bhujaṅgamasya phaṇaṃ chitvā sruggatena tena phaṇenetyarthaḥ rahasyārthaśca svagurumukhādevāvagantavyaḥ śiṣṭeṣu madhyādhaḥkoṣṭhamārabhya pratilomajān sādhyayonyasṛjā piṣṭatadvṛkṣakṣodalepitān śmaśāne caṇḍikāgehe kulotsādakaraṃ bhavet anugrahaṃ śṛṇu prājñe pūjācakravidhānataḥ navedyamāsāṃ samproktaṃ yadāsāṃ prītidāyakam haridrānnaṃ tilānnaṃ ca śuddhānnaṃ ṣaṭakameva ca yuvatīḥ sapta saṃsthāpya prāgvadabhyarcya tāḥ kramāt tāsu tuṣṭāsu tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ śaktayastāḥ samāstadā kūṭānuktasamārambhān prādakṣiṇyena sallikhet proktānyeva phalāni syuryogo'yaṃ laghuvigrahaḥ bījadvayādyaiḥ saptākṣaryantaiḥ pañcadaśākṣaraiḥ dineṣu ghaṭikāyogāt pañcāśanmithunānyapi saptākṣaryā ca saṃyuktā mantrāḥ pañcadaśākṣarāḥ manīṣitaṃ samālikhya (rabhya) teṣu tanmithunāni ve evaṃ maṇḍalamāsārddhāt prāpnotyevābhivāñchitam proktaphalāvāptiḥ syāt evameṣa prayogeṣvapiyatnasādhya iti samastavāñchitaprāptiḥ sadā bhavati sarvadā asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam iti śrī ṣoḍaśanityātantrekādimate ṣoḍaśapaṭalam pañcadaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam pañcāśītiḥ sārddhapādāḥ ṣoḍaśe paṭale smṛtāḥ

tasyā nīlapatākāyā vidhānaṃ sarvasiddhidam sādhanaṃ siddhavidyasya vijayaṃ kāmarūpatām yakṣiṇīśceṭakānmāyāṃ yantrāṇi ca vadāmi te daśabhiḥ siddhibhirmartyobhavedvidyādharo'paraḥ dvicatuṣṭayaṣaḍavarṇaiḥ krameṇa ṣaḍitīritaiḥ kathitā | vidhānaṃ vadāmītyanvayaḥ siddhyādīnām nābhāvādhārake pādasandhiṣu triṣu ca kramāt vyāpakaṃ ca samastena vidadhyācca yathāvidhi pañcavaktrāṃ trinayanāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīm ratnastabakasambhinnadehāṃ cārusmitānanām dadhānāṃ vāmapārśvasthaiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastairāsīnāṃ padmaviṣṭare saṅkṣepavikāsārthatvānna punaruktidoṣaḥ prāgvadvyāpakanyāsaṃ ca kuryāditi yāvat || 6 prativaktramityarthaḥ || 8 || daśahastāṃ sambhūyetiśeṣaḥ śaktivṛndairvṛtāṃ dhyāyeddevīṃ nityārcanakrame aṣṭāsraṃ bhūpuradvandvādvṛtte tatpurayugmakam kṛtvā tāmāvṛtāṃ śaktigaṇaistatrārcayecchivām agrātpradakṣiṇenaiva yajedāvṛttipañcakam śṛṅgamayatvāccāpasya | teṣāmubhayataḥkramamūrddhādi kalpayet padmaviṣṭare vakṣyamāṇarūpe || 11 || āsyaṃ mukham brāhmyādīraṣṭapatreṣa tatkoṇeṣa bahistathā balidvayaṃ ca kurvīta pūjāṃ prāgvatsamāpayet tilataṇḍulakairvāpi proktaṃ dravyānudīraṇe

pṛthakkṛ(tyā)tvā'thagaṇite tripañcāśadbhavanti hi taddaśāṃśaṃ hunedagnau sarvatrākṣaralakṣake nityānāmapi sarvāsāṃ vāsanāyāmudīritam vyākhyāto'smābhiḥ | tatkoṇeṣu aṣṭakoṇeṣu | bahiḥ caturasre || 15 śeṣaḥ | prāgvat ādhāratraye, teja(sa)strayabhāvanādisahitamityarthaḥ tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe vakṣye vidyāvibhedataḥ saṅkhyāṃca tāśca samproktāḥ krameṇāsāṃ phalāni ca tābhyāmeva vilomābhyāṃ puṭayeduparauritān parastāttatprabhedānāṃ mantrānvakṣye yathāvidhi udīritaṃ prāṅmukhattvakāraṇam sarvāṇi paṭalaśeṣe vakṣyamāṇāni prastauti (iti) kūṭayuddhe durgaje ca teṣāṃ mantrāścaturvidhāḥ vidhātumātmanaḥ śaktiṃ sa eko mantra īritaḥ kṛtvā smaredvāñchitantu deśaṃ tatra tadā sthitiḥ yenāktākṣonidhiṃ paśyeddevādyāṃścāntarikṣagān palāyitā vā padayoḥ praṇameyurvaśaṅgatāḥ nidhāya sādhanaṃ skandhe careyurvāñchayā'sya te siddhimantrānte yojayediyarthaḥ | uparīritān upariṣṭādvakṣyamāṇān siddhyavāntarabhedānām | mantrān tatsaṅkhyādibhiḥ teṣāṃ vijayānāṃ caturvidhānām śaktiḥ sāmarthyam | saḥ kāmarūpapradaḥ kecidbhīṣaṇādāṅgāḥ vetālā bahuvigrahāḥ kiṅkarāḥ proktakaraṇādbhaveyuryāvadāyuṣam kruddhāḥ kṣudrāśayāḥ proktakāriṇaḥ syurasaṅkhyakāḥ taireva praharecchatrumajñātamaniśaṃ raṇe

sarūpā dvibhujāścitravasanābharaṇānvitāḥ pādukāsiddhividyāprasādīkṛtam | pādayoḥ svasyetiśeṣaḥ | tatra deśe tanmantrasaṅkhyā vā | yena añjanena pūrvāparayoranveti te piśācāḥ | taiḥ piśācaiḥ | ajñātaṃ apratyakṣam ṣaṭtriṃśadrūpasaṃyuktāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśatsaṅkhyātā ityarthaḥ sametya sarvābhīṣṭāni dadyustāḥ sādhakāya vai yābhiḥ siddhābhiraniśaṃ sādhakāḥ sarvasammatāḥ te'pi nānāvidhākārāḥ siddhāste dadyurīpsitam vasūnyupahareyustā vidyaikā tatprasā(dha)dane daśavidyāḥ prajāyante śṛṇu vakṣye ca tāḥ kramāt tāḥ vidyāḥ | yābhiḥ vidyābhiḥ prāgvat | īpsitaṃ sādhakasyeti śeṣaḥ ekādaśādhikaṃ śatamiti siddhyapekṣayoktiḥ | tāḥ vidyāḥ vidyā sā vijayaprāptyāṃ caturṣvekādaśākṣarāḥ trayodaśākṣarī vidyā kāmarūpapraderitā dvādaśārṇā bhavedvidyā siddhā dadyācca pāduke pūjayettaddvayenātra dvādaśārṇā samīritā dvādaśārṇā bhavetsiddhā satyā dadyātsuśobhanam atirahasyatvādvidyā āñjasyena na likhyante tathā kūṭadvayenetyarthaḥ | anyatsugamam mantrāyojanāt | vidyeti pūrvāparayoranveti | pāduke iti dvivacanam dvādaśārṇā vidyeti śeṣaḥ śeṣaḥ | siddhā prāgvaccheṣaḥ

trayodaśākṣarāṃ vidyāṃ siddhāṃ tān darśayettathā puṭayetpūrvavaddvābhyāṃ vidyā saptadaśākṣarā tāsāṃ nāmāni vidyāśca śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhi viśālā madanā rūddhā kālakaṇṭhī mahābhayā mekhalā sakalā lakṣmīrmālinī viśvanāyikā kāmeśvarī nandinī ca svarṇarekhā manoramā kalyāṇadā kalādakṣā tataśca surasundarī mantrayojanā | tathā prāgvat dvayena | tān vetālānitiśeṣaḥ bījābhyāmitiśeṣaḥ tāsāṃ yakṣiṇīnām iti daśamī māhendrītyādinā ślokena daśa nāmānyupadiśati sakārastadvat tāsāṃ vidyāḥ krameṇaiva tadbījadvayasampuṭaiḥ vidyāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadākhyātāstāḥ siddhā dadyurīpsitam pañcamī pañcadaśamī viṃśatiśca tathā'ntimā trayodaśī cāṣṭadaśī dvāviṃśā dvādaśākṣarā navamī daśamī caikaviṃśā tadvadanantaram sugamāni dvādaśākṣarāḥ tadvaccaturdaśākṣarā ityarthaḥ trayastriṃśā(dhi)dikāstisrastrayodaśayutāḥ parāḥ śṛṇu śuddhyāstu te nityaṃ sādhayeyuḥ samīhitam siṃhanādo mahānādaḥ sugrīvomarkaṭaḥ śaṭaḥ mayūro maṅgalobhīmo dvīpivaktraḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ sauribhāsyo gajamukhaḥ paśuvaktro gajānanaḥ

śyenāsyaḥ kaṅkavadanaḥ kākāsyo hayavaktrakaḥ sampradāyārthaḥ tavetyarthaḥ | te ceṭakāḥ vibhrametyādinā ślokena ekādaśa nāmānyupadiśati mātaṅga ityādinā ślokenāṣṭa nāmānyupadiśati capalaḥ kukkuṭāsyaśca māyāvī madanālasaḥ sumukhaḥ pīḍitaḥ kruddho varāhāsyaḥ saṭāmukhaḥ bhakṣakobhayadaḥ siddhaḥ sarvagaśceti kīrtitāḥ nāmabhistairdvitīyāntairdehītipadasaṃyutaiḥ teṣāṃ saṅkhyāmapi tathā śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhi tathā pañcadaśārṇāḥ syuḥ ṣaḍviṃśatiritīritāḥ mahodaretyādinā ślokenāṣṭa nāmānyupadiśati manoharetyādinā ślokena nava nāmānyupadiśati padacchedaḥ | anyatsugamam tathā saptadaśārṇāśca catvārovyākulakramāt sasvaraistairbhavetsaṅkhyā caturviṃśacchatadvayam devatāḥ saptavāreṣu bhāskarādiṣu bhaktitaḥ svarūpabhedasambhinnāḥ samīcīnaṃ darśitāḥ yantrasya madhye māyāsthaṃ tatra siddhīśca pūjayet bahiḥ kalābjabhūpadmayugaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi daleṣu koṇeṣu tathā vṛttamadhyatraye punaḥ tasya koṇāntarāleṣu halakṣārṇān kramāllikhet siddhīnāṃ yakṣiṇīnāṃ ca ceṭakānāṃ tathaikaśaḥ teṣāmuktakrameṇaiva sādhanāni phalāni vai koṇāntarāleṣu caturṣu uktamakṣaratrayaṃ vilikhedityarthaḥ

pūjyate sarvalokaiśca sarvataḥ sarvadāpi ca udyānamadhye kāntāre mātṛpādapamūlataḥ ekaikasmin varṇalakṣaṃ japeduktavidhānataḥ kadambabandhūkajayāhayamāraiśca lohitaiḥ suvarṇāni ca vāsāṃsi bhūṣaṇāni phalāni ca ālepanāni mālyāni dadyurājīvitāvadhi ityuktvā nityaśastāstu pūjayeccajapettathā evaṃ tāḥ sarvayakṣiṇyaḥ phalaṃ dadyuryathepsitam ekasmin pañca pañca syuḥ siddhāḥ sindhutaṭe nava maunaṃ dineṣu satataṃ kuryāt siddhyai na cālayet japeddivāniśaṃ proktaṃ sarveṣāmapi sādhane japasaṃkhyocyate | hayamāraiśca lohitaiḥ raktakaravīrapuṣpairityarthaḥ nityatadupāsanādigranthārthaḥ sugamaḥ || 84 || 85 || 86 sthānānyanyasarvasiddhyaṣṭakasādhanasādhāraṇānīti sampradāyaḥ kṣobhayuramuṃkṣomaṃ nacedetyatha tatpuraḥ pratyekaṃ te tathetyuktā na māṃ muñcata ityapi (smṛ)sate tametya sandiṣṭaṃ sādhayeyuḥ samīhitam kurvanti prārthitārthānāṃ pradānaṃ ca divā'niśam niścalīkurvate mattaṃ dantinaṃ vā hayaṃ naram piśācairuragaiḥ siddhaiḥ kinnarairapsarogaṇaiḥ rudrairekādaśavidhaiḥ sādhyaiśca navabhirgrahaiḥ vijayādīnāṃ saptānāṃ vidhānādikamapyevam || 94 rājabhirvanitābhiśca narairanyairmṛgaistathā hṛṣṭāśayo vadānyaśca dayāvān sumukhaḥ kṣamī dhanī bhoktā'paradveṣī premabhūrāvayorbhavet

asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam parāmṛṣṭam tatra anyaiḥ daśaprājāpatyādibhiḥ || 96 || 97 siddhasamīhitasukhāspadaḥ siddhasamīhitaśca sukhāspadaścetyarthaḥ śivaśaktyoḥ saptadaśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭham tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe vidyā prāguditā tava tadyantraviniyogāṃśca vakṣye'haṃ vijayapradān śeṣābhyāṃ ca dvayaṃ kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgāni karāṅgayoḥ akṣarāṇi kramādvinduyutānyanyattu pūrvavat tadviniyogāṃścetyarthaḥ bhāsvanmukuṭavinyastacandrarekhāvirājitām udyadbhasvadbimbatulyadehakāntiṃ śucismitām cakraṃ tathā'ṅkuśaṃ khaḍgaṃ sāyakaṃ mātuluṅgakam upāsane'tisaumyāṃ ca siṃhopari kṛtāsanām samare pūjane'nyeṣu prayogeṣu sukhāsanām sarvādevyā samākāramukhapāṇyāyudhānyapi krameṇa vinyasya samastarūpayā vidyayā vyāpakaṃ ca nyasediti yuddhavijayārthaṃ dhyātvā pūjayedityarthaḥ | anyeṣu vaśyādiṣu sukhāsīnāṃ saparivārāṃ devīṃ dhyāyediti dalāṣṭakasamopetaṃ tatra prāgvat samarcayet tadantaśca tathā padmaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadasaṃyutam tattacchaktyā vṛtāṃ samyagupacāraistathā'rcayet balidvayaṃ ca kurvīta pūjāṃ cā'pi samāpayet candrakhaṇḍalasanmauliyutā sā tanmayī matā

tadāvaraṇagāḥ śaktīstatsamākāraśaktikāḥ devīmāvāhyābhyarcayediti || 13 || vā vikalpe | balidvayaṃ prāgvat tāsāṃ krameṇa nāmāni śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhi antaḥsthitāṣṭakoṇeṣu pūjayeduktavigrahāḥ kṣemāṃ kṣemaṃkarīnityāmaṣṭakoṇeṣu bhaktitaḥ śaktīstā(stā) gandhapuṣpā(di)yutobhaktisamanvitaḥ vīrāṃ vikṣobhiṇīṃ vidyāṃ vinodāñcitavigrahām vibhavāṃ vividhāṃ viprāṃ proktākārasamanvitāḥ proktakrameṇa gandhādyairbhaktiniṣṭhāśayo vaśī hṛllekhādyaiḥ saptākṣaryantairityarthaḥ | nāmabhiḥ mantrairiti śeṣaḥ tāḥ śaktīḥ teṣu caturasrādisthāneṣu | tāsāṃ āvaraṇaśaktīnām vidāriṇīmityarthaḥ | viśvavibhañjikāṃ viśvavibhañjinīmityarthaḥ māninīṃ madhurāṃ māyāṃ mohinīmuktavigrahām bhajate nityaśodevīṃ yo'sau syātsarvataḥ sukhī homaṃ raktāmbujaiḥ kṛtvā siddhamantrodayānvitaḥ japena tarpaṇenāpi pūjanena yathāvidhi sugandhiśephālikayā trimadhvaktairyathāvidhi proktavāreśayoścāpi tanmaṇḍalata eva vai proktarūpataḥ avaśiṣṭamanyatsugamam || 26 mallayuddheca vādeca dvaye dyūtadvaye'pi ca caturaṅgulajaiḥ puṣpairhomātsaṃstambhayedarīn campakaiḥ ketakairājavṛkṣajairmāgandhodbhavaiḥ prokteṣu stambhanaṃ śatrorbhaṅgo vā bhavati dhruvam sarpiṣājyāplutābhiste praṇamantyeva pādayoḥ

samidbhirjuhuyātsamyagvāreśārcanapūrvakam sajīvanirjīvarūpe || 30 || sarvatra anyeṣu vivādeṣvapi || homātproktaphalasiddhiriti tenāsya vijayobhūyānnidhanenāpi vā punaḥ patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ kāṇḍaiḥ mūlaiścāpi hunetkramāt arātidiṅmukhobhūtvā kuṇḍe tryasrevidhānataḥ vairī balasamagropi śauryamānānvito'pi ca homena somavāre ca bhavetprāgvanna saṃśayaḥ vāre bhaumasya havanāttadāpnoti suniścitam budhavāreṣu śubhrāyāḥ savatsāyā ghṛtānvitam nakṣatravṛkṣasamidbhiḥ | te śatravaḥ || 34 || samidbhiḥ mṛtyoritiśeṣaḥ uddiṣṭakramaiḥ patrādyairmūlāntaiḥ pañcabhiraṅgairityarthaḥ ekonapañcāśaddinairityarthaḥ | ttyasre trikoṇakuṇḍe ityarthaḥ || 38 takṣavāreṣu(?) te janma pūrvameva hi tatkriyā tattannityārcanaṃ tattaddvāreśadvayapūjanam śīghraṃ tatphalasaṃsiddhyaibhavatyevānyathā'nyathā hunettathā tatphalāptistaddinaiḥ syādasaṃśayam tatsiktairvidadhītetthaṃ taddinaistacca siddhyati taddināttatphalāni syuriti vāreṣu saptasu viyayaṃ śṛṇu deveśi kathayāmi krameṇa te tadvāreśadvayaṃ ca pūjayitvā paścāt prayogān kuryāditi śālīcaṇakamudgaiśca yavamāṣaiśca homataḥ ṣaṣṭhyādi ca daśamyantamajābhavaghṛtaistathā tadūrdhvaṃ pañcadaśyante samastaiśca tiladvayaiḥ havanāttadavāpnoti yadāsau phalamīritam

havanādapi tatprāptirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ taddināt prāevanmaṇḍalāt | tatphalāni jayaphalāni | iti proktarūpataḥ vijayamitiśeṣaḥ | tathā ṣaṣṭyādibhirdaśamyantābhiḥ pañcatithibhiḥ kṛṣṇarūpaiḥ, trayodaśyāṃ sitarūpaiśca tilairjuhuyādityarthaḥ madhusiktairhomāt tattatphalāvāptiriti aśītyarṇavatīṃ vidyāṃ tairyantrāṇi śṛṇu priye ekāśītipadāni syusteṣu tāni likhetkramāt śūlīkṛtya ca rekhāgrāṇyatrāvāhyābhipūjya tām vidyākramaṃ tatra yantre yajettatphalamāpnuyāt ṣoḍaśasvarayojanārūpaḥ | taiḥ akṣaraiḥ | yantrāṇi vakṣyamāṇāni tasmin prayogārthaṃ vidyākramañcārcayet | tena vijayaphalasiddhiriti navāni sambhavantyatra koṣṭhāni parameśvari teṣu madhyasthapadmasya karṇikāyāṃ samālikhet teṣvādito'ṣṭau saṃlikhya vindunā tadbahistathā evamaṣṭasu saṃlikhya veṣṭayenmātṛkākṣaraiḥ caturasratraye bāhye yantrasyāgre samālikhet vidyākṣarauṣadhikvāthajalairāpūrya pūrvavat abhiṣiñcettataḥ kleśairvimukto jāyate sukhī navagrahārtoripubhiḥ sarvataḥ kleśasambhave putrāptyai vāñchitaprāptyai triṣu janmasu kārayet devīmāvāhya sampūjya japedvidyāṃ tathā'yutam taṃ kumbhaṃ pratikarṇikamitiśeṣaḥ | pūrvavat phalapallavādibhiḥ sañjapya triṣu janmasvabhiṣekāt proktaphalasiddhiriti rājānaṃ vanitāṃ martyānanyāṃśca prāṇino'khilān nidhāya bhittimadhye vā śayanasthānake nije

sahasraṃ proktakālena stambhayedakhilaṃ dṛḍham vyavahāraṃ raṇodyogaṃ vāde vācaṃ matiṃ ruṣām sandhyāsu pūjayennityaṃ sahasraṃ prajapettathā athānyadvajrarūpaṃ tu yaṃtraṃ vakṣyetivaibhavam koṣṭhāni navaṣaṣṭyā ca yutaṃśatamitisphuṭam madhye ca sambhavatyevāśītikoṣṭhairyathāvidhi sarvamadhyasthakoṣṭhe ca caturdikṣvagratastathā etadagracatuṣkasya sparśāttricaturasrakam ekena vajrayantreṇa vijayā vijayapradāḥ vijayaṃ samavāpnoti prokteṣvapi ca saptasu japārādhanasaṃsiddhaṃ sthāpayecchūnyaveśmasu piśācā rākṣasāḥ kṛtyā vetālāḥ syurna tatra vai sthāpayedyatrakutrāpi tatkṣetraṃ brāhmaṇāspadam vaṭe vilikhya khananāt pattanaṃ bhavati dhruvam āhitānāśrayaṃ sthānaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ dāhavyāpte svasaṃyukte likhet tacchṛṅgamadhyayoḥ bhālasthenābhijaptena tamāviśya gado vadet triṃśattamena ślokena proktadvandvayuddhādiṣu saptasvityarthaḥ grahabhūtapiśācādyāḥ asyāviśyāpayānti vai yantrametadvilikhyāśmanyabhyarcya sthāpayet kvacit sthāne gajānāṃ vāhānāṃ nava kṛtvā navasvapi dikṣu madhye ca tatraiva rogāḥ kṛtyāḥ pareritāḥ candracandanakāśmīrairālikhyābhinave paṭe dāhajvarārtamacirānmucyate tajjvareṇa saḥ samareṣu mahīpānāṃ yantrametadudīritam

daradenātha tanmadhye tāmāvāhya samarcayet pratyarthisenā tacchabdaśravaṇena palāyate sajīvadyūtakāleṣu yantrametadvinirmitam vajrarūpam || 94 || 95 || tāḍayan nissārayan | tacchabda iti nissāraṇa śabdaḥ || etaddarśanamātreṇa palāyante diśo daśa nāsādhyaṃ vidyate tena vajrayantreṇa pārvati tadaiva dāsavattasya vaśo bhavati tadbalāt asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattva svātmasātkṛtam parāmṛṣṭam tatkaṇṭhe kukkuṭādikaṇṭhe || 98 || jayamāpnoti dadhajjana iti śeṣaḥ dhyānabalāt | uktaprakārataḥ paripūrṇaṃ paramāmṛṣṭam ekākṣarā sā kathitā vidyā sā sarvamaṅgalā pūjākramaṃ sādhanañca viniyogādikān kramāt tāni tatsvarabhinnāni nyaset sveṣu mano'vadhi māṇikyamukuṭāṃ netradvayapreṅkhaddayābharām viniyogādikān yantrādīnāmiti śeṣaḥ prāgvannyasediti sampradāyaḥ patrairupete sacaturdvārabhusadmayugmage vāmena nijabhaktānāṃ prayacchantīṃ dhanādikam ṣaṭsaptatibhiranyabhirakṣarotthābhiranvitām tāḥ śaktīḥ śṛṇu deveśi yā nityāvaraṇe sthitāḥ karuṇāṃ kamalāṃ kalpāṃ pūjayedaṣṭapatrake śaktibhiścānvitāṃ proktarūpato dhyātvā pūjayediti aśokāmamalāṃ pūrṇāṃ puṇyāṃ bhāgyāmathodyatām

pūjayedabhitaḥ śaktīḥ prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa vai gaurīṃ śivāmameyāñca vimalāṃ vijayāṃ parām aśeṣarūpāmānandāmambujākṣīmaninditām vidyāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ sandhyāṃ saṃyātāñca sarasvatīm prāgvadindrādibhiḥ sarvvāḥ kramādanvarthasaṃjñakāḥ paścimādicaturddikṣu catasraḥ proktavigrahāḥ japantu nityaśaḥ kuryyādagre tasyāḥ sahasrakam homaṃ daśāṃśataḥ kuryyādannājyābhyāṃ ghṛtena vā prayogānanyathā tasya naiṣphalyamayaśo mṛtim saṃsādhya paścāt kurvvīta maṅgalānmaṅgaloditān devyāḥ etatsarvamaṅgalāpaṭaloktānmaṅgalān prayogānityarthaḥ somasūryyāgnirūpāśca tāstvaṣṭatriṃśadeva tāḥ śaṃśinī candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śrīḥ prītiraṅgadā etāḥ ṣoḍaśa candrasya kalāḥ kalpadrumopamāḥ suṣumnā bhogadā viśvā bodhanī dhāraṇī kṣamā bhakārādi ḍakārāntavarṇoccāro vilomataḥ vivasvānindrapūṣārkāḥ parjanyaḥ samanantaraḥ kādiṭhāntārṇatanavaḥ sarvagāḥ sarvvasiddhidāḥ suśrīḥ surūpā kapilā havyakavyavahe api teṣāṃ daśānāṃ nāmāni vāsanoktāni te śive proktakrameṇa saṃpūjya vidhiṃ yuñjyāttu sarvataḥ tāsāṃ nāthāstatsadṛśanāmarūpāḥ samīritāḥ tāni saṃpūjya tattejastrayātmani jale śive abhiṣekāttu tattejastrayaṃ devyātmatā bhavet

pañcabhiryojayennityāṃ vidyāṃ tāṃ sarvamaṅgalām tataḥ sahasrairnavabhirdviśatena ca ṣoḍaśa tattaddevatātmatetyarthaḥ | abhiṣecyasyeti śeṣaḥ tairyantrāṇi prayogāṃstu phalāni ca vadāmi te tadbahiścāṣṭapatrāvjaṃ tadbahistattrayaṃ tathā teṣvādyaṃ madhyataḥ sādhyasametaṃ vilikhedbahiḥ aṣṭacchadeṣu pratyekaṃ pañca pañca samālikhet vilomāmanulomāñca svena samyak samālikhet taiḥ proktasaṃkhyairvidyārūpaiḥ prayogān yantrairiti śeṣaḥ nitye likhedagratastu prādakṣiṇyena sarvataḥ śatañca catvāriṃśacca catvāri ca tataḥ kramāt madhye nāmasametāni tadanyānyabhito likhet jāyanta iti sahasraiśca śatenāpi caturbhistāni saṃkhyayā evamāsāntu nityānāṃ yantrāṇi syuḥ pṛthak pṛthak vidyante teṣu yatkiñcidvakṣye kaḥ śeṣato vadet bhittvā ṣoḍaśadhā devi vidadhyādviniyogakam prāgādimadhyasaṃyuktaṃ nāthān devīśca tatkramāt || 48 pīṭhe vā bhūtale vāpi pūjayet proktavāsaram śaknomītyarthaḥ cakraṃ prakṣālya tattoyaṃ kedārādiṣu nikṣipet viniyuñjyādabhīṣṭeṣu kāryyeṣu kramataḥ śive sarvataḥ saumyakarmmāṇi sidhyantyevānayā dhruvam lakṣmīprāptyai tathārogya siddhau rogārttiśāntiṣu putrāptyai sarvarakṣāyai pūjayetteṣu tatkramāt

teṣāṃ rogādipīḍāsu tacchāntyai ca yathākramāt teṣu teṣūktakāryyeṣu tattat samprāptihetave tithiṣu proktarūpāṇi tatra tāṃ sarvamaṅgalām evameṣā mahāsiddhikarī pūjājapādinā nāthātmakatvaṃ ṣoḍaśanityātmakatvaṃ caiṣāmiti sampradāyaḥ pūrṇāmanativistāraṃ maṅgalāṃ brūhi me śiva pūjāṃ vakṣyāmi te devi guhyāṃ śṛṇu manohare arcitayā vidhāyātha pīṭhe cakraṃ vidhāya tat ekena tatra tāḥ samyaguktarūpamathārcayet vṛttasyāyāmavistāradvaye tvekaturīyataḥ pratiṣṭhāpya cakramiti śeṣaḥ | atra cakre trayamantarato muktā tena dvādaśakoṇakam madhyavṛttasya madhye tu yoniṃ kuryyāt samāsrakām anyā anyeṣu koṇeṣu pūjayeddvādaśa kramāt saptākṣaryyā kevalayā kevalāṃ lalitāṃ yajet proktarūpaṃ dvādaśāsraṃ cakraṃ bhavatīti nityāsaptākṣarībhiḥ syurvidyāḥ pūjāsu sarvadā tadvidyākṣarasaṃkhyāntu śṛṇu vakṣye yathākramam dvitīyāyāścaturthyāḥ syuścaturdaśabhirakṣaraiḥ dvādaśyāśca caturdaśyāḥ pañcadaśyāḥ krameṇa vai madhyasthāṃ pūjayediti ekādaśyāstu sāṣṭamyāḥ ṣoḍaśyā dvādaśoditāḥ saviṃśatiśatā vidyā japettāstāśca siddhaye āsāṃ pūjājapādyeṣu yantreṣu ca samīritam tena tantroktamakhilaṃ sādhayedvajrarūpiṇā

proktadvādaśāracakre pūrvoktakrameṇa ṣoḍaśanityāḥ samarccayediti ābhiryantrapaṭalavakṣyamāṇayantreṣvapi pūjādikaṃ kuryāt koṇātmavajranirmmāṇaprayogāḥ parataḥ śive yatsādhakārthitāvāptyai surāṅghripasamo bhavet navaviṃśatibhiḥ pañcaśataṃ koṣṭhāni tena vai śiṣṭeṣu vakojraṣṭhāni pañcaṣaṣṭyā śatadvayam koṣṭhairvidhāyādho madhye vāhyārambhāt pradakṣiṇam madhye'vaśiṣṭe khaṇḍārṇacaturvviṃśatimālikhet lalitāṃ sādhyagarbhāntu vilikhenmadhyakoṇataḥ saṃsthāpya kutracit sthāne pūjayedvāñchitāptaye maṅgalānyeva jāyante nāmaṅgalakathā bhavet caturdiggatatrikoṇacatuṣṭaye'pi sādhyagarbhāṃ samālikhet iti amaṅgalakathā amaṅgalamiti śabdastasminniti śeṣaḥ vilikhya madhye lalitāṃ sādhyagarbhāṃ samālikhet tenāpi pūrvvavat proktaṃ deśe na syādabhavyakam madhye sādhyākṣaropetāṃ sthāpayettatphalāptaye saṃsthāpya kumbhaṃ tadvarṇabhūruhakvāthapūritam janmarkṣeṣu viśeṣeṇa samastalayaśāntaye savindukāmālikhya pūrvoktadeśe sthāpanāt pūrvoktaphalasiddhiriti tatra madhyasādhyākṣaropetāṃ nānyatreti yāvat pūrvoktaphalasamṛddhaye p. 353) tathānyadapi deveśi prayogaṃ sarvapāvanam saṅkocadhvāntamārttaṇḍaṃ santoṣāvdhividhūdayam maunī japet prasūnaiśca pūjayet saurabhānvitai saurabhādyaistilaiḥ śubhraistaṇḍulairvidhivaddhunet

samastaṃ tatkramādekavāraṃ tairabhiṣekataḥ bhūtapretapiśācāpa * * * vimucya tatkṣaṇādbhītāḥ prayānti cānyataḥ kṣaṇāt abhiṣiktam kaṇṭhamātre majjanāttu prāgjanmādyairvimucyate evaṃ sakalakalyāṇasaṃproktā sarvamaṅgalā kṣipraprasādato nityaṃ harṣotpādanato'pi ca asyā niphālanā citte tattattvasvātmasāt kṛtam svarūpānubhavataḥ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe jvālāmālinyudāhṛtā yantrāṇi viniyogāṃśca phalāni ca śṛṇu kramāt kuryādaṅgāni mūlārṇairāditaḥ ṣaṭ karāṅgayoḥ ṣaḍvaktrāṃ dvādaśabhujāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām proktakramādityarthaḥ ṣaḍbhirmantraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni karanyāsapūrvaṃ nyasediti śūlavahnī varābhītī dadhānāṃ karapaṅkajaiḥ cārusmitalasadvaktrasarojāṃ trīkṣaṇānvitām caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā caturdvārasamanvitam ṣaṭkoṇaṃ madhyatastryasraṃ vidhāyātra śivāṃ yajet ḍākinyādyāśca ṣaṭkoṇe aṣṭāsre ghasmarādikāḥ sarvabakṣā sahasrākṣī niḥsaṅgā saṃhṛtipriyā trīkṣaṇānvitāṃ prativaktramiti śeṣaḥ | dhyāyediti śeṣaḥ samatrirekhaṃ tryasrañca yathāmānaṃ kṛtvā tatrārcayet acintyāmaprameyāñca pūrṇarūpāṃ durāsadām

vahirdvāreṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet prāgudīritāḥ valihomāvasānāntamiti samyak samīritam taddaśāṃśaṃ tarpaṇañca homaṃ kuryācca goghṛtaiḥ homañca kuryādityarthaḥ | samīritaṃ pūjanamiti śeṣaḥ ajādighṛtanivṛttyarthaṃ gograhaṇam p. 358) pūjācakre vahirbhūtaṃ caturasre tvakhaṇḍite sarvamadhye tāragarbhe śaktimākhyāsamanvitām aṣṭakaṃ vahirapyevaṃ vāhye dikṣu nava kramāt samastaṃ vāñchitaṃ pūjādhāraṇaṃ sthāpanaiḥ śive catuṣṭayaṃ proktayantre vairṇaistatsthānato likhet evaṃ yantrāṇi jāyante daśa teṣāmanukramāt yairiṣṭamakhilaṃ prāpnotyayantrāt sādhako dhruvam kuryāditi kramānnavagrahāṇāṃ syustattadvāreṣu taddiśi rāhuketū sthitau yatra tadrāśyadhipavārake vibhaktyā bhājane samyak prīṇayāmīti saṃlikhet sarveṣvapi ca vāreṣu sarveṣāṃ prītisiddhaye evaṃ yantreṣu daśasu pūjitā nityayā saha dvitīyāntaṃ samyak prīṇayāmīti vākyāntaṃ vilikhediti saumyāḥ saumyagatānāntu phalānyeva vitanvate likhiteṣvarcciteṣvevaṃ kumāraṃ kanyakāntu vā tathāvidhaṃ kumāraṃ vā saṃsthāpyābhyarcya vidyayā prasūnairaruṇaiḥ śubhraiḥ saurabhādyairathāpi vā tato devyā samāviṣṭe tasmin saṃpūjya yatnataḥ sarvamadhye devyarccanācca proktaphalasiddhiriti

pūjayettāṃ tataḥ pṛcchedabhīṣṭaṃ kathayecca sā janmāntarāṇyatītāni sarvaṃ saṃpūjitā vadet sahasravāraṃ sthiradhīḥ pūrṇātmā vicaret sukhī tatra saṃsthāpya gadinam abhyarcyodīritakramāt proktā tat sakalaṃ tasya nideśādapayāti ca svātmanyudvāsya pūrṇāśayaḥ sukhī vicarediti japan vidyāṃ smaran sādhyāṃ sadya ākṛṣyate'tha sā nirastetarasadbhāvā manmathārttābhiyāti sā rājāno rājaputrā vā tathānye cāpi kecana vaśagā dāsavadbhūmau tiṣṭhantyāmaraṇād dhruvam tattaccakrasya madhyasthaṃ veṣṭavidyājapānvitam sādhakasyādeśena sa rogo'payātīti rājādayaḥ sādhyavargāḥ manaḥṣaṣṭhāni cākarṣenmanasā prāgvadātmani tatastamutthāpya mukhe kṣiptvārghyāmbu vadettataḥ śāktaśāmbhavabhedābhyāṃ dvayoraikyātmayāmalāt smara dāhārṇakān saptetyuktvā prāgvadudīkṣaṇāt saṃsthāpya tajjīvakarṇe vidyāṃ vadediti śāmbhavantu śṛṇu prājñe vedhamadbhutavigraham svayaṃ praviśya taddehamekībhūtvā punaḥ svake kṛtanyāsajapārccastu tattanuṃ vahninā dahet iti vedhatrayaṃ proktaṃ tvadbhāvasiddhisūcakam jñānamanyacca sakalaṃ saṃkramettetna tat samaḥ lohairviracite paṭṭe phalakāyāṃ śilātale devīmāvāhya tatraiva pūjayecchaktibhiryutām

māsaṃ maṇḍalamityevaṃ kramādiṣṭamavāpnuyāt anyacca sakalantviṣṭamavāpnotyarccanādbhutam sādhayet prathamenaiva yantre,na yatnataḥ śive itarābhyāmasyeti pūjayet proktakālena phalānyuktānyavāpnuyāt sahasravāraṃ tannityāvidyāṃ tadvāsitāmbubhiḥ pramehaistrividhairghoramūtrakṛcchraiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ jīvecca suciraṃ bhūmau nīrogaḥ svasthamānasaḥ tale bhūmau tataḥ khātvā tatrāgniṃ jvālayet sadā taccotkṣipya salile na prakṣipeccedvinaśyati tatrākāramehavāriko rogaviśeṣaḥ | svasthamānasaḥ ādhirāhityāt yantraṃ | salile na jalāśaye vinaśyati tadā dāhajvareṇa ripurityarthaḥ prāpnoti vijayaṃ prokteṣvakhileṣu suniścitam sarvadā jayinaḥ sarve bhavantyetasya vaibhavāt vaśe bhavanti manujā dantino vājinaḥ striyaḥ mandocce sthāpayet kvāpi suvaddhantviṣṭakāpuṭe vādecchāṃ sakalañcānyadaniṣṭaṃ stambhayed dhruvam tatrārcayennityaśastāṃ sandhyāsu bhavane nije pūjanānnityakramataḥ | dinaiḥ prāgvat bhavatyeva maheśāni vicitrā yantraśaktayaḥ pīṭhe vā tatra tāṃ devīṃ gurāvuccaṃ gate dine vāsāṃsi ca vicitrāṇi bhūṣaṇānyapyavāpnuyāt tadālipto vrajed yatra kutrāpi janasaṃsadi tadiṣṭasādhikā yāvajjīvamasyānubhāvataḥ yadyattairīritaṃ sarvaṃ kāryyametat susādhayet

devīsambuddhiḥ evamarkādīnāmapyuktaḥ kālaḥ | tathā nityakramataḥ sādhyā | asya prayogasya saṃsthāpya kumbhaṃ vidhinā japitvogre grahe tadā na bhavecca bhavedevaṃ vaśyo yantreṣvaśeṣataḥ nivedyañca praṇamyārcya dadyācchivatmavāpnuyāt ekādaśasthaphaladā nityaśo yajanādapi vilikhyābhyarcya tadvidyāvide dadyāt supūjitam sarvamadhye nāmākṣaravinyāsabhedataḥ | etaddaśamaṃ yantram bhavantīti nityārcakasya nityānāmekāṃ pūjayituṃ tu vā paścimāmukhamāsīnaṃ tasmai proktavidhānataḥ bhukte ca jaṭharasparśajapādapi suniścitam prokteṣu daśayantreṣu pratyekañca trivāsaram samṛddho jīvati ciramarogaḥ sumanā bhuvi tasmai dadyāditi bhāskarasahitāṃ devīṃ | tatra bhāskarārccanasthānaṃ prāgvaditi taddineṣu taducceṣu kāleṣu ca tadarcanāt tathā tarpaṇahomābhyāṃ japadānādināpi vā tattat kṣobhaṃ vilikhyāntaḥ pūjayedvairimardane uparāge same bhūmau dinaśo jayamāpnuyuḥ bhāṇḍe nave pañcagavye khārimāṇe pacecca tat dānaṃ suvarṇapaṭṭasya yantrāṅkitasya uparāge grahaṇe ravicandrayorityanvayaḥ | āpnuyuḥ śatravaḥ ghṛtena vidyayā hutvā tadbhasmādāya tatra vai

tatastadbhasma saṃgṛhya nidadhyāddinaśo'rcayet gadacoragrahāriṣṭakleśā na syuśca tadgṛhe bhakṣaṇaṃ sarvakṛtyādi duritārttivibhañjakam svaratrayaṃ kramād yuñjyāttena tānyekaviṃśatiḥ tadantarvṛttamadhyasthaṃ ṣaḍasrañca vidhāya tu vilikhedagramārabhya prādakṣiṇyena pārvati śiṣṭe sādhyākṣarantvagre likhet pañcadaśasvapi bhavanti yantrāṇi tathā taiḥ kukṣyagniḥ pravarttate spṛśan vidyāṃ japellakṣa tadvarṇakṛtasampuṭam tattoyenānnapākābhiṣekato bhavati dhruvam jāyate parameśāni nityānāṃ vaibhavāditi asyā niṣphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtam cirantanapāpāni nāśayitvā jaṭharāgnivṛddhikarāṇi bhavantīti paripūrṇaṃparāmṛṣṭam proktā tatkalpamadhunā śṛṇu sarbārthasiddhidam dhyānaṃ śaktīḥ pūjanañca sādhanaṃ tatphalāni ca upāyaiḥ pañcabhistaistaiḥ sādhayedakhilepsitam ṣaḍaṅgāni yathāpūrvaṃ mātṛkāṃ vidyayā nyaset | etairhomādibhiḥ kulasundarīpaṭaloktakramādityarthaḥ navaratnakirīṭāñca citrapaṭṭāṃśukojjvalām sarvānandamayīṃ nityāṃ samastepsitadāyinīm dadhānāṃ maṅgalāpadmakarṇikānavayonigām navayonāvaṣṭavargayutā vrāhmyādikā yajet navayoniṃ proktamānena kuryyāditi

hetīśca parito devyāḥ pūjayettadbhujāntike pūjayettattadākārāṃstattanmantrairyathāvidhi sarvāsāmapi nityānāṃ yadādyāsyandajā imāḥ evaṃ saṃsādhitā vidyā viniyogāya kalpate prāgvat saparyyādikaṃ tat samānamevetyarthaḥ daśāṃśamannājyādibhirhomañca kuryyādityarthaḥ yenātimandabhāgyo'pi śrīmān bhoktā sukhī bhavet prāpnoti maṇḍalāddhomāt sitaistaiśca mahāyaśaḥ suvarṇaṃ samavāpnoti nidhiṃ vā ca sudhāntu vā dhānyāni vividhānyāśu subhagaḥ sa bhevennaraḥ tadaktairapi kahlārairhavanādrājavallabhaḥ caturvidhantu pāṇḍityaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ kanyakāṃ labhate yatnāt samastaguṇasaṃyutām kṣaudrāktaṃ juhuyāttadvadayatnāddhanadopamaḥ prasūnairaruṇaistadvattathā bandhūkasambhavaiḥ sitaraktaistu militairāyurārogyamāpnuyāt tathā guḍucyā homena pāyasena tilena vā havanācchriyamāpnoti sā tadanvayagā bhavet tatpaṅkamarditairhomāt kahlārairvikacaiḥ śubaiḥ niḥsapatno nirātaṅko nirdvandvo nirmalāśayaḥ tathaiva karavīrotthaiḥ prasūnairaruṇaiḥ sitaiḥ tathaiva campakairhomādrūpājīvā vaśaṃ nayet labhate'nupamāṃ lakṣmīmapi pāpiṣṭhacetanaḥ lakṣmī suṣprāpatvāt

ardhendukuṇḍe niyataṃ vidviṣṭā ripavo'mbike mṛtyuvījairnimbatailasiktairhomāttu dantinaḥ akṣabījaistu tailāktairhomaḥ sarvavināśavān tathaivākṣatarūdbhūtapañcāṅgahavanādapi taddine syādapasmārī vairī bhavati niścitam tadyonipiśitaistaiśca havanaṃ mṛtyukṛdripoḥ jāyante veriṇaḥ kuṣṭharogā dehavilāpakāḥ dāhajvareṇa grastaḥ syādarātistaddinairdhruvam gurumukhādavagantavyāni | tailāktaistilasambhavatailārkteḥ snigdhaiḥ samprāptasadvidyairjapahomādi kārayet vidyābhiranyathā siddhaṃ mantramapyāśu nāśayet vittāśayā vā na kadāpyācaredbhūtikāmukaḥ anayā vidyayā karmāṇyaśeṣāṇi maheśvari yaiḥ sarvve sarvvadā sarvvasamīhitamavāpnuyuḥ sarvvatrokteṣu vidhivat sthāneṣu parameśvari svarakṣāvidhānavaiparītyena ācarennigraham abhicāryyāṇāṃ tatroktānāmityarthaḥ tadvahiḥ ṣaḍdalaṃ padmaṃ tattattrayañca saṃlikhet trikoṇeṣu ca ṣaṭkoṇe ṣaṭpatreṣu samālikhet antarvṛttāntaradvandve bhūtārṇāṃśca kriyocitān mātṛkāṃ vilikhenmāyābinduyuktāṃ kramotkramāt parastāttu śatenāpi ṣaṣṭyā kūṭairlikhet pavim taistu koṣṭhāni jāyante navāśītiśatadvayam tato vajraṃ bhavenmadhye tvekaṣaṣṭyā śatātmakam madhyakoṣṭhe likhedvidyāṃ sādhyākhyākarmmasaṃyutām

prāgvadārabhya vilikhet prādakṣiṇyapraveśataḥ ṣaḍviṃśatisaṃkhyāni yantrāṇi sambhavantīti samastābhīṣṭadaṃ sarvvavijayaśrīpradaṃ śubham etadviṣamaṃ mahadvajrayantraṃ proktaphalasiddhi pradamiti saptaviṃśati nakṣatrasamānyetāni cedapi viniyogakramañcaiva susphuṭaṃ parameśvari svaveśmani vidhāyaitat pīṭhe bhūmitale'pi vā trirātraṃ saptarātraṃ vā saptaviṃśatirātrakam nidhāyābhyarccya gadinamabhiṣiñcettataḥ sukhī teṣāṃ vilekhanadravyāṇyākarṇaya vadāmi te kāśmīramaguruṃ kuṣṭhaṃ elākakkolajātibhiḥ jalairnakṣatravṛkṣotthaiḥ śubhairbbā sūkṣmapeṣitaiḥ vāde vivāde samare dyūteṣu ca jayī bhavet devyātmarūpāttenāsya tairbbādhā na bhaved dhruvam saṃgrāmagamanaṃ varṣāmudyogaṃ vācamāgraham tattattithiṣu taiḥ prāgvadvāñchitānāpnuyād dhruvam vāreśānapi saṃpūjya tattat phalamavāpnuyāt vārarkṣatithisaṃproktayantre tāṃ taiśca daivataiḥ rogaśāntiṃ samudyogaphalābhīṣṭānyavāpnuyāt samudyogaphalāni prārabdhakāryyaphalāni ṛkṣavṛkṣāṃstathā yonī rnigade parameśvari mātaraśca tathā durgā diśo dhanadakeśavau nakṣatradevatāścāpi śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhi guruḥ sarpāśca pitaraḥ aryyamā bhaga eva ca indro niṛtitoyākhyau viśvedevā haristathā

ahirbradhnastathā pūṣā proktā nakṣatradevatāḥ khadiraḥ kṛṣṇavaṃśau ca pippalo nāgarohiṇau vakulaḥ saralaḥ sarjo vañjulaḥ panasastathā madhūkaśceti saṃproktā vṛkṣā mānāṃ kramādamī ajāmārjāramūṣāśca mūṣikā vṛṣamāhiṣī gokarṇo vānarī siṃhī turagā siṃhagogajāḥ mūhurtaiḥ saṃkhyayāhobhiḥ śāntiḥ syāddviguṇena vā sarveṣāṃ nāmāni gurumukhādavagantavyāṇi ced rogiṇo dehatyāga iti sampradāyaḥ prokteṣu bhāvayettāni tāvanti maṇipūrake viśuddhākhye ca catvāri pañcājñāyāmiti kramāt tattaccakragatāḥ sarvā bhāvayet sarvasampade natu sarvatra sarbbāṇi bhāvayenna kadāca proktānyādhārapadmāni kṛtvā tatrārcayecchivām saṃpūjya devīmiṣṭāni prāpnuyāt proktavāsaraiḥ prokteṣu proktānyeva bhāvanīyāni phalānyavāpnuyādityupadiśati pañcāśanmithunānāñca proktacakre'rddharātrake mithunoktakrame śaktimantravaccakragāminām taisteṣāṃ teṣu kāleṣu valiṃ dadyāttatheritaiḥ vidhāya tasya madhye tu kṛtvā dīpaṃ ghṛtāplutam pratyekaṃ devatānāṃ vā mithunānāmathāpi vā kulmāṣapāyasānnena vyañjanaṃ chāgamāṃsayuk sādhayet saptabhiḥ pakṣānmāsānmaṇḍalato'pi bā pratyabdaṃ vā gṛhe mantrī jīvedādyāmahodayaḥ

smaraṇāt kīrttanāt sarvavāñchitānāpnuyurnarāḥ yaistuṣṭiṃ prāpya tānyāśu prayacchantyabhivañchitam pañcānāṃ mudgabhinnānnaṃ pañcānāṃ dadhibhaktakam pañcānāṃ nārikelasya phalakṣodaṃ guḍānvitam mithunārccārato nityaṃ yo'sau syānmāntrikāgraṇīḥ smaraṇānmithunānāṃ kālarūpitvānusandhānāt asyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtam mithunānāṃ dravyāṇi | asau arccakaḥ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam sā vidyā kurukullāyāḥ pañcaviṃśākṣaroditā saptabhiḥ prathamā proktā trayodaśayutā purā evaṃ sā tribhirapyetairvidyārūpairabhīṣṭadā dvīpe tāṃ lalitāṃ nityavinodānanditāṃ yajet sā kurukullā sampradāyaḥ tatsāgareṣu parito ratnapotacarīṃ yajet valicakrañca tenaiva tanmadhye ca samarccayet kṛtvā tadantaḥ padmañca sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vālayā kṛtvā tenārghyamapi sādhayet || 8 || tanmadhye ratnapītamadhye tannāmamantreṇa tadarccayediti pañcaviṃśatyakṣarayā trivārādahīnamabhyarccayecca dhyātvatthaṃ parivāraistāṃ devīṃ gandhādibhiḥ kramāt dadhānāṃ cintayedvāṇaṃ cāpapāśatuṇīḥ karaiḥ ṛtusnātāḥ sphuradyonyaḥ sadānandāruṇekṣaṇāḥ

tatastadājñayā rohe bhrāmiṇīṃ drāviṇīṃ yajet sūryyasomaṃ tithivāraṃ yogarkṣakaraṇānyapi sampradāyaḥ vyomavāyvagnitoyakṣmārūpiṇīśaktisaṃyutam ghrāṇān buddhiṃ tathāśaktimaṣṭapatreṣu pūjayet tato vāṇān dhanuḥpāśamaṅkuśañcābhito yajet śaktīryaṣṭvātha tanmadhye sambidāsanamarccayet tatastadājñayā potaparītaṃ dvīpamāgataḥ parīyamāṇe dikṣvetānarccayettatra tatra vai namo'ntairnāmabhiḥ pūrbbaṃ pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ tṛtīyenetyarthaḥ evaṃ samarccitaṃ devyā lalitāyāḥ priyaṅkaram prasīdati yatastasmāt pūjayedevamīśvari pañcaviṃśārṇamūlena pūjānte parameśvari tāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ priye vacmi tārāvidyāṃ daśākṣarīm rayo dharānvitaḥ paścādrayayugmaṃ marudyutam ṣaṣṭhaṃ tadaṣṭamaṃ vidyāt hṛdambumarudanvitam tanmantrā yathā hrīḥ śrīḥ ikṣusāgarāya namaḥ ityādayaḥ devī iti śeṣaḥ | īśvarīti devīsambuddhiḥ svatantrapūjākramamupadiśati anayāsyā valiṃ dadyādvidyayā parameśvari asyāstoyeṣu sarbbatra bādho na bhavit smṛteḥ dadhānāṃ bahuvarṇābhirvvahurūpābhirāvṛtām ratnapādukayoḥ nyastapadāmbujayugāṃ smaret sugandhibhiḥ sitaiḥ puṣpairannājyābhyāṃ ghṛtena vā

japitvā pūjayet sandhyāsvatha tarpaṇahomakam ṣoḍaśārṇena valiriti sampradāyaḥ | parameśvarīti debīsambuddhiḥ nityahomadravyāṇyupadiśati | tatra vā vikalpe evaṃ saṃsiddhavidyastu nityārccāniratastathā homena pūjayā yantrabhāvanena ca tān śṛṇu sarṣapasnehasaṃsiktairmaricairānayecca tāḥ nārīnaranṛpānanyān vaśayed yāvadāyuṣam havanādvanitāḥ sarbbā mohayet premakautukaiḥ vaśayecchatapatraiśca tathā vicakilaiḥ śubhaiḥ phalakṣodaiḥ sitayutairhavanāt svarṇamāpnuyāt prāguktakālato bittanicayaṃ samavāpnuyāt kahlārahomato'bhīṣṭaṃ labhate kumudadvayaiḥ raktapuṣpādiṣvanyatamena tatra nityārccānirataḥ puraścaraṇānantaramapi | tān prayogān padmaiḥ sitairlohitaiśca pūjayedindirāptaye japāvandhūkakusumaistathā dāḍimajairapi punnāgajaiḥ pāṭalaiśca campakotthairyajecchive proktakāleṣu vittāṭyo dharādhānyāṃśukādimān labhate proktakālena tathā kālāgurudravaiḥ karpūrairāyuṣaḥ siddhai vaśyastrīdhanasiddhaye kandarpasamasaubhāgyo vanitāsu naro bhavet abdamātraṃ tato loke viśrutaḥ syāt sa vaibhavaiḥ pūjitaistaistu jagdhaiḥ syānnaroyātyakhilapriyaḥ kumudadvayaiḥ raktasitaiḥ navayoniṃ vidhāyātra madhye māyāṃ sasādhyakām

bahirdaleṣvapi tathā likheddvidbikrameṇa vai krameṇa cābhisaṃveṣṭya tena yantreṇa sādhayet yantraṃ rocanayālikhya bhūrje vā kṣaumakhaṇḍake yajanataḥ | taiḥ karpūrādibhiḥ | jagdhairbhakṣitaiḥ tāpayedrātriṣu dinaiḥ prāguktaiḥ striyamānayet tatra devīṃ samāvāhya pūjayettairdinairbhavet gajavājitarakṣāditiyyagajātīrapi dhruvam gaurakeṇa samāvāhya devīṃ tatraiva pūjayet lābhāśca pūjanāttatra paśudāsīdhanādinām putrapautrakalatrājñādhanadhānyādimān bhavet samastarogaduḥkhārttirahito varddhate sukhī koṣṭheṣu pañcaviṃśatsu trīṇi koṇeṣu mārjayet tanmadhye śaktimāyāsthāmālikhyākhyāṃ tato'bhitaḥ vāñchitāṃ vanitāṃ mānakulalajjātilaṅghinīm paṭṭaśuṇṭhīmāgadhikāmaricārkapayoyutam vidyāṃ trayodaśārṇāntu taddigvaktro dinaiḥ striyam valālaṃghanīyavacanataḥ | vādvayaṃ vikalpārthaḥ avasthābhiśca daśabhirmṛtimeti suniścitam madhūcchiṣṭapratikṛtaiḥ ṛju taṃ tāpayettathā karoti yāvaddehāntaṃ te pratīpā lapanti ca japitvā dhārayet sarvarogaduḥkhārttināśanam tadā striyaḥ śayānasya vairiṇyo dāsasannibhāḥ bhūḥ svagarbhagataṃ nāma vilikhyāstriṣu ṣaṭsvapi tadyantrasahitāmbaramitiśeṣaḥ yantrametattālapatre bhūrjekṣaume'rkapatrake

tatra sthitā yebhujagāḥ palāyante'tha taddine vidhāya nityaśaḥ pūjāsamete rakṣato gṛhe yakṣagandharvabhujagavṛścikādyā na tatra vai sahasravāraṃ salilairāsekaḥ kṣveḍanāśanaḥ dehagaṃ parameśāni trividhaṃ bhīṣaṇātmakam tadrūpaṃ phaṇinaṃ vidyājapapūrvvaṃ nakhādinā evaṃ sarvvaṃ triprakrāraṃ garalaṃ nāśayedidam tatra tairveṣṭayet sapta bhoginaṃ na brajedvahiḥ taiḥ ṣoḍaśasvaropetaiḥ saṃkhyāṣṭau ca śatadvayam bahiḥ vālukāveṣṭhanāt bahiḥ prāgvattatastaiḥ syād yantrāṇyaṣṭau maheśvari dvitīyādīni yantrāṇi sapta bhānvādivāsare vārākhyāṃ saptamīyuktāmālikhet sādhayeti tat proktakrameṇa vidhinā śāntimarcanatastathā sampādayediti tannāśayanti tatpotamadhau sarbbaṃ tathā śive vāñchiteṣu samasteṣu tairdinaistānyavāpnuyāt śatrubhaṅgaṃ vaśaṃ nārīnṛpamarttyādijanminām dvāviṃśatiṃ tataścaikacatvāriṃśaccatuḥśatam pañcapañcāśadanyāni koṣṭhavajra maheśvari madhye'vaśiṣṭanavakamadhye nāmodarāṃ likhet sakalaprāṇijātaviṣayaḥ trikoṇeṣu ca sādhyāni likhedvajramitīritam vilikhyābhyarccya tadyantraṃ pote rakṣati vāridhau yantreṇānena kālena proktena satataṃ śive

śive iti devīsambuddhiḥ ākarṣantīṃ svapādānte sāñjaliṃ praṇatiṃ muhuḥ sādhyo narotha nārī ca vaśameti suniścitam protakeśasamākṛṣṭaṃ japet prāgvadbaśī bhavet svayamevānayettāntu smaran jāpairbbaśaṃ nayet lalitāvigrahā yena vaśinyādiyutā tataḥ asyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtam iti ṣoḍaśanityātantre śrīkādimate dvāviṃśata paṭalam | yena lalitāvigrahavattvakāraṇena | tataḥ kāraṇāt taddvidhā kathitā pūrvaṃ tadaṅgāni ca pūjanam homairyantraiśca vakṣyāmi samastābhīṣṭasiddhaye daśabhiḥ saptabhiḥ saptasaṃkhyairjātibhiranvitam vidhāya cakraṃ tatraiva svanāmnāvāhya pūjayet pūrvaṃ tṛtīye paṭale | sādhanaṃ vidyāyā iti śeṣaḥ namaḥ ityādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ | anvita kriyāviśeṣaṇametat sarvamadhye samabhyarccya vāmadakṣāgrakoṇataḥ ādyabījāntyasaprāṇairupetāmatha pūjayet vṛtte caiva mahālakṣmīṃ pañcamīṃ madhyatastathā tadagre tāṃ japedvidyāṃ sahasramathavā śatam ghṛtena vā tato vidyā siddhā syādaṣṭatastataḥ vidyāṃ japellakṣasaṃkhyāṃ taddaśāṃśena tarpaṇam gurubhaktaḥ susantuṣṭaḥ śāntacittaḥ kṣamānvitaḥ sidhyatyayatnato devyāḥ prasādādvaibhavādapi ākaṇṭhaṃ vanitārūpāṃ jvalatpiṅgaśiroruhām proktanityabhajanataḥ

pāśañca muśalaṃ śīramabhayaṃ varadaṃ tathā nitthapūjāsu tacchaktīstatsamānāḥ smarecchive gajārūḍhāṃ hayārūḍhāṃ tārkṣyārūḍhāñca śaktibhiḥ tatprayogeṣu ca tathā dhyāyettattadavāptaye āvṛtāṃ pañcamīṃ dhyāyan japedvaśyāptaye'niśam tacchaktīḥ parivāraśaktīḥ smarediti nityapūjāsviti pūrvatrānvayaḥ | saheti śeṣaḥ | vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa aruṇākalpāṃ padmarāgādibhiḥ kṛtākalpām pītaśaktyāvṛtāṃ dhyāyet stambhaneṣu tu sarccadā śaktibhiḥ svasamānābhirantābhiḥ samāyutām svātmānaṃ bhāvayanmantrī vrajedakliṣṭavaibhavaḥ gavayairbhujagairbhīmairdantibhirmmadamantharaiḥ bhūtapretapiśācādyairākule'raṇyasaṅkaṭe smareddevīmuktarūpāṃ nirātaṅko brajet sukhī saṅkaṭeṣu duranteṣu smṛtvetthaṃ vijayī bhavet pītaśaktyāvṛtāṃ pītavarṇābhiḥ śaktibhirāvṛtām proktopasaṃhārārthartvātvānna punaruktidoṣaḥ cakrañca dakṣiṇairvibhradvāhubhirbhīmavigrahām pāśaṃ śaṅkhañca dadhatīmanyairnīlāṃ svaśaktibhiḥ vairisenāṃ samastāñca nipātya parighairbhuvi carantīṃ śaktivṛndaiśca bhīmārāvairmmadoddhataiḥ taddehaniryyadraktāktaśūlāṃ devīṃ vicintayet saptarātraprayogeṇa vairiṇaṃ mārayej jvarāt kadalīketusaṅkulaṃ kadalīnibhagajapatākāsaṅkulaṃ deśamiti śeṣaḥ ekāgracittaḥ

ripudehaṃ smaret pherukaṅkakravyādakukkuraiḥ prāgvattāvaddinairvārihataṃ smṛ (śru)tvā samuttaret utpāṭayantīṃ saṃcintya japan śatrūn yamaṃ nayet krodhaṃ saṃśayedvāde vivāde samare'pi ca vṛtāṃ tārkṣyagaṇoddāmapakṣamārutamūrcchitām vārihataṃ jale mṛtaṃ ripumiti śeṣaḥ saṃcintya japan śatruṃ mārayediti sampradāyārthaḥ sampradāyārthaḥ senāmityanenānvayaḥ | kṣaṇāt smṛtimātreṇa tathaivāṣṭabhujaiḥ khadgān dadhānāṃ śaktibhirvṛtām vikīryya keśānaruṇavāravāṇadharo hayaiḥ śaktivṛndaistriśūlāgraprotapattyaśvavāraṇaiḥ dhyāyannarāteḥ pṛtanā nāśayet svairvalairnṛpaḥ prāguktairmmaṇḍalādyaistu vāsaraiḥ parameśvari iṣṭamanyacca sakalaṃ stambhayet sādhakaḥ kṣaṇāt śeṣaḥ | tathaiva japādinā | kṣaṇāt prāgvat hayavṛndasahito hayārūḍho nṛpaḥ śatrusenāṃ svavalairnāśayediti prāgvat nihantukāmaḥ sarvāṃstu ripuṃ kuryyādvaśe dhruvam yamakaṇṭakakāle vā kṛṣṇapuṣpaistathāvidhām śyāmāñca saurabhādyaistaiḥ puṣpairabhyarccya vāsaraiḥ sukhaṃ jīvati bhūmau sa śatavarṣāṇi viśrutaḥ śeṣaḥ | aruṇaiḥ aruṇavarṇaiḥ madhyarātrataḥ madhyarātre prāguktamaṇḍalādyaiḥ pūrvatrānvayaḥ

haridrāmilitairannaistilairmmāṣaiḥ sataṇḍulaiḥ sakalīkṛtya likhitasādhyavarṇasamanvitaiḥ niśācūrṇairghṛtāktaistu homaḥ stambhayate tathā māṃsaistaddehasambhūtasnehāktairhavanāddinaiḥ dahanairvvāraṇairanyaiḥ prasādaiḥ kaṇṭakādibhiḥ śatrubhirbbā prayogāmī na bhavantyeva bhaṅgurāḥ ghṛtāktairghṛtapariplutaiḥ | tathā maṇḍalādibhiḥ dhyāyan riporaṣṭame tu rāśau chāgaghṛtāplutaiḥ tībradāhajvaragrastaṃ visaṃjñaṃ vikṛtāṅgakam sarūpavatsāruṇagoghṛtāktairaruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ japāprasūnaiḥ pālāśaiḥ karavīrasamudbhavaiḥ aśokajaiḥ kusumbhātthairanyaiḥ puṣpaiśca lohitaiḥ anyairapi ca tatsaktaparairaṅgaiḥ suniścitam viśeṣyaṃ | taddinaiḥ prāgvat vikṛtāṅgakaṃ asvādhīnāṅgam chatracāmarādibhiḥ paricchadaiḥ madhyarātre hunet sādhyadiṅmukho maricaistathā bhavet kīrttīndirāyuktaściraṃ jīvati bhutale bhaumākṣarāṇi tadbāhye daśāgrādabhito likhet mantrākṣarāṇi ṛtuśastadvahirvṛttayugmakam tatkoṇeṣvantarāleṣu mantrārṇān bhūdaśānvitān proktairdinaiḥ prāgvanmaṇḍalādibhiḥ apivā apicetyarthaḥ vilomamātṛkāṃ tatra nyasya bhūmipuraṃ vahiḥ pūjayannakhilaṃ lokaṃ stambhayedarivāhinīm prāpnotīti caturasrañca saṃlikhya mantrārṇān ṣaṭ ṣaḍālikhet

caturasre ca vilikhet pratilomānulomakam stambhaḥ syāt pūrbbamuktānāṃ vidhānāt parameśvari pūjayannarātigatyādikaṃ stambhayatīti aṣṭāsraṃ tadvahirbbṛtte iti kṛtvātra vinyaset trayaṃ trayaṃ sam1ālikhya vahiḥ śiṣṭantu pārthivaiḥ sthāpayet kvāpi tatraiva nityaśaśca valiṃ kṣipet pūrvoktaphalaṃ prāpnotīti kramāttrikoṇavṛttāntarālān ṣaṭkoṇasaṃyutān vilikhellipiśaḥ sarvvāṃ mātṛkāṃ śaktisaṃyutām māyāmadhyagataṃ devi dhārayet sarbbasiddhaye gajavājikharoṣṭrādirogaśāntyai ca dhārayet rekhāgre sarvvataḥ śūlāstanmadhyāgre ca pārśvayoḥ parito vilikhenmantravarṇān bhaumasamanvitān gṛhapaṭṭanayorlohadṛśadoriṣṭasiddhidam proktakramasandhāraṇāt proktaphalasiddhiriti sthāpayedbhittimadhye ca bhūmau ca kramataḥ śive yāvatphalāpti kurvīta niyataṃ sandhyayordvayoḥ taistu koṣṭhāni jāyante pañcaviṃśaiḥ śatadvayam aṣṭāviṃśati koṣṭhāni tataḥ śiṣṭeṣu dikṣvapi madhye triṣu tu koṣṭheṣu sādhyasādhakakarmma ca mantrārṇānagramārabhya vilikhedabhitaḥ śive pūjayannabhīṣṭaṃ phalamāpnotīti yatraitat sthāpitaṃ lohaśilādilikhitaṃ śive bhūtapretapiśācādikopajāścāpyupaplavāḥ vāstumarmmādiduḥkhādi śamayed gehagañca tat

kṛtyābhicārakṣudrādi pīḍā na bhavati dhruvam prāṇapratiṣṭhādipuraḥsaramabhyarcya sthāpanāt proktaphalasiddhiriti tairvvajrarūpakoṣṭhāni ekaviṃśaśatambhavet agrādabhita evānyānyakṣarāṇi samālikhet sthāpitaṃ lohaśilādilikhitaṃ pūjitantu vā anyāni kleśakārīṇi yāni tāni vināśayet vilikhya madhye kumbhantu kṣīradrukkāthapūritam spṛśañjalaṃ japedvidyāṃ sahasratrayamātmavān taiḥ kleśairmuktadehastu sukhī jīvati bhūtale saikaviṃśaśate vāpi kumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya secayet dvyaṅgule dvyaṅgule kuryyādekādaśa tataḥ kramāt ekādaśa tatasteṣu prāṅmadhyāttu pradakṣiṇam rekhāgrāṇi ca śūlāni kṛtvā sādhyañca madhyataḥ anyatamaṃyantre ityarthaḥ nāsādhyamasti bhuvane vidyayā siddhayā'nayā asyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam trayoviṃśaṃ paṭalam paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam kathayāmi śṛṇu prājñe vāñchitārthasuradrumān prayogeṣu samasteṣu vāhyābhyantarataḥ kramāt dhyāyeddevīḥ samastāśca lohitākāramaṇḍanāḥ vidveṣoccāṭanidhananigraheṣvasitāḥ smaret sarvvatra svasamākāravarṇaśaktibhirāvṛtāḥ vasanabhūṣaṇamālyānulepanādiviṣayaḥ ekadbyādisamārabdhairvvarṇākāraistu śaktayaḥ ko vā śṛṇoti sākalyāt tataḥ kiñcidvadāmi te

āpyāḥ sattvaguṇāḥ sarvvāḥ sitākārāḥ samīritāḥ āgneyā rājasāḥ sarvvā lohitākārasaṃyutāḥ dhyānabhedeṣu kiñcidvadāmīti vāyurūpā dhūmravarṇā sarvā dveṣādikārakāḥ āsāṃ mukhabhujādehavidhānaṃ śṛṇu pārvati ṣoḍaśāsyāḥ pañcaviṃśadvadanā api kāścana catuḥṣaṣṭimukhāstadvadekāśītiśatānanāḥ vāyunabhasorājasaguṇātmakatvabhastīti sampradāyaḥ prastauti | tatra pārvatītisambuddhiḥ tathāpi darśitaṃ kiñcidvaktre bhujadvayaṃ dvayam vasanti nānārūpāśca bhaveyustatra vāñchayā lalitāṅgitvarūpeṇa sarvāsāmātmavigrahāḥ tāttadvarṇāyudhākāravāhanaiśca susaṃyutāḥ iti tāsāṃ dhyānabhedāḥ sthūlāḥ proktā maheśvari sampradāyārthaḥ nityānām yena te sādhakāḥ sarvve vāṅchitaṃ prāpnuyuḥ kṣaṇāt vibhāvya tejonicaye tatra siddhiñca cintayet pūjātarpaṇahomādirahitaṃ bhāvanena vai nirvvātadīpasaṅkāśamātmanātmasamīkṣaṇāt parivāratvena sthitāśca dhyeyā bhavantīti prāpnotīti proktakrameṇa deveśi satataṃ sādhyasādhakaiḥ sādhayet pararūpantu sādhyaṃ sādhanasiddhaye

dhyānayoḥ karmmaṇā siddhiṃ vividhāṃ phalayogataḥ śṛṇu vakṣye maheśāni krameṇa tava sāmpratam pāṣāṅkuśau caturbbāhau ṣaḍbhuje cāpasāyakau paradhyānamiti vacanācca tadeva prāpyamiti yāvat dvisaṃkhyacatuḥsaṃkhyabhujādikrameṇa sukhapāṇyāyudhānāntu rūpasaṃkhyādivāñchayā tathā tasyāgrato bhūtvā pālayati tamādarāt daṃṣṭrogrā bhīmanayanavadanāḥ krūrakarmmasu śubhetareṣu tāḥ sarvvāḥ prayogeṣu tu sarvvadā virājamānāstāḥ sarvvā divyāṃśukadharā api rūpasaṃkhyādītyatrādiśabdaḥ proktaviṣayasaṃkhyetaraviṣayaḥ ityasya tathā ityanenānvayaḥ | āvirbhūyetyarthaḥ daṃṣṭrogrā ityuttarārddhenāśubhakarmmasu dhyānam navaratnamayaiḥ sarvvāstavakaiścopaśobhitāḥ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tattatkarmmasu siddhidam vyāghratārkṣyasamārūḍhā dhyeyā rakṣāsu sarvvadā piśācacoravyālādidurgame'raṇyavartmani ekaikaśaḥ samastā vā sukhī bhavati niścitam uccāṭaneṣu sarvvāstā bhīmā dhyeyāḥ sudāruṇāḥ sarvaprayogasādhāraṇāni | maheśvarīti devīsambuddhiḥ svasvaparivārasahitā vā | niścitamityantenāmoghaphalatvamucyate bhīmā vigrahādibhiriti | sudāruṇāḥ karmmaṇīti śeṣaḥ vidveṣaṇeṣu sarvāstā ghorapraharaṇākulāḥ cintayet sakalāḥ sarvvakṣudrakarmmasu sādhakaḥ

iti vāhanabhedena phalabhedāḥ samīritāḥ dvinetrāstvekavadanā daṃṣṭrogrā bhīmavigrahāḥ bhīmarāvābhirabhito veṣṭitā raṇamurddhani palāyanotsagahanāt pādayoḥ patanena vā tatra kauśikaḥ divābhītaḥ | ghorapraharaṇākulā ghorāyudhaniviḍāḥ vāhanaviśeṣamupadiśati || kṣudrakarmasu vaśyākarṣaṇādiṣu vibhāvya vā jaya yuddhe prāpnotyuktakrameṇa vai vāmaiḥ kodaṇḍanivahamanyaiḥ khaḍgañca vibhratīḥ vamadrudhiradhārāñca vijayaṃ proktamāpnuyāt caturaṅgaripoḥ senāṃ chindatīstaravāribhiḥ pattyaśvebharathāṭopavādyaniḥśanasaṅkule athavā navabhirhastairgadā vāmaistathetaraiḥ tadbhinnacaturaṅgāṃñca senāṃ vijayamāpnuyāt vijayī bhavati proktakramāddvāre raṇāṅgaṇe dhyātvā vā vijayī bhūyāt samare romaharṣaṇe dhyātvā vijayamāpnoti niyataṃ samare nṛpaḥ vijayaṃ samare śaśvadaśnute śaṅkaropamaḥ smṛtvā vijayamāpnoti nṛpaḥ proktakramād dhruvam cintayan samare mīme vijayī syāt suniścitam smaran pravijayaṃ yuddhe prāpnoti dhyānavaibhavāt prāgvat pramathitārātipṛtanāñcintayan japet taithaikādaśabhirbhedairāyudhairnighnatīrvvalam tathā smaraṇasaṃyuktaiḥ pūjayettāstadā'grahe tathaiva daśarūpaistairvāraiḥ praharaṇairyutāḥ praharantīstathārātīn smṛtvā jayamavāpnuyāt

praharantīḥ smared yuddhe jayī bhavati niścitam tathāvidhaiḥ praharaṇaiḥ smaran yuddhe jayī bhavet smṛtvā vijayamāpnoti samare tāśca ṣoḍaśa tathā tairhetinivahairvyākulakramahastakaiḥ evasuddāmasamarasaṃkaṭādiṣu cintayan taddhetibhiḥ pūrvoktaikādaśavidhadvandvahetibhiḥ devo vā rākṣaso yakṣaḥ kinnaro vā bhujaṅgamaḥ na kadācit smarannityaṃ bhaṅgamāpnoti niścitam dvividhairvairibhirjātaiḥ kṛcchre rājabhaye'thavā piśācaḍākinīvṛndabrahmarākṣasapīḍane smarannitthaṃ yajet sarvā vipado dhyānavaibhavāt sapādukāḥ samāgatya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ gāyantībhiśca nṛtyeṣu vanamālābhiranvitāḥ nāsādhyamasti bhuvane dhyānādāsāṃ maheśvari itthamabhīṣṭamukhakarāyudhādirūpataḥ | bhaṅgaṃ parājayam maheśvarīti sambuddhiḥ smerānanāśca gāyantīḥ smṛtvā viśvaṃ vaśaṃ nayet saṅgītāsaktamahilāvṛndasaṃkulamadhyagāḥ nānābhogasamopetāṃ prakhyātanijavaibhavām tathā saṅgitasaṃsaktaśaktivṛndasamanvitāḥ evaṃ tattrividhadhyānāt saubhāgyamatulaṃ yaśaḥ proktakramālaṅkṛtahayagajarathārūḍhadhyānāt | atulaṃ nirupamam pādukāsaktacaraṇā āgacchanti svaśaktibhiḥ nidhiṃ saṃprāpya bhuvane bhogī syād yāvadāyuṣam evaṃ campakapunnāganameruvakuleṣvapi

rājato dhanito'nyasmād yenāsau syāt sukhī ciram prāpnotyanargharatnāni bahūni dhyānavaibhavāt smaran kanakamāpnoti varṇotkṛṣṭamasaṃkhyakam yāvadāyuṣaṃ yāvajjīvam anantarapūrvoktaprakāreṇa syāttāvaddhanamityarthaḥ pūrvoktadhyānaprakāreṇa tathā prāgvat dhyānaprakāreṇa rūpayauvanaśīlāḍhyāḥ premanighnāstvananyagāḥ nṛpatiṃ kurute vaśyaṃ manovākkāyakarmmabhiḥ vaśīkaroti bhuvane prāṇinaścā viśeṣataḥ vāñchitaṃ samavāpnoti muktaḥ syānnigaḍāditaḥ vāñchitāni likhitvā tāḥ paṭeṣu navasu sphuṭam rathadantihayānāntu tiraskaraṇikāyutān vajrālikhitaniśānabherīpaṇavamarddalān śeṣaḥ | premanighnāḥ premaparavaśāḥ kṛtavandhanaviśeṣādiviṣayaḥ vajrādabhimukhaṃ vairī dhāvatyāśu parājitaḥ iti dhyānānyaśeṣeṇa kathitāni tavānaghe atastacchṛṇu vakṣyāmi sarvābhīṣṭābhikārakāḥ tanmadhye sādhyarūpañca nijavāñchānurūpakam tathā suṣumnāntastacca cintayedvā gamāgamam sādhakaśca tathā siddhastayorevāśusiddhikṛt iti sambuddhiḥ sūkṣmarūpadhyānaprayogeṣvanadhikāratvamucyate

asyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtam paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam varṇaistajjanitairmmantrairyantraiḥ kālātmatāṃ kramāt yajjñānopāstibhedābhyāṃ mantrāḥ sidhyanti varṇinaḥ teṣu tattvāni ṣaḍviṃśadvargā nāthanavātmikāḥ vāsanāpaṭalavakṣyamāṇāḥ sattvādivihīnāḥ mātṛkāyā navātmakā vargāsta eva navātmakā nāthāḥ syuriti mātṝṇāntu svaraireko vargaḥ pūrvavaduttaram ṣaṭsaptatyā pañcaśataṃ tatsaṃkhyābdaistu pūrṇatā pūrṇakālasamāvṛttiryugakalpādināmabhāk tasya turyyāṃśaturyyāṃśahānyā tretādisambhavaḥ yugakalpādiamabhāk yugakalpādisaṃjñā bhavati tān dinākṣarasaṃyuktānmadhyayonau samālikhet vāmordhvadakṣapārśveṣu pañca pañca samīritāḥ vyañjaneṣu tu sarvvatra suśliṣṭāḥ svena saṃyutāḥ rekaścaturyugo bhavatīti nigrahe vāstuvinyāse garbhanyāseṣṭasiddhikṛt ekaikaṃ mātṛkāvarṇapañcāśatparivṛttitaḥ savisarjanīyamitareṣu savindukaṃ likhediti padacchedaḥ | āgamānāṃ sandhirdivyatvādasmābhirna vicāraṇīyaḥ evaṃ yugādimārabhya kālātmārṇaiḥ pravarttate teṣu paryyāyanityārṇavarṇānālikhya bāhyataḥ nityāḥ ṣoḍhaśa deveśi pūjayennityamarccakaḥ ṣaṭṣaḍāvṛttayaḥ sambhavantīti adhamā māsamātreṇa māsādūrddhvamayogyatā

ṣaṭtriṃśattattvavarṇāstaddvitīyā marutā kramāt tripurāḥ sarvvasiddhānāmākarāḥ kathitāḥ kramāt proktakāle ṣoḍaśa nityāḥ samarccayediti yatra tatra gadālakṣmīgrahadurbhikṣaśātravāḥ abhīpsitāni sidhyanti tasya yo'rccati nityaśaḥ tāsāṃ saṃkhyā samākhyātā tadāvṛttistadāptikṛt vakṣyamāṇasaṃkhyā vidyāḥ sambhavantīti etadgranthitajāpena mantrāḥ sidhyanti varṇinaḥ catvāri ceti vijñeyāstattvāvṛttirudīritāḥ dviśataṃ ṣaṇavatyaśca niḥśeṣaṃ samudīritāḥ tā vidyāstattvarūpiṇyaḥ śeṣāstvante dviśaḥ smṛtāḥ ṣoḍaśaṣoḍaśasaṃkhyāvṛttiḥ niḥśeṣaṃ samastavyāptiḥ viśeṣato vidhātavyaṃ jayārogyādisiddhaye tatprakāraḥ prayogānāṃ paṭale sādhu vakṣyate ghaṭikākramayogena bhajante parivarttanam vṛttaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadasrañca tadvadaṣṭādaśāsrakam maṇḍalīkaraṇam caturasramatha tryasramiti bhedā nava kramāt tena dvāsaptatirbhedāsteṣu nityārṇabhedataḥ eteṣvādyasya vṛttasya vinyāsenānyadunnayet evaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kuryyādekaikāṅgulato vahiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadbhistatasteṣu nyasedarṇān tathāditaḥ bāhyābhyantaḥparāvṛttau tathā vyākīrṇamityapi cakraṃ saptatriṃśadbhirvṛttaiḥ | prāgvat ṣoḍaśāraiśca kuryāt yojayedvāhyakoṣṭhasthaiḥ prāguktavidhinā kramāt

aṣṭāsre ṣoḍaśārāḥ syuḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadvṛttamanyavat kṛtvā daleṣu kramaśo vāgdevyaṣṭakamālikhet vidhāya pūjayennityaṃ pustapūjoktasiddhaye na kadācicchriyo hānirbhaviṣyati ca tatkule śloke anyat sarvaṃ pūrvamevāsmābhirvyākhyātam tatra devīṃ samāvāhya saṃpūjya vidhivanniśi saṃpūjya śiṣyaṃ saṃsthāpya śaktyā tamabhiṣecayet kuryyāt karṣasuvarṇasya mudrikāṃ gāśca dakṣiṇām pārthivastasya vandyo vā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ varṣatrayābhiṣekeṇa siddhirvaidyādharī bhavet ubhayaṃ mātṛkācakrārcanaṃ pustakārcanañca pañcavarṣābhiṣekeṇa pañcatvaṃ nādhigacchati saptavarṣābhiṣekeṇa divākarasamo bhavet navavarṣābhiṣekeṇa devīsārūpyamāpnuyāt āvṛttīrjapahomārccātarpaṇaiḥ sādhu sādhayet tathotpāteṣu sarvveṣu tathā rogādyupadrave āhlādakaratvādinā | devīsārūpyaṃ parāhantātmatām || 48 || oṃ || tathā kṛtyāsamutpattāvitthaṃ sarvvārthsiddhidam etaccakrāravinyāsarūpā bhūmiśca dṛśyate sarvve manorathāḥ siddhā bhajanaṃ sampradāyataḥ kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu śukleṣu kevaloktakramaṃ bhajet amuṃ jñātvā vidhātavyamanyathānarthamāvahet punaruktidoṣo na bhavatītyarthaḥ nityakarmma kāmyakarmma veti śeṣaḥ | anyathā tatprakārākaraṇe kālena prāptamanyatra sarvatra samudīritam

rogaśatrujaye prokte parāvṛttakrameṇa vai uccāṭaneṣu vyākīrṇaṃ teṣu śāntyai kramaṃ yajet tasminnarikṛtāḥ pīḍāḥ kṛtyādyā naiva sammukhāḥ yatrāsau nivasatyeṣa tatkṣetraṃ tattapovanam sampradāyācca pratiṣṭhite yantrarāje tat syājjanapadaṃ mahat uccāṭitā punardevi mayāpi ca na rakṣvate vilikhya bhūmau nikhaned grāmarāṣṭrapurādiṣu karṇikāmadhyage veraṃ kuryyāt sānnidhyasiddhaye puṇyakṣetram janapadaviśeṣaṇam | sa deśo janapadaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ punaralpasāmarthyādyairityarthaḥ khātvāvaṭaṃ punasteṣu pāṣāṇairghaṭitaṃ dṛḍham pāṣāṇena tadācchādya pīṭhaṃ kṛtvopari sthiram trisandhyamevaṃ kurvvīta nānyathā siddhidāyakam hotṛṇāṃ dakṣiṇā vastrabhūbhūṣādāsagodhanaiḥ japatarpaṇahomairvvā sekaiḥ saṃsādhayet sthiraḥ tasmāttadābhirupāyaiḥ sādhayet sarvamīpsitam mucyate nigaḍaiḥ kṛcchrairvairirodhaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ labhante tanayān vandhyā api sarvaguṇānvitān proktagrāmādi rakṣāsiddhiḥ | etatsamaṃ cakrāntaraṃ na vidyata iti hotṛṇāmuktāni dravyāṇi dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāditi pañcavidhasādhanaiḥ guṇarūpādisampannāṃ bhāryyāṃ vindantyayatnataḥ labhante putrapautrādyairedhante sampadanvitāḥ

triśatairbhumiśasyāḍhyaścaturbhistu śatairdhanī saptabhistu śatairasya na muñcatyanvayaṃ ramā navabhistu śataireṣa kandarpo vanitājane āsāntu vidyānityānāmañgāni śṛṇu sundari uktānyanyāni durlabhānyabhīṣṭāni sidhyantīti vinyasya mātṛkāyuktāṃ japedvidyāntamekaśaḥ pāśāṅkuśekṣukodaṇḍaprasūnaviśikhāḥ smaret caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā dvāradvayavibhūṣitam tattannityāvidyoktanyāsajātapuraḥsaraṃ japediti ca sampradāyaḥ mūladevatāsadṛśāḥ varṇādibhiriti śeṣaḥ aṅgāvṛttiṃ madhyayonāvantare tvāyudhāvṛtim bahirdaleṣvapi tathā yajedvarṇairvilomataḥ brāhmyādiśakīstadvāhye caturasradvaye yajet saptākṣaryyā kevalayā proktarūpāṃ smaran dhiyā tanmadhyārṇaṃ svarairbhinnaṃ likhitvāsriṣu māyayā vātādyarṇaṃ hṛdantaṃ syāddvādaśa dvādaśa kramāt tābhistādātmyaṃ darśayatītyārādhyapādamukhādavagato'rthaḥ stutvā dvādaśabhiḥ ślokaistaiḥ svānte tāḥ samudvaset tadaiva devatācakrasāmyamasya bhaviṣyati tatraiva devīmāvāhya pūjayet sarvasiddhaye caṇḍī sunetreti pañcākṣaravākyajanitasaṃkhyāni cakrāṇi bhavantīti tatrājñāsiddhayo loke prakāśante mahādbhutāḥ sundarīṃ yuvatīṃ tatra saṃsthāpyābhyarccayet kramaiḥ pūrṇe tu divase tena devī tuṣṭeṣṭadā bhavet tuṣṭābhīṣṭapradā bhavediti

anyadvā śastramakhilaṃ mahācakrasya madhyagam dattvā taiḥ samare śatrūn hatvā vijayamāpnuyāt japanto vāramekantu vidyā nityātmikāstu tāḥ taiṃstairdevatātmabhiḥ yuddhe sarvaśatrūn hatvā vijayaṃ prāpnotīti labhante lalitā yābhiḥ sampradāyavatau bhavet kṛtaṃ janmāntare samyak sampradāyāya kalpate tenākṣarāṇāṃ siddhatvānmantrāḥ sidhyantyaśeṣataḥ sādhakasya kālāntare putrapautrādiṣu vā satsampradāyā bhavantīti nṛpāṇāmaṅganānāñca vallabho jāyate śivaḥ asyā niphālanāccitte tattattva svātmasāt kṛtam pañcaviṃśatipaṭalam | duṣkaraṃ karttumaśakyaṃ | śivaḥ paripūrṇāhantātmā paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam mantrāṇāṃ vaibhavaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu devi yathābidhi tataḥ padāni vākyāni mantrarūpāṇi kānicit amṛteśvaridevyāstu varṇaistairmmithunairapi samuddiṣṭakrameṇaiva sarvvametadaśeṣataḥ mūlādhāre samutpannaḥ parākhyo nādasambhavaḥ paśyantyākhyāmavāpnoti tathaivorddhvaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ saṃkhyātairmantreḥ prayogānityatrānvayaḥ sañjāyata iti tathā tayorddhvanunnaḥ sa viśuddhau kaṇṭhadeśataḥ jihvāmūlāgrapṛṣṭhasthastathā nāsāgrataḥ kramāt samutpannānyakṣarāṇi kramādādikṣakābadhi teṣu svarāḥ svatantrāḥ syustairvyajyādvyañjanaṃ bhavet

bhavatīti saṃyogenaiva jāyante tadrūpāṇi tu saṃkhyayā tairvvākyāni ca mantrāśca vedabhāśānyabhedataḥ śabdavyākaraṇādīnāṃ niyamādiyutāstathā tribhirityādirūpāṇāṃ saṃkhyā karttuṃ na śakyate evaṃ śabdasya māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ kasyāpi nāsti hi lalitācakranavake pratyekaṃ śaktayaḥ priye koṭyaḥ syustatkramāttāsāṃ vidyā vakṣyāmi tāḥ kramāt | śaktiḥ sāmarthyaṃ asya pūrvaślokenānvayaḥ | diśā upāyena kramāt yathā kramam dvitīyāni ca tānyeva krameṇa syurathāditaḥ kṣāntaiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadarṇaistaiḥ samāyairuktasaṃkhyakāḥ tābhistatkoṭisaṃkhyākā vidyāstricaturarṇakāḥ puruṣārthāstu sidhyanti taduktaṃ mātṛkāyudhaiḥ samānatve'pi dehādervyāpāre guruśiṣyayoḥ pratyakṣaṃ yaistu dṛṣṭāntairāśu te darśayāmyaham ga aḥ ityādīni a ā kṣa aḥ ityantāni bhavantīti prāguktāni phalānyāpnotīti sā jarārogamaraṇakleśairna spṛśyate'nyathā ātmanaścedarūpasya saṃskāro naiva yujyate vuddheścedātmanā sāmyāt kasya syād guruvīkṣaṇam sekekṣaṇopadeśaistu guruṇā kriyate tu yat yadavāpya tyajatyāśu saṃśayākhyaṃ mahāmalam saṃskāraḥ kriyate samyag guruṇā tattvavedinā vīkṣaṇādātmano vuddherayathārthanikṛntanam

dustarāṃ tāṃ dhiyā svātmavimarśena vināśayet vināśo nityaśuddhātmasvarūpālambha ityubhe śasyānāṃ bījarūpasya bahnisparśāt prarohitā tathāsyājñānajanmādi kāraṇaṃ yattathaiva tat dṛśyate tatprarohaśca puṣpādi ca tathā bhavet susādhyaṃ sadguruprāptamaghānāṃ saṅgavarjjitam rahitaṃ te vadāmyadya mantravidyāstvanantakāḥ sādhakānāñca siddhānāṃ netareṣāṃ kathañcana sadvāsanāṃ sādhvasādhucintāvirahitaṃ sadā pravṛttirgurūktirūpa svānubhūtisvarūpiṇī bhavatīti ubhayātmakamātmasvarūpaṃ nādasya tasya taiḥ parāhantāmayaṃ sarvasvarūpasvātmavigraham prakāśarūpamātmatve vastu tadbhāsate param vati mandi ntrīdhehisa dāsataḥ rva sathāvasa mantrāṇāṃ paratattvārthavācakatvādabhedatā bhavantīti tathaiva ca parāyāśca gāyatryāścoktarūpataḥ praṇavasya ca tadrūpayogāt syāttattadātmatā haṃsarūpāṃ prāṇaśaktiṃ tadvailāmyasamudbhavam itare bhaktimantaścet kālāttajjñānamāpnuyuḥ bhaktibhede ca kathaya yayāpnotyakhilaṃ dhruvam yadanvayāt phalāvāptiryadviyoge śramo vṛthā tatsāmarasyarūpaparamārthajñānaṃ dadātīti samyak phalamayīṃ siddhamalabhyāmalpapuṇyataḥ vidyānuṣṭhānayoḥ sthairyyaṃ dhiyaḥ saṃśayanāśataḥ

yayā vihīnā niyatamihāmutra ca duḥkhinaḥ ādhivyādhimahādāvaprāvṛṣañcāmṛteśvarīm ṣaḍvidhāṃ japahomārccātarpaṇadhyānayantrakaiḥ jyākaṃ dāhavanasvaiḥ syāttṛtīyā sāmṛteśvarī śeṣaḥ japahomārccatarpaṇadhyānayantrarkaiḥ saheti śeṣaḥ aṅgāni tāsāmādyāyā dīrghasvaraniyojanāt saṃyojyāmṛtasaṃsthānānnyasedanyattu tadgatam pūrvaprastutāmṛteśvarī vidyā itthamuktetyarthaḥ galanāsākṣikarṇabhrūśaṅkhamūrddhasu vai kramāt śukle pūrṇāntamitare mūrddhādipratilomataḥ nityaśo mṛtagasthānasamārambhāvasānakam nyāsenāmṛtarūpī syāt sādhakaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ yāsāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa kleśā naśyantyaśeṣataḥ abhṛtairārdradehāstāstvamalābharaṇānvitāḥ dadhānāḥ smeravadanā muktābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ bhavatīti tābhiḥ ṣaṣṭiśatārṇātmaśaktibhiḥ parivāritāḥ śaktītidvyakṣaraṃ proktasaptākṣaryyā ca saṃyutam vāhyāt praveśagatyaiva prādakṣiṇyāt sugandhibhiḥ pūjayedbahirāsāntu vidadhyādvaliyugmakam homañca taistarpaṇantu jalaiḥ karpūravāsitaiḥ sādhāraṇam kurukullāsaptākṣaryyā ca | taiḥ pāyasādibhiścaturbhiḥ evaṃ japādisaṃsiddhavidyo mantrī yadā jalam

ekaikaśaḥ śatādevaṃ tattoyaṃ dundhasannibham śatārṇānālikhenmadhye tadādyaṃ madhyato likhet dugdhasannibham rasādibhiḥ teṣāmanvonyasambhedālekhanāt syuranantakāḥ koṣṭānyutpādya susamānyekaṣaṣṭyā śatatrayam śeṣaṃ vajraṃ bhavet koṣṭhairekāśītiśatena vai teṣu tāstā likhedvidyāṃ ṣaṭsādhyākhyāsamāyutām vilikhedamṛtārṇāṃstu kramāt ṣaṣṭiśataṃ priye vāhyādimadhyamāntantu likhedanyāstu pañca vai yantrāṇi teṣāṃ sarvatra gadādiparirakṣaṇam yasmin deśe tvidaṃ yantraṣakaṃṭke tvevaṃ supūjitam sadā na sambhavantyevaṃ bhavantyeva ca sampadaḥ saikaviṃśacchataṃ koṣṭhānyabhito mārjayet kramāt madhye taddinajāṃ vidyāṃ ālikhyākhyāsamanvitām prāgvadagratrikoṇāttu vilikhedudayākṣarāt kṛtvā proktāni phalānyavāpnuyāditi ghaṭikākramayogena gandhapuṣpādibhistathā śīghraṃ śamaṃ prayāntyeva kleśāstatra prapūjanāt sitairvvā saurabhopetairmaṇḍalācchriyamāpnuyāt samastavāñchitaṃ varṣādavāpnotyeva niścitam nīrogo nirgatādhiśca nivṛttinītisaṃyutaḥ madhye sādhyasamopete vajrayantre divāniśam proktakāleṣu proktakālāvadhipūjanāt proktaphalasiddhiriti nityābhaktaiḥ samīcīnaiḥ snigdhaiḥ saṃprāptadakṣiṇaiḥ tathā trilohāśmatale kṛtvā vajraṃ suvistṛtam

madhye sādhyaṃ samālikhya tat khanedbhavanādiṣu niḥsapatnā nirupamā nītiyuktā nirantarāḥ tāsāṃ vidyāṃ śṛṇu prājñe yābhiḥ syāt siddhavigrahaḥ proktakramataḥ | tatra pradeśe | nirantarāḥ santanyamānāḥ samīritā viṣoḍhābhiḥ svaravarjamaśeṣataḥ lalitāśaktipūjoktavījadvayasamanvitam pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśārṇābhirvidyābhistābhirambike yanmayaṃ viśvamakhilaṃ dṛśyate sacarācaram asyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtam paṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam || 26 || O/ || yāvat | vidyāyāḥ lalitāvidyāyāḥ yanmayaṃ vidyāmayam ṣaḍviṃśapaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam || 26 || oṃ tatsat || mātṛkābhūtanāthādyaiḥ śrīcakreṇa ca śaktibhiḥ ekaśvāsaṃ samārabhya tatsaṃkhyābhiḥ krameṇa vai viśeṣāṃścāntarādvāhyāttattatsiddhyupapādakān sa tu pañcavidho bhūtabhedādudbhavadeśataḥ prāṇāgnīlāmbukhātmānaḥ pavanāḥ syuryathākraman kramāccaturṣu bhūteṣu vyoma sarvvātmakaṃ bhavet vāmadakṣau tayostasya praveśo nirgamastathā pṛthivī salilaṃ candro raviranyattrayaṃ bhavet vāhyābhyantarān viśeṣān vacyītyuktaṃ bhavatīti mātṛkāñca tathā vidyā svaravyañjanabhedataḥ śarīre'pi ghaṭerūrddhaṃ candrādho ravirīritaḥ śuklakṛṣṇau tathā prakṣāviti candrā daśāntarāḥ ekādaśavidhau candrabhāskarau samyagīritau

rāhuḥ śūnyañca sarvvatra nāśāya bhavati kṣaṇāt saṃgrahaścānyadakhilaṃ candre sidhyatyayatnataḥ candrasūryābhyāṃ | cakāraḥ samāhāre sāmānyaṃ phalamupadiśati | tatra bhāskarāḥ śūnyarūpavidhurāḥ niścitya bhavatītyuktamanyathā cettadanyathā śūnye garbhavipattiḥ syādityādyūhya vadeddṛḍham śubāni tatra sarvvāṇi naśyanti parameśvari tatsthāne sthāpayitvā taṃ tatkarṇe kathayenmanum anyathā śūnyarāhostu nāśāya guruśiṣyayoḥ śūnyanabhorāhuṣu naśyanti aśubhāni bhavantītyarthaḥ tāsāṃ ṣaṣṭyā dinaṃ pūrṇaṃ taddinaṃ syāt punaḥ punaḥ ṣaṭśatañca tatasteṣāṃ svarūpaṃ śṛṇu sundari prāṇāgnīlāmbukhāni syurnavatyānyatra saṃkramaḥ dinamevaṃ brajedādau darśapratipadaṃ prati sundarīti devīsambuddhiḥ etatkramaviparyyāsādabhavyāni bhavanti hi ubhayatrobhayātmānaḥ śubhāśubhaparīkṣaṇe tatra sārddhacatuṣkeṇa bhūtāni syuriti kramāt tattadarṇabhavāḥ śvāsāḥ ṣaṣṭyā triśatamīritam bhavantīti karmmaṇāmiti śeṣaḥ proktasaṃkhyaśvāsātmakāni ca bhūtvā bhūtāni samudyantīti saptāvṛttyā tataḥ śeṣāḥ prāṇāgnīlāmbukhākṣaraiḥ yayā vihitayā mantrī sadā darśanavān bhavet pañcabhūtātmakavarṇātmikā bhavatīti

tato dinārṇāḥ sandhyāḥ syustataśca ghaṭikārṇakāḥ mātṛkāścāpi pañcāśacchrīcakrasthāśca śaktayaḥ evaṃ vidyāṃ vāsanāṃ yo bhāvayet parameśvari yogābhyāsaṃ tadaṅgaiśca svecchotkrāntividhānakam āsannamṛtyucihnāni kathayāmi yathākramam suṣumnā pṛṣṭhavaṃśākhyavīṇādaṇḍasya madhyagā tadagrāt pāyugā proktālambuṣākhyā tu nāḍikā atrānyadrahasyaṃ pūjyapādamukhādavagantavyam mṛtaśarīre svajīvapraveśanaṃ tasmāt svaśarīre tatpraveśanaṃ vā tadvāmadakṣapārśvābhyāṃ saviśvodaravāraṇe hastijihvāyaśasvinyau tattadaṅguṣṭhage padoḥ gāndhārī ca tathā pūṣā netradvayagate kramāt sarasvatī tu yā nāḍī sā tu jihvāgragāminī tāsāṃ sandhiṣu tatsandhiṣvevaṃ nāḍyaḥ sthitāstanau apradhānāḥ śirā dehe tvasaṃkhyā yābhireva vai nāḍayaḥ suṣirā raktamarutpūrṇāśca sarvvagāḥ citrābhidhānā tanmadhye sthitā sā kuṇḍalī parā jihvākarṇākṣināsāṅghri jaṭharāntāḥ pradakṣiṇāt || iti ūrūsauvanikāmuṣkameṭranābhiṣu pārśvayoḥ śaṅkhayoḥ phālgunāsādimadhyāntāsyakapolataḥ parakāyapraveśca svecchotkrāntiśca sidhyati ūrddhādhogamanāsaktau prāṇāpānau sadā tanau devadatto jṛmbhaṇakṛt ravakṛcca dhanañjayaḥ samānavāyuḥ kāyāgniṃ sandhukṣayati pācitum eṣāṃ daśānāmaṃśāstu marutāṃ syuranantakāḥ

dvādaśa sambhūyāṣṭatriṃśanmarmāṇi | eṣu marmasu vailomye vikṛtāṅgatvāllokairnāśāya kalpyate yogo yogastu vijñeyastasyāṅgāni tathāṣṭa vai prāṇāyāmastathā pratyāhārastadanu dhāraṇam kathayāmi śṛṇu prājñe yairmmarttyo matsamo bhavet lobhamohau mānamadau vahnivat sarvanāśakāḥ vikṛtāṅgatvāt ahitādibhiḥ aṣṭāṅgasvarūpaiḥ | matsamaḥ manmayaḥ śivarūpaḥ udyogebhya uparamaṇaṃ yamaḥ yamākhyamaṅgam tathaikādaśarūpaḥ syānniyamaḥ parikīrttitaḥ kṣamā dayā tridhāśaucaṃ santoṣo gurusevanam āsanāni manaḥsthairyyakaraṇe sādhakāni vai bāhyapārśvadvayasparśāttat padmāsanamīritam svastikākārataḥ proktaṃ tadbhadrāsanamīśvari manovākkāyarūpataḥ | santoṣaḥ pūrṇatā ūrvoradhastathorddhe ca dvidhā bhadrāsanaṃ smṛtam pādayorjānudeśe vai vīrākhyaṃ yogapaṭṭataḥ lāghavo bhūtalatyāga uttame cittanirvṛtiḥ sarvvāṅgakampanaṃ proktamabhyāsāt kālasaṃyutāt tasmāt samabhyaset prātaḥ sāyañca niyamena vai smarannambu marut paścāddakiṇenāpasārayet sampradāyaḥ dvividhaṃ vīrāsanaṃ bhavatīti dhārayettaccatuḥṣaṣṭyā recayettatturīyataḥ tadvat kāntiprakāśau ca yogasiddhasya lakṣaṇam

nāḍīcakrāntaraṃ nītvā sarvvāṅgāni ca cārayet dhārayan vārayedicchāvaśenāṅgāni sarvataḥ rasāmbudāhavyāptasvaiḥ sahaṃsairvyāpayettanum turīyataḥ ṣoḍaśamātrābhiḥ dehaviṣaye | prakāśa iti svatejaso bahiḥ prakāśanaṃ bījādivat mūlataḥ mūlādhārāt vāyumiti śeṣaḥ | icchāvaśena syābhimatāṅgadhāraṇavaśena trikālajño viśuddhātmā sukhī jīvecciraṃ bhuvi svecchayā dehamadhyasthaḥ kuḍmagṛhagato yathā prāṇānākṛṣya madhyasthasuṣumnārandhratastathā athavottarasaṃproktacūrṇāsvādanato vaśī svecchotkrāntiriti proktā yogayuktātmanāṃ priye svadehe tattadbhūtamayīkṛte proktaphalasiddhiriti śarīravyāsaṅgarahitaḥ vānavacchinnasvarūpo bhavatīti kalau duḥśāṭakaṃ prāyo marttye siddhirapīśvari paripūrṇāṅgasaṃyuktāmagrato vīkṣya yogataḥ svāṃ tanuṃ gopayet sviyaistatastāñca tathā brajet śṛṇu tāni mahādevi yairanyairjāyate guṇaiḥ jitendriyatvamakrodhaḥ kṛpayā janagopitā yaiḥ sādhyasādhakau jñātvā dehatyāgamatandritau sugatiṃ prāpya siddhyai tu bhavato jātamātrataḥ samāśrayettatastvabdānmṛtistasya suniścitam dṛśau nāsāntikākrāntyā candrake yoṅgayorna cet gulphādhaḥ sphuraṇaṃ nāḍyoḥ pādayoścenna jāyate
