niruddhakarṇarandhrasya na cet kuṇḍalinīdhvaniḥ mūrddhnigā vihagā līnāḥ parāsuṃ taṃ na ko vadet sadyaḥ parāsumātmānaṃ jānīyāt sarvathā naraḥ āgulphorantarāṣṭabhyā paśyannāto vinaśyati tasmin pakṣe prayātyeva yamaṃ santyajya jīvitam bhāskaraṃ bhagaṇaiḥ paśyannapi yāti yamālayam prayāti nidhanaṃ chidraṃ paśyan bhānośca maṇḍale sa pakṣādyāti nidhanaṃ sarvairapi surakṣitaḥ āstikān satataṃ nindannakāraṇata eva ca gurumantraparityāge'pyacirājjāyate mṛtiḥ sadādhikṣepaśāpābhyāṃ nyakkurvannāśu naśyati niṣkāraṇe nirākurvannāśu naśyati mānavaḥ dhyāte svadevavairūpye māsato nidhanaṃ bhavet asyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtam paṭalam svadevavairūpyaṃ varṇavigrahaprasādādibhiriti śeṣaḥ paṭalam paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam || 27 || oṃ tatsat || yanmayaṃ viśvamakhilaṃ vartate sacarācaram vācyavācakayogena mātṛkālokayorapi yadāyattamidaṃ viśvaṃ nityāstatkālavigrahāḥ vṛddhikṣayābhyāṃ candrasya ādyayā kalayā tathā lokatādātmyaṃ | yanmayaṃ nityātmakalokamayaṃ | varttate pratīyate mātṛkālokayorvyāptirapi ṣaḍviṃśe paṭale mayā tavoktetyaryaḥ sakalaviśvakāraṇabhūtaḥ kāla eva nityānāṃ vigraha ityarthaḥ tayoranyonyanityātvavyāptiṃ tadvat sthitiṃ tayoḥ

grahāṇāṃ mātṛkārūpaṃ śṛṇu proktaṃ krameṇa vai tasyābhito mahaupārśve pañcāśacchatayojanāḥ darśāntañca pratitithyekaikakrameṇodayaviśrāntipratītirbhavatīti mātṛkātmatvam sindhubhiḥ saptabhirdvīpaistatsaṃkhyairdviguṇottaraiḥ madhye vistāramānāttu bahirāvṛtya tat punaḥ nūnaṃ paribhramatyeva paścimādhopasavyataḥ āvṛtetyasya mahīti pūrvatrānvayaḥ tejomayairdvādaśārairyuktaṃ meṣādivigrahaiḥ rāśiyuktena kālena proktenoparyyadhastathā paścimābhimukhamūrddhādhaḥ prādakṣiṇyakramāt paribhramatīti lokānāmutpattyādirūpāṃ sthitiṃ kurvantīti madhyasthamerau lalitā sadaivāste mahādyutiḥ tadbahiḥ parame vyomni tvetā citrā tu saṃsthitā dvitīyādiṣu varṣeṣu kramāttāḥ parivṛttibhiḥ citrā ca bhavatītthaṃ hi bhajante parivarttanam varṣaṣoḍaśakavarṣaṣoḍaśakenaikāmekāṃ parivṛttiṃ bhajantīti kāleṣvapi ca madhyādi paravyomāntamīśvari anyāḥ sarvvāstatra tatra caranti svayameva vai kālato deśataścakrādaikyaṃ saṃjāyate yadā prajāśca sukhino bhūyurarogāḥ kālamṛtyavaḥ tadbahiḥ paramavyoma sthitistatra tadantikā evaṃ deśe ca kāle ca tanmayaṃ samudīritam pūjayet saviśeṣaṃ tāṃ prajapeccākhilāptaye mahāśaktiśca jāyeta trayāṇāmaikyavaibhavāt

deśaprāptāntu tanmāsapūrṇāyāṃ pūjayecchive kadācidapi dīrghāyurarogo jñānavān sukhī nityātmakau bhavata ityuktamiti deśādīnām mānyate sarvamantrāśca siddhāḥ syustatra pūjanāt śākaśca puṣkaraśceti saptadvīpeṣu bhūruhāḥ tattannāmabhirabhyarcya taddvīpaṃ tatra pūjayet evaṃ pūjayiturloke na samosti na cādhikaḥ mahāvyoma ca niḥsaumaṃ tatraitaddvayasaṃsthitiḥ pratipakṣatattatprāptatithīśca pūjayan proktaphalasiddhibhāgiti proktarūpaprabhāvo bhavediti grahāṇāṃ tatra saṃvāsapracāraniyatātmanām na tvanyadavalambāya tayoḥ kutrāpi vidyate prāguktarūpāṃ tattīre kolavaktrāntu pañcamīṃ tanmadhye navaratnāni mahādvīpañca tatra vai tanmadhye'saṃkhyarūpābhirvṛtāṃ saṅgītaśaktibhiḥ vinodyamānāṃ vilasanmadamantharavīkṣaṇām śucismitāṃ śaktivṛndagītākarṣaṇananditām śaktericcheti dayāmadāruṇāpāṅgavilokitasusādhakām virājamānāndiradānaśvānapi tathāvidhān svasamānābhirabhito nityābhiḥ sevitāntathā tadvinodastatsamīpanivāsī syāt suniścitam navaratnamayaṃ dvīpaṃ tanmānābdhibhirāvṛtam ratnadvīpasya madhysthatṛtīyāṃśe tu maṇḍape

tathā samanvitāṃ dhyāyannaro bhavati matsamaḥ saparivāranityānāṃ tadvinodaḥ saṅgītādiviśeṣavinodaḥ naro nirastasaṃsāramūlājñāno jitendriyaḥ apāpaḥ puṇyaśīlaśca satyārjavasamanvitaḥ jāyate tasya parito yojanaṃ pāvanaṃ bhavet pāpakarmmakṣayāttena rahitāḥ syuśca tatsamāḥ vyomarūpamanādyantaṃ yattaccinmayamāvayoḥ sa jīvanmukta eveti proktaṃ tallakṣaṇañca te bhūtapretapiśācādipīḍāśāntyai sukhāptaye proktaṃ pañcatriṃśat paṭale vakṣyata ityarthaḥ corasiṃhadvīpigajagavayādibhayānake salilādimanaḥ pīḍāsvabdhau potādisaṅkaṭe sukhī jīvati nirdvandvo niḥsapatno jitendriyaḥ yenāhamapi yuddheṣu devāsurajayī sadā kāmeśī purataḥ pātu bhagamālā tvanantaram nityaklinnā ca bheruṇḍā diśaṃ pātu sadā mama mahāvajreśvarī rakṣedanantaradiśaṃ sadā pālayettu diśaṃ cānyāṃ rakṣenmāṃ kulasundarī nityā nīlapatākākhyā vijayā sarvvataśca mām dehendriyamanaḥprāṇān jvālāmālinivigrahā kāmāt krodhāttathā lobhānmohānmānānmadādapi staimityācca samudyogādaśubheṣu tu karmmasu rakṣantu māṃ sarvvadā tāḥ kurvantvicchāṃ śubheṣu ca tathā hayasamārūḍhāḥ pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadā rathārūḍhāśca māṃ pāntu sarvataḥ sarvadā raṇe

bhūgatāḥ sarvadā pāntu māñca sarvatra sarvadā drāvayantu svaśaktīnāṃ bhīṣaṇairāyudhairmmama asaṃkhyāḥ śaktayo devyāḥ pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadā kadācinnāśubhaṃ paśyenna śṛṇoti ca matsamaḥ tena teṣāntu pūjārthaṃ vakṣye taddhāmamaṇḍalam sudhāvyañjanarūpaṃ syāditare tanmayā yataḥ śivabhūtaḥ teṣāṃ navānāṃ pūjāsu tanmayaṃ navamaṇḍalam krameṇa śṛṇu deveśi sarvaśreyaskarātmakam trihastamātre janayennava koṣṭhāni teṣu vai tanmadhye tiryyagūrddhañca sūtradvayanipātanāt vātādyaṣṭasvarānmadhye praṇavaṃ nabhasā yutam svatantrapūjāsu tayoścandrārkayoḥ tatrārkamarccayettasya nāmabhirdvādaśoditaiḥ somasyādyaṃ svasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā tena tathārccayet ṣoḍaśasvarayuktañca mātṛkāñca svayogataḥ dāhavahnisvasahitamarccayettatra maṇḍale nivedya śarkarādugdhapāyasaiścopacārakaiḥ tattadvargādivarṇañca svaraistāṃ mātṛkāmapi tattadvargākṣarāṇyākhyātryakṣarairālikhedapi evaṃ kṛteṣu navasu pūjayecca navagrahān tryakṣarāṇi caturthyantānyarcayettaiśca tāniti ketumetaistu sarvatra mantrānuktau ca pūjanam teṣveva teṣāmarccātaste kuryyustadanugraham svoccayoḥ sthitapūjāñca maṇḍalaṃ śṛṇu pārvati

rekhābhiraṣṭabhirmmadhye tvekāśītipade likhet māyāntāśītisaṃkhyātānmadhye dāvagatañca tat pañcabhiśca likhettatra bimbe somaṃ samarcayet raktacandanasindūragairikairekato raveḥ dvivṛttāntastiryyagūrddhvāḥ kṛtvā rekhāḥ samāntaram prāṇādikānnabho'ntāṃstu svairupetān svarairyutān svarairbhāntayutairvahnidaśārṇairgrathitāṃ lipim tanmadhye bhānumāvāhya pūjayet prāgvadīśvari susamenāvṛte kṛtvā bimbānyuktāni pūjayet viśeṣādeśarahite tatra tatkramatorcayet proktopacārādyairarkañcārccayet | tena proktaphalasiddhibhāgiti sarvvātmanā sarvadā ca saivārcyā sarvavigrahā aṣṭāviṃśaṃ paṭalam śeṣaḥ | saiva lalitaiva arccanīyā sarvavigrahā sarvadevatāvigrahā iti parāmṛṣṭam || 28 || oṃ tatsat || prācyādidigvibhāgañca maṇḍapādestu lakṣaṇam mānāni teṣāmagnestu dhyānaṃ jihvāstadarccanam upakramopasaṃhārau phalāni ca yathākramam yadi kuryyād yathādṛṣṭaṃ vipanno nirayaṃ brajet tadgatyā dikparijñānaṃ śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhi tanmadhyaṃ bindumadhyantu śaṅkuṃ saṃsthāpya tasya vai pūrvāparāhṇayoḥ kṛtvā cihetamabhitastathā tayoḥ saṃśleṣasañjātamadhyadakṣottarasthite sūtraṃ dakṣottaraṃ teṣāṃ agraiḥ prāgādi kalpayet vidadhyānnavahastena vistārāyāmasaṃyutam

udumbaravaṭāśvatthaplakṣaiśchadanamālayā vidadhyānmadhyato vedīṃ karamātrasamunnatām prāgādidikṣu koṇeṣu vahnyādiṣu ca kalpayet pratyagdakṣiṇottarātmakadikcatuṣṭayaṃ kalpayediti nirmmāṇaṃ sakalaṃ vakṣye yathāvidhi tavānaghe vidadhyādvṛttakuṇḍāni cararāśicatuṣṭaye vidadhyāccaturasrāṇi tataḥ kuṇḍānyanukramāt ubhayātmasu kurvīta yonikuṇḍāni maṅgale sthireṣvapi trikoṇāni pareṣu tu catuṣṭaye evaṃ navānāṃ kuṇḍānāṃ śṛṇu mānādilakṣaṇam tṛtīyāṃśo bhavedatra tantre sarvatra cāṅguliḥ aratnistaddvayena syāddhastastaddvayataḥ śive ṣaṇavatyaṅgulā sā syāttanmānaiḥ kuṇḍakalpanam āṃ navavidhānāṃ kuṇḍānāṃ mānādilakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇviti kṛtvā tatpūrvataḥ paścāddvādaśāṅgulamānataḥ prākpratyakcihnamānena tayorevāvalambataḥ prasāryya sūtraṃ taccāpi mārjayitvoktamānataḥ kuryāddhaṃsapadaṃ koṣṭhānyabhitasteṣu pātayet tatsaṃkhyāṅgulamitapuruṣadehonnati samānāni kuṇḍānīti tasminnanyāni kuṇḍāni vadāmi tava mānataḥ mānanirmmāṇayorvakṣye vidhānaṃ susphuṭaṃ śive caturasrābhitaḥ sā tu tyājyā bhūranyatastathā tatsamānyeva jāyante ṣaṇavatyaṅgulātmanā teṣāṃ śaśāṅkamānena tanmadhyādbhrāmayettathā bhavantīti

yena dvayaṃ carāṇāṃ syādrāśīnāṃ kramataḥ śive pratyekaṃ paścimaṃ sūtraṃ tanmānenātha sūtrayoḥ kuṇḍaṃ trikoṇamuditaṃ caturṣu sthirarāśiṣu kramataḥ maṅgalāmaṅgalayoḥ | śive iti sambuddhiḥ kuṇḍaṃ kalpayet | etadamaṅgalaprayoge sthirarāśiṣu caturṣūditamiti pūrvataḥ paścimadvandvaṃ koṣṭhayormmadhyadeśataḥ uttarāgrāvadhi tathā dakṣiṇāgrāvadhi priye vikāśitabrahmasūtrāvadhi sūtradvayaṃ bhavet rāśiṣu proktakalyāṇakarmmasūktārthasiddhikṛt mānena parito bhrāntyā kṛtvā vṛttaṃ tathā tataḥ kuṇḍamuktaphalasiddhikaramiti pātayet pañcasūtrāṇi tat syāt pañcāsrakuṇḍakam tena mānena ca tathā kṛtvā vṛttamatisphuṭam tatra ṣaṭsūtrapātena bhavet kuṇḍaṃ ṣadasrakam tena mānena sambhrāntyā kṛtvā vṛttaṃ tathā tataḥ vṛtte vidhāya cihnāni saptasūtrāṇi pātayet maṅgalakarmmaṇi mithunarāśisthānavahnidik proktaṃ bhavediti karmaṇi kanyārāśisthānaniṝtidik proktaṃ ṣaḍasrakuṇḍaṃ bhavediti samastavairināśāya proktaṃ kuṇḍamidaṃ śive vidhāya caturasrantu pūrvakoṇārddhamānataḥ teṣu cihneṣu kṛtvāṣṭa sūtrāṇi paritaḥ śive pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu prājñe samuddiṣṭaṃ krameṇa vai svavāñchitena mānena tadasrāṇi bhavanti hi kuṇḍeṣu ca tathā koṭihomādiṣu samīritam kārayet koṭihomantu puruṣairaṣṭabhistathā

teṣāñca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pūjāpraṇatipūrvakam mekhalādikamityatrādiśabdo yonyādiviṣayaḥ | prājñe iti sambuddhiḥ koṭyādimahāsaṃkhyahomaproktakuṇḍeṣu ca vidhānaṃ samīritamiti mahiṣīṃ saprajāmaśvadāsadāsīvibhūṣaṇām tato gurośca tānyeva taiḥ samānamudīritam tathā digvijaye'nyasya parakṛtyādisambhave surūpaiśca suśīlaiśca nityābhaktaistathāstikaiḥ koṭihomasya kuṇḍasya khātamūrddhantu tasya vai ṣoḍaśanityābhaktaiḥ | āstikaiḥ nityanaimittikādikramabhajanaparaiḥ koṭihomaproktanavahastamānakuṇḍasya vistārotsedhayoḥ kuryyādyonihotrāsanāgrataḥ tisṛṇāmapi vistārāḥ pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulāḥ yoninirmmāṇamadhunā vāsanāñca śṛṇu priye vitastimātrakāṃ koṣṭhāmaśvatthadalasannibhām vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇāṃ yoniṃ kuryyāditi nirmāṇaṃ tasyā vāsanāṃ yoninirmāṇasya | priye iti devīsambuddhiḥ ekāṅgulotsedhayutāṃ mekhalopari sarvataḥ yoniḥ kāraṇabhūtasya tattvasya syāt padaṃ mahat phalāni pūrṇānyacirādayatnādvitaratyasau tanmekhalopari yonikḷptiṃ vinaiva tatphalasiddhikṛditi sampradāyaḥ nābhiṃ kuryyāttu sarvvatra kuṇḍamadhye vidhānataḥ caturbhiraṅgulaiḥ kuryyāt karṇikāṃ dalameva ca prāgvanmahati kuṇḍe ca kuryyādūhena tattathā saumyaṃ nityāsamākāraṃ dhyānamanyacchṛṇu priye tattannityāproktasthūlarūpadhyānaṃ | priye iti devīsambuddhiḥ

tridhārūpamatikrūrairaruṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirīkṣaṇaiḥ itaraistomaraṃ tālavṛntaṃ sarpiḥsubhājanam krūreṣu sarvvahomeṣu dhyānavaibhavamīritam juhuyāccettadā kṣipraṃ tadaghaistaṃ vināśayet juhuyācca samāpnoti vāñchitaṃ sakalaṃ kṣaṇāt dakṣavaktragatā sarvvasiddhidā tu samarccanāt vyāttavaktraṃ vistṛtavaktram pratyavāyamupadiśati tatra vā samuccaye | taṃ sādhakam jihvāsaptake ityarthaḥ | kṣaṇāt proktamaṇḍalādikālālaṅghanena rūpādibhiriti yāvat | sarvasiddhidā vāñchitaphaladāyinī bahurūpāyāṃ jihvāyāṃ homaḥ sarvvārthasādhakaḥ yasyāṃ juhoti tāmādyāṃ samabhyarcyātha saptaśaḥ sāmānyato nityahome dravyāṇi śṛṇu sundari taddvayaṃ ceti saṃproktānyuktānyetāni nityake abhicāreṣu vānyeṣu krūreṣvanyeṣvapi priye tanmāṃsaistatra tatroktairdravyaiḥ krūreṣu karmasu kuryyāditi sampradāyaḥ devīsambuddhiḥ priye iti sambuddhiḥ annājyādi samastantu niṣkamātraṃ hunet kramāt prasannacittavadanaḥ kuryyāddhomantu sādhakaḥ nyastagātro'rghatoyena prokṣayet kuṇḍamadhyakam darbheṇa vilikhet kuṇḍamadhye rekhācatuṣṭayam tattatpaṭale prasthamātreṇa ṣaṇavatyāhutīḥ kuryyāditi yāvat

prāgādiṣu tu saptāpi madhye vahniṃ tathā smaran jihvānāmabhirekaikaṃ vahneśca dvyakṣarādikam vahniṃ sabhājanaṃ haste gṛhītvāṅgārakañca tat viparibhrāmya kuṇḍantu tanmadhye vinyasettataḥ kṛtvā darbhaiḥ paristīryya palāśāśvatthapatrakaiḥ juhuyādekamekantu nāthanityātmabhūtajaiḥ svājñāsthānagatāṃ buddhvā paristaraṇapūrvakam pūjāṃ samāpya vicaret sukhī tadrūpavānnaraḥ kuryyāditi | krūrakarmasu abhicārādiṣu teṣu taddhomakaraṇaṃ samāpte nityaśastathā nityakramaṃ tato nityaṃ tattaddivasavidyayā maṅgale pūrvamudite pāhi māmityudīrayet homaṃ taṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ sthūlasūkṣmaparatvataḥ itarasya vidhāne tu yāni jñeyāni tāni tu vināśayedarātīṃśca homeḥ pāpāni cātmanaḥ tasmāddhomena sakalaṃ sādhayet sarvavāñchitam asyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtam paṭalam || 29 || oṃ || nānavāpyamityetadabhimataviṣayaḥ parāmṛṣṭam || 29 || oṃ tatsat || tāsāṃ cakraṃ tatra pūjākramaṃ samyagvadāmi te sūkṣmahomavidhānāni tatphalāni paraṃ tathā yairvinā bhuvane mantrāḥ sarve syurniṣphalā dhruvam purā tasya vadhāyaiva sarve devāḥ smudyamam āvayostannirāsāya māmetyākathayattadā

niścitam darpaśāntiṃ nacettena viśvamāsīdupadrutam khātvā tamavanau tasya śarīre sthāpayettathā niyojya teṣāṃ ye pūjāvimukhāstaiḥ kṛtāni tu tasmātteṣāmarccanantu pratyahaṃ kurvatāṃ sadā taccakrādividhānantu śṛṇu samyagvadāmi te tairekāśītikoṣṭhāni jātāni syuḥ samāni ca ḥ | te tava ekīkuryyāttrikoṣṭhāni dikṣu prāgādiṣu kramāt dvidhā kuryyāt koṇakoṣṭhānyaṣṭau tatpārśvayoḥ punaḥ ekamekaṃ bhavecchiṣṭaṃ bahirdvātriṃśadīritam hemābhañca caturvaktraṃ vedādhyayanaśīlinam tripañcāśaddevatāsthānāni bhavantīti āryyakañca vivasvantaṃ mitramanyaṃ mahīdharam vahnyādīśāntamabhitaḥ pūjayet pūrvavat priye āyāpavatsakau ceti proktāste'ṣṭau tu nāmataḥ aṣṭau krameṇa tārādyairnamontairnāmabhistathā sarvvaṃ guhañcāryyamaṇaṃ bhañjakaṃ pilipicchakam bahirīśādi parito yajedaṣṭau diśaṃ prati satyo vṛṣontarikṣaśca pūrvāśākoṣṭhagāḥ kramāt gandharvvo bhṛṅgarājaśca mṛgo dakṣiṇakoṣṭhagaḥ varuṇaḥ puṣpadantaścāsurākhyaśoṣarogakāḥ vāyurnāgastathā mukhyaḥ somo bhallātakastathā koṣṭheśūttarasaṃstheṣu devatāstāḥ samīritāḥ kṛtvā caturddhā teṣveva prāgādiṣu yathākramāt

praṇavādibhirnamo'ntaiḥ pūjayediti prāgādiṣu tathā dakṣe nityārṇāṇudayārṇakam uttare pūjayāmīti vilikhyātra yajecca tān brīhimudgayavaiḥ kṣaudraghṛtadugdhāplutaiḥ kramāt pratyekaṃ tairhuneddravyairmmantraistadvacca pāyasaiḥ sasitairdugdhakadalīphalāpūpādisaṃyutam | tān proktān brahmādīn ājyāhutīrjuhuyāditi svagehe vāstupūjāyāṃ maṇḍale sarvataḥ kramāt trayādahīnān vividhairmmadhurādyaistu bhojayet evaṃ vidadhato gehe nākalyāṇaṃ kadācana na sarpapīḍā nānyonyakalahānyaśubhāni ca arogī vijayī khyātaściraṃ jīvati tadgṛhe śrīvidyājāpī gṛhametya nyastagātro devatātmā bhavediti sacivāmātyasenānībhavaneṣu pure tathā na ceduktānyathārūpaphalaiḥ kleśo'niśaṃ bhavet tattaddaivatanāmāni māyāgarbhe samālikhet sthāpayedveśmasu kkāpi nityaśaścāpi tatra vai tadveśmamaṅgalaṃ grāmapurakharvaṭakādiṣu pratiṣṭhādikamiti śeṣaḥ p. 586) tataḥ sūkṣmaiḥ parākhyaiśca homaiḥ siddhiṃ śṛṇu priye vācyavācakarūpañca prapañcaṃ juhuyāttathā tadvidhānaṃ vada prājña śambho samyaṅmamādhunā tadrūpaṃ tatkriyāṃ sarvaṃ vada me viśadaṃ prabho prāṇāgnihotravidyeti yattrayyāṃ śrūyate param

jāyate iti prabho iti devasambuddhiḥ yadvyayāyāsarahitamananyā pekṣanirvaham sukhāspadaṃ svagaṃ viśvamayaṃ cidvedyavedanāt pradarśyate tatastatra varṇayāmi ca kiñcana sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tadvaddhṛdaye ca prabhākaraḥ tattayātmakameva syādādyā nityā trikhaṇḍakam gamāgamābhyāṃ tejobhisteṣāmanyonyajaiḥ śive cittavikalpavidhuraṃ bhāvayedadbhutāñca yat dvābhyāmanyatamaṃ kṛtvā puṭitaṃ juhuyācca taiḥ kuṇḍalīmukhamārgāgnau juhuyānniścalāśayaḥ vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa juhuyāditi candrabhānupuṭāntaḥsthairvvahnyarṇairjuhuyāttathā candravahnipuṭāntaḥsthairbhānvarṇairjuhuyādapi tathā teṣāṃ prātilomyāt ṣoḍaśānāṃ hunedapi kṛtvā tadvācyamakhilamartharūpañca taiḥ samam anyāni cāvayoricchāgṛhītāni vapūṃṣi vai muktiśca tanmayībhāvasthairyyameva samīritam mūlādhārasthanirvikalparūpamātmamahāvahnau homaḥ syāditi proktatejastrayatādātmyabhāvasthairyyam tāṃ vadāmi śṛṇu prājñe rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam jīvaśaktiḥ kuṇḍalākhyā prāṇākāreṇa tena sā māyāśīrṣā nadantī tāmuccarantyaniśaṃ svage pidhāya na śṛṇotyasyā dhvaniṃ tasya tadā mṛtiḥ vihāya ṛjutāṃ yāti svecchādaṇḍāhatā satī

niśāndhakāre bhuvanasthitivat svātmanaḥ sthitiḥ jñānātmakatvāttādātmyātmakatvācca sa vetti brahma paramaṃ māṃ tvāmapi ca sādhakaḥ aspṛṣṭapuṇyapāpaśca śokaharṣātibhūmigaḥ nirupādhikasantuṣṭaḥ svecchādhīnecchayā yutaḥ samārimitrakalyāṇaguṇaśīladayānvitaḥ itaraḥ pūjane devyā bhajane ca sakautukaḥ janmabhirvvahubhiḥ kliṣṭo mūrkho vidyādhanodbhavaiḥ śivaṃ śaktiñca tvām jīvanneva muktaḥ paramārthataḥ svātmanīnyādyabhāvādityarthaḥ nityāsu bhaktirbhuvane prakṣīṇe pāpakarmmaṇi naro bhavanti tāṃ bhaktiṃ prāpya lokeṣu devatāḥ anye ca lokapālādyāstadbhaktiprāptasampadaḥ na santi devatā vidyāstasmāttā eva sarvvadā paravaśo bhavatītyarthaḥ sampradāyārthaḥ p. 594) tadvarṇavyāptacakrasthā grahāśca tavadarśitāḥ anyāśca devatā yā yāstāstāstanmayavigrahāḥ yatsiddhiḥ siddharūpāṇāṃ prāguktānāṃ bhavet sadā prakṣīṇāśeṣapāpānāṃ bhaktiḥ syāttajjñasevinām nityātmakamātṛkāvarṇavyāptacakrasthāḥ cakrāntarasthaṣoḍaśanityāmayavigrahāḥ pararūpahomasyeti śeṣaḥ | tathā siddhavat | tajjñasevināṃ viditaparamārthanāthasevāditatparāṇām āmuṣmikāsaṃśayatvaṃ santoṣo nityapūrṇatā

akārpaṇyamadīnatvaṃ paracintānirudyamaḥ lābhahānyoḥ prītiroṣābhāvaḥ kalyāṇaśīlatā akalyāṇakathālāpavaimukhyaṃ svecchayā sthitiḥ sarvvānukūlyaṃ saṅgītapriyatvaṃ vāñchitāptayaḥ sarvvottaratvavāñchā ca lakṣaṇānīritāni te nidhānaṃ parahomantu sthūlasūkṣmañca yanmayam tanmayatvādaikyarūpaṃ sthūlahomamudīritam sarvottaratvavāñchā devatātādātmyasiddhivāñchā vācyārthānāmaśeṣeṇa vedyavettṛvidātmanā svātmarūpamahāvahnijvālārūpiṣu sarvvadā nirvyutthānavilāpastu parahomaḥ samīritaḥ homakarmma samastaṃ tu śubhātmakamudīritam anyeṣvanyāni kāryyāṇi proktāni proktarūpataḥ dakṣiṇāsyobhicārantu gade vahnimukho dviṣām proktavidhānena vidadhyāt paścimāsyastu krūrāṇyanyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ vidadhyādupaviśyoktamanyathānarthamāvahet gomayaiḥ parimṛṣṭe tu susame bhūtale śubhe madhye vidadhyāddhomantu proktamevamaśeṣataḥ asyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtam iti ṣoḍaśanityātantreṣu śrīkādimate triṃśattamaṃ paṭalam tāṃ diśaṃ prācī parikalpya kuṇḍaṃ nirmāya juhuyāditi proktadiśi | anyathā viparītakaraṇe kṛtakoṣṭhanavake | madhye sarvamadhyakoṣṭhamadhye triṃśat paṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam || 29 || oṃ tatsat ||

idānīṃ sthūlahomantu kathayāmyarimarddanam vidhānairdveśanidhanaroganigrahacāṭanam tadātmikagrahāṇāñca sthitimaṣṭakavargakam anyathā krūrakarmmāṇi kurvvāṇaṃ nāśayanti hi kuryyāttaddevatābhaktimāstikyaṃ varttanaṃ gurum cāṭanam uccāṭanam vidadhyādanyathā śaktyā neṣphalyaṃ vātmanāśanam sthāne kuryyādaniṣṭāni tadvināśāya sādhakaḥ kulīrasiṃhamatha tanniṛtyāṃ kanyakā sthitā tatprayokturnāśanaṃ vā bhavatīti sthāneṣu dvādaśasu | tadvināśāya ripuvināśāya nakrakumbhāvṛttarato mīna īśe tu saṃsthitam kāle tu pañca pañca syurghaṭikāḥ kramayogataḥ meṣādirāśigo yāti tathānyairgrahamaṇḍalaiḥ mūrddhādicaraṇāntantu tān dvādaśasu lakṣayet īśe koṇe | susthitaṃ kālacakrastharāśicakravanna bhramatītyarthaḥ sūryyādhiṣṭhitarāśyādikramayogataḥ tattadgrahaparivṛttiproktakālaviśeṣairityarthaḥ tān rāśīn | dvādaśasu sthāneṣu śubhāśubhāni sarvvāṇi phalantyevaṃ kṛte dhruvam jñātvā vidadhyāt puttalyāḥ prayāgaṃ sarvatastathā bhrūśaṅkhamūrddhamadhyeṣu tatra bhrūśaṅkhamadhyataḥ savyakaṇṭhastanataṭe hṛdi nābhau ca guhyake aṅghrau sandhau jānuguhye nābhau ceti sitatare kṛte

karmmasu | tathā vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa viṣanāḍyāṃ viṣasthāne vedhayet kaṇṭakena tu vadarādisamutthairvvā tathāyaḥsārasūcibhiḥ vyādhinā pīḍitaṃ kālādavidheyaṃ bhaveddhruvam puttalīkaraṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nigrahasiddhaye dakṣiṇavāmapārśvavinimayakrameṇa ca viṣasya parivṛttirbhavatīti puttalīnirmāṇavidhānaṃ maṅgalo gurumandārkiguravoṃśakarāśipāḥ etāvatyaśca puttalyastvaśakakramayogataḥ ṣoḍaśa dvādaśa tathā mānamaṅgulisaṃkhyayā dvitīye navakenyeṣāmadhyarddhāḥ syustrayodaśa candrārkayorekavidhaḥ proktasaṃkhyākramastathā tatra etāvatyaḥ aṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyāḥ citāmṛdbhasmalavaṇaṃ śuṇṭhīpippalikāyutam gairikañceti kathitaṃ puttalīdravyamīśvari vairidehajaromādyairupetaiḥ puttalīkriyā śīrṣaṃ trayāt kaṭerūrddhvaṃ trayāt pādadvayaṃ tathā vidhāya tantre sarvvatra prayogānācarennaraḥ upetairityetaddāruvyatirikteṣu cakrihastamṛtsahiteṣu triṣvanveti prayogān proktān nāśayoge ca dinajamṛtyau krakacayogake raktasthūṇe kaṇtakākhye sthūṇe pañcārkasaṃjñake nigrahāya nirīkṣyaivaṃ kuryyāt siddhimavāpnuyāt vidadhyāt puttalīḥ samyak catasraḥ proktayogataḥ sādhyanakṣatravṛkṣeṇāpyuktalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ

piṣṭamṛttarujāḥ khātvā syāpayet sikthamambare evaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryyāt karmma samīritam evamuktaprakāreṇa vairiyonyasṛjā kṛtvā tayā tu juhuyāttathā śmaśāne nirjane deśe vidadhyādabhicārakam tatrābhito nṛpau rakṣau kārayedātmasiddhaye svarāṣṭrasandhau kurvvīta na kurvvīta svamaṇḍale tadrāṣṭraṃ pīḍayantyeva śanakairbbairibhūbhṛtaḥ vakṣyamāṇavidhānakrameṇa kuryāditi ityetadviśeṣyam śanakaiḥ kālakrameṇa haimīdalarasāktaistu homācchatruṃ vināśayet ripurugro'pi rogārttaḥ prayāti yamasādanam tatpatrāmbuplutairmmāsādarātirbhrāntimāpnuyāt vitastimātraistailāktairhavanādvairiṇo mṛtiḥ homādarātestībrārttijvareṇa syānmṛtirdhruvam haimīdalarasāktaiḥ haimīdalajalāplutaiḥ unmattapatrottharasaplutaiḥ vitastimātraiḥ dvādaśāṅgulamātraiḥ aru.karavījaiḥ | tadghṛtāplutaiḥ aruṣkaratailāplutaiḥ arātīnāmathānyonyakalahānnidhanaṃ bhavet vairijanmarkṣavṛkṣāgnau maṇḍalāntaṃ mṛtirjvarāt sarṣapāruṣkaraghṛtasaṃsiktairjuhuyānniśi raktasraggandhapuṣpādiyutaḥ śatrūn vināśayet havanādvairiṇo dāhajvaraprāptistribhirddinaiḥ

sauvīrāktaiḥ āranālāplutaiḥ raktasragraktagandharaktapuṣparaktāsanādiyutaḥ sarpaśīrṣakaiḥ sarpaśiraḥkalpitasrugbhiḥ havanāttattarūdbhūtasamidhāṃ havanādapi drumakuḍyasarpadaṃśānmattadvipādighātanāt yakṣarākṣasagandharvvapiśācabrahmarākṣasaiḥ nimvapatraiśca kārpāsabījaistajjaiḥ karañjajaiḥ nīcayoge hunedagnau ripuvṛkṣasamedhite uccāṭanaṃ prayātyeva mantraśaktyābhitāḍitaḥ arāterdantino vāhā rogairnaśyanti niścitam nimajjanena pāvake pātanena anyaiḥ apasmārādyaiḥ | vā vikalpe phalaiśceti śeṣaḥ | sarṣapasreha siktaiḥ sarṣapodbhavatailāplutaiḥ ripunakṣatravṛkṣakhaṇḍaiḥ | dinaiḥ proktairmaṇḍalādibhiḥ prāguktakaṇṭakādyaistu yadaṅgaṃ vedhayecchanaiḥ arddhapraharake śīrṣe praharedvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ granthibhirvvā kaṇṭakādikṣatavṛddhividāruṇaiḥ gardabhīmehasalile saṃsthāpya kkāthayecchanaiḥ madhūcchiṣṭena tāṃ kṛtvā tāpayenniśi tāṃ śanaiḥ hunejjahuyāt dantino gajāḥ vāhāḥ hayāḥ ca | praharādinā ityatrādiśabdaḥ chedanādiviṣayaḥ | vā vikalpe kaiściddivasaiḥ tāṃ tatkaṇṭakaviddhāṅgīṃ khanet pitṛgṛhe niśi prāguktaireva taddavyairaśeṣaiḥ puttalīṃ tathā samiddhegnau tatsabhidbhistailāktairjuhuyānniśi pralayaṃśanakairdehaṃ tyajan yāti yamālayam

navamyaṅgāradivase mātṛgehegrapīṭhake pitṛgehe śmaśāne | niśi madhyarātre | caḥ samāhāre niśi madhyarātre | yāti yamālayaṃ ripuriti śeṣaḥ bhūtādyaiḥ śirasi svīye nirghātavadalakṣitam piṣṭvā sādhyarkṣavṛkṣasya śakalairapi saṃyutam tadvakṣontarnidhāyārināma tālasya patragam sahasravāraṃ sādhyasya vadharkṣe'ṣṭamarāśige gṛhītvā jīvahastena tāṃ japet prayajecchucau taddine tāpatṛṣṇārttivihvalena jvareṇa saḥ alakṣitaṃ etat kriyāviśeṣaṇam prayāti nidhanaṃ tūrṇaṃ prayogavalataḥ śive vajrīkṣīreṇa vā liptāṃ baddhāṃ prāgvadadhomukhīm juhuyāttatsamidbhistu tatkṣīrāktairniśāntarā yadyasti tasya rakṣecchā tāṃ taṭākodare khanet tathā yadi na kurvīta ciraṃ rogātmako bhavet caṇḍikāyatane khātvā tadyoniṃ tatpuro valim prayogadivase | sa sādhyaḥ | śive iti sambuddhiḥ jvarārttasya | tathā proktaprakāreṇa svagehe valyadhaḥ khātvā taduparyyagnivarddhanāt tāṃ tathākṛtarūpāntu rurujaṅghāsthisaṃyutām rāśau tadaṣṭame māsāt prayātyudyātyatonyataḥ viḍālamūṣikācarmmanaddhaṃ sādhyākhyayā yutam mātṛgehe nadīpūrttyāṃ vidveṣaḥ syāddvayostadā upasargakaiḥ kleśaiḥ jvarādigadasambhava ityanena ca

niśi madhyarātre | rāśau tadaṣṭame śatroriti śeṣaḥ caṇḍikāyatane | nadīpūrttyāṃ satyāmiti śeṣaḥ tadvidyājāpasiddhāstāḥ khanedarigṛhe punaḥ evaṃ nikaṭavarttināṃ abhicāra udīritaḥ vadāmi te śṛṇu prājñe sudūrasthasya vairiṇaḥ yenārirnikaṭa sthāttu prāgeva nidhanaṃ vrajet tāḥ prāgudīritakṣīradvayasiktāḥ sasaṃjñakāḥ ekāmekāṃ hanedvairidiṅmukhastā aśeṣataḥ ripukulotsādanam proktaputtalīkhananādividhānena sambuddhiḥ | yena prayogena nikaṭasthāt arāteritiśeṣaḥ kathaṃ vā māntrikavalī nihantuṃ śakyatāṃ vrajet tairmmāntrikaistasya pūrvvaṃ vidveṣe kārayettataḥ bhāgyādhikaṃ mahārakṣākaraṃ mātṛkasaṅgatam tanme kathaya deveśa yadyupāyantu vidyate abhicāramarātīnāmāśunāśakaraṃ param ripuriti śeṣaḥ | nihantuṃ śakyatāṃ brajet vadhyatāṃ brajedityardaḥ rakṣakābhāvāt īśvarasambuddhiḥ | upāyaṃ divyatvādupāyāḥ śeṣaḥ tairavacchinnadarpantu homayedyāmadik kramāt arātinigrahaṃ kuryyādevamuktavidhānataḥ ekatriṃśat paṭalam evaṃ prakāreṇa || 31 || oṃ tatsat ||

yena marttyopi bhuvane prakhyāto devatāsamaḥ prokteṣu navakuṇḍeṣu tattatkarmmasu codite śuklapratipadārambhāt pūrṇānte paṅkajairhunet madhuratrayasaṃsiktaiḥ puṣpairapyaruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ teṣveva divaseṣvavjaiḥ sitaistaddhavanādghṛtaiḥ kuṇḍādiviṣayaḥ ekonatriṃśapaloktapariṣecanaparistaraṇādividhānena p. 622) teṣvevotpalahomena śriyamāpnoti puṣkalām saubhāgyaṃ kīrttimārogyamavāpnotyarccanādapi acalāñca śriyaṃ prāpya sukhī jīvati bhūtale putradāsīdāsayutaściraṃ jīvati mānavaḥ vanitājanasandohavinodī bhuvi jīvati ghṛtāktairabdamātreṇa niḥsapatnāṃ labhecchriyam kāntilakṣmījayārogyayuto jīvati bhūtale indudravāktaiḥ karpūradravāktaiḥ | turviśeṣe kṣīrāhārī ciraṃ bhūmau jīvatyakaluṣāśayaḥ āyurārogyavijayasampannāṃ śriyamaśnute puṇyakīrttirnṛpairmmānyo jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sukhī havanāttaddinairiṣṭamakhilaṃ samavāpnuyāt vāsāṃsi nānāvarṇāni mahārhāṇi labheta saḥ taiḥ savatsasitāgavyapayoktairhavanādapi ajākṣīrayutaistaiśca tathāvikṣīrasaṃplutaiḥ tathā dvādaśabhirdravyairekaikaiḥ saṅgataistu vā gobhūhiraṇyavāsobhiḥ samṛddho jīvati kṣitau abdādannasamṛddhiḥ syād ghṛtāktairvvā madhuplutaḥ

sampannaśasyāṃ pṛthivīmavāpnoti suniścitam tairiṣṭahṛdyamilitairhavanāttāṃ mahīṃ labhet śriyaṃ sakalakalyāṇanilayāṃ labhate'bdataḥ juhuyādabdamātreṇa labhate gehamuttamam guḍānvitairvvā juhuyācchiyā suciramedhate havanāllabhate lakṣmīmabdādatimanoharām taddinairindirāṭyaḥ syādvidyāhavanavaibhavāt ghṛtakṣīratilakṣaudraguḍāpūpasamanvitam śālibhistaṇḍulairmmudgairmāaśairgauretaraistilaiḥ kṣudrasarpistilairdundhakerondekṣurasāplutaiḥ dugdhasiktapanasāsthiparāgakaiḥ kṣīramiśritapanasavījaparāgaiḥ lalitāvidyāvaibhavāt homavaibhavācca lalitāvidyābhaktān | trīn dvau trīn vā dvau vā ityarthaḥ | subhojayet maghādiṣu tathā homaṃ navabhiḥ syānnavasvapi māṣānnaiśca haridrānnairguḍānnaiḥ pāyasaistathā tathā mūlādinavake kalibhirjuhuyāttathā śālīcaṇakamudgotthairmāṣapiṣṭatilodbhavaiḥ prokteṣu aśvinyādiṣu | kramāt ekaikāplutaiḥ ekaikadravyakramāt dravyamekaṃ tadāplutadravyaṃ tatphalañca ārogyamāyuḥ saubhāgyaṃ mānyatāñca labheddhruvam tathāmṛtākhyayogeṣu juhuyādrogaśāntaye uccayogeṣu juhuyādaruṇairutpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ parvvatākhye hunedyoge yaddravyaistaddhi parvatam athānyamadbhutaṃ homamākarṇaya vadāmi te pāyasairghṛtasaṃsiktaiḥ sitamiśraistu vidyayā

vijayādiphalasaptakaṃ mūlādinakṣatranavakaproktahomasādhāraṇam taddravyaṃ parvataṃ sampūrṇaṃ | parameśvarīti sambuddhiḥ tattatprokteṣu kāleṣu grahārttiḥ syānna tatkule dūrvāmṛtātilairnityaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ sukhī bhavet na tasya kutracit kaścit kadācit kleśasambhavaḥ saurabhyāḍhyaiḥ prasūnaiśca pūjayedvātha taddine yadi syāttasya rogādipīḍā bhavati niścitam rogādītyatrādiśabdo bhūtādiviṣayaḥ vidyāṃ japet sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vā pūjayecchivām tasmādukteṣu kāleṣu tathā kurvvan sukhī bhavet māntrikatvaṃ bhavelloke śokahāsāspadaṃ bhavet havanādabdamātreṇa vāgmī syāt kuṇṭhavāgapi maṇḍalāttasya patraiśca samidbhirapi mūlataḥ mūlaiśca lakṣmīsaṃsiddhyai mā tadanvayagā bhavet svapakṣaparapakṣayoḥ kuṇṭhavāgapi mūkopītyarthaḥ khaṇḍarūpaiḥ sādhakasya vaṃśagāminī indirāṃ labhate ramyāṃ sarvalokacamatkṛtām āḍhyaḥ syādaprajaḥ putrānavāpnoti guṇādhikān labhate sarvaśasyāḍhyāṃ bhuvaṃ bhoktā ca jāyate śataguḥ sādhakastadvattrimadhvaktairlabhettrayam tagarotthairapi tathā lājaiśca kuṭajairapi tāvaddinaiḥ maṇḍaladinaiḥ maṇḍaladināvadhi

bhaume | turviśeṣe | uccasaṃsthite makararāśisthite | caḥ samāhāre labhetetyarthaḥ | trayaṃ gobhūmiputravargāṇām kuṭajairgirimallikāpuṣpaiḥ | apiḥ samuccaye amvarāṇi vicitrāṇi mahārhāṇi ca taddinaiḥ keśaraiśca kadamvaiśca kuṇḍai(ndai)rvicakilairapi juhuyāt prathamārambhaṃ pañcamyantaṃ madhuplutaiḥ tathājyāktaistu havanāllabhate bhūṣaṇaiḥ śriyam uditairacalāṃ lakṣmīṃ avāpnoti suniścitam prāgvannandādipūrṇāntamekaikairvāpi pañcabhiḥ pāṭalatagarajalajakuṭajaiḥ | caḥ samāhāre | taddinaiḥ maṇḍalāt mallikāviśeṣaḥ | apyā pūrvatra taddinairityetadākṛṣyate proktānmaṇḍalāt | eṣa phalakālāvadhi prakaraṇasamānaḥ trimadhvaktaistathaikaikaiḥ sarvvairvvā sādhakottamaḥ vāsāṃsi labhate citrāṇyanarghāṇi bahūnyapi sitāni vāsāṃsi tathā muktādāmāni rūpyakam tathā damanakaiḥ patrairhavanācchriyamaśnute tadvarṇānyeva vāsāṃsi labhate sādhako dhruvam lajjāmānakulatyāgalolāmiṣṭāṃ samānayet pañcabhiḥ anarghāṇi varārghāṇi labhate iti yāvat patraiḥ tamālasya lalitayā | priye iti sambuddhiḥ | tadvarṇāni hutaprasūnavarṇāni campakāśokapunnāganamerukusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ tairevājyaplutairhomādvaśayet puruṣānapi

tathaiva juhuyānnityamāyuṣe tilataṇḍulaiḥ trimadhvaktairhutaiḥ sarvān vaśayedaṅganājanān tathā puṇḍrekṣutoyāktairhutaiḥ syurvaśagā nṛpāḥ nityaśo ghṛtahomena śrīmān bhogī ca jāyate sitānvitaiḥ śarkarāyuktaiḥ madhyarātre | tathā prāgvat turviśeṣe | dinairuktairmaṇḍalāt | caḥ samuccaye saṃpūjya devīṃ hṛṣṭātmā saṃskṛte havyavāhane prasthamātraṃ taṇḍulantu śālijaṃ sitameva ca gṛhītvā pāṇinā vidyāṃ japitvā śatavārake hutvā samāpya pūjāntu tathā bhuktvā tu taddinaṃ na kadācidramā muñcatyadbhutā mantraśaktayaḥ nivedayecca pūjāyāmabdādāḍhyatamo bhavet sādhakakulaṃ | ramā lakṣīḥ | adbhutāḥ aprameyavaibhavāḥ taddinānnantu kahlāraprasūne vikṣipettataḥ kāle tāvāddinairlakṣmīṃ bhūmyāḍhyāṃ labhate dhruvam nidhāyādāya maunī tu hunedagnau bhṛgorddine nṛpamānyāṃ sarvahṛdyāṃ nānābhogānvitāṃ śubhām nidhāya vikace padme karṇikāyāṃ tatastu tat karṇikārasya puṣpāṇi tathā campakajāni vai ca homamupadiśati | tatra nivedayet pāyasamiti śeṣaḥ | caḥ samuccaye nirātaṅkī mahārghāñca rājacorāpahārakaiḥ kevalaṃ navanītena sitopetena homataḥ bandhūkaiḥ kiṃśukaiścūtaistrimadhvaktairhutakriyā dadhyannahomādannāḍhyaḥ sādhakaḥ syāttrimāsataḥ

vilikhya navanītena sametaṃ juhuyānniśi tathā palāśaparṇeṣu vilikhya daradairhunet candanaiḥ pānase patre vilikhya juhuyāttathā sūccagate karkaṭarāśigate | tadanvayagāminī sādhakakulagāminī śarkaropetena | kīrtilakṣmīdhanārogyavijayaiḥ saheti śeṣaḥ sahakārapuṣpaiḥ | dadhyannahomāt dadhimiśritānnahomāt hutairavāpnoti nijaṃ vāñchitaṃ proktakālataḥ tairhutaistadavāpnoti taddinaistadvidhānataḥ sitairālikhya ca sveṣṭaṃ patre padmasamudbhave nāsādhyamasti bhuvane vidyāhomairudīritaiḥ dvātriṃśapaṭalam || 32 śeṣaḥ | tasya svābhimatasya || 100 || oṃ parāmṛṣṭam || 32 || oṃ tatsat || tasyā yantrāṇi kathyante tadvidyābhedasambhavaiḥ samastavāñchitāvāptikāraṇāni kṛtātmanām ṣoḍaśānāñca tasyāśca pūjākalamacakrakam koṣṭhavajraṃ vajraliṅgaṃ meru[setu]liṅgaṃ yathāvidhi tadeva ca mahākāraṃ koṣṭhayantrāṇi ca kramāt kuryyāt sthaṇḍilapūjāyāṃ hastamātre'tisundaram sadā suvihite pūjā śubhānyasmiṃstathānyathā pramṛjya tiryyaṅmadhyasthaṃ sūtraṃ tiryyaṅnipātayet uddiṣṭakramāt vakṣyamāṇamānādyalaṅghitaṃ kuryyādityarthaḥ anyasmin uktalakṣaṇādirahite tathā pūjā anyathā aśubhā vidhāya taddvayorantānmadhyasūtrāntataḥ kramāt

dvyaṣṭāgrataḥ samārambhānnavamaṃ prathamāntarā navamaprathamāgrābhyāṃ tiryyak saptamakāvadhi tataścatuṣkaṣaṣṭhāntadvayārambhāttathāṣṭagam caturmmarmmānuguṇyena tataḥ pañcamakāntayoḥ mārjayenmadhyagaṃ brahmasūtraṃ syāccakramuttamam vidhāya ṣaḍbhirvṛttaiśca caturasre tathāṣṭabhiḥ dakṣiṇottarato rekhātrayāt sthānadvayāttathā dvidhā kuryyācca catvāri padāni parameśvari ārambhāt tṛtīyagaṃ tṛtīyasūtramadhyagaṃ sambuddhiḥ sundaraṃ susamaṃ sarvalakṣaṇaiśca samanvitam navabhistvekasūtrasthaiḥ syādetadatisundaram marmmabhiścāṣṭadaśabhiryutaṃ cakraṃ sulakṣaṇam taccaturvviṃśatiyutaṃ cakraṃ sarvvārthasiddhidam śastrādvadhaṃ mahāvyādhiṃ dāridryamayaśo mṛtim cakraṃ tatraiva tāṃ nityamarcayan matsamo bhavet prāgāditiryaksūtrāṇi ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu ca pañcasu draṣṭavyā śastrādvadhamityādiphalapañcakamarccakāya prayacchatītyarthaḥ pratidinaṃ arccayan pūjayan matsamaḥ śivasamo bhavediti vidadhyāttīṇi sūtrāṇi kuryyāttenātisundaram dvidviprasthamānatoyapūraṇīyā iti sampradāyaḥ aṣṭapatrāmbujaṃ vāhye daśacchadasaroruham aṣṭacchadābjaṃ dviguṇacchadamaṣṭādaśacchadam paścānnāthān pārśvayośca hetīranyāstathārccayet

mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti jñānānmāñca samāpnuyāt śriyaṃ jñānāttathāvāñca saṃyāti parameśvari tanmadhye navadhā kṛtvā koṇeṣu prathamaṃ likhet ghaṭayorantarā kṛtvā tiryyagrekhāḥ samantataḥ paramārthāditiśeṣaḥ | māṃ śivam parameśvarīti devī sambuddhiḥ likhedbinduvisargābhyāṃ mukhe pañcāmṛtāmbujam vidhāya ca ghaṭādhastādvidadhyādviniyogakam vibhṛyādabhiṣiñcecca janmarkṣeṣvāyurāptaye abhiṣiñcedaśeṣārttiśāntyai siddhyai ca sampadā trivarṣamabhiṣekantu kuryyājjanmatraye tathā ārogyo vijayī viśvavandyo bhavati mānavaḥ vidhāya sthāpayet kṣaudre yajet sarvvāpamṛtyujit ūrmmikādau vahet sarvvasampade riṣṭaśāntaye sthāpayettatra ye snātā narāḥ syuḥ sukhino'niśam koṣṭhānyekonapañcāśatteṣu koṇeṣu mārjayet vikṣvekatastrikoṇāni prāgārambhāt praveśataḥ vilomenātha madhyasthe tat sasādhyaṃ samālikhet vināśanamaniṣṭānāṃ jayasaubhāgyadāyakam samabhyarcya taddhāraṇāt proktaphalasiddhibhāgiti yatrādhiṣṭhitataḍāgādiṣu samaste dhārayet kleśe vijayaṃ sukhamāpnuyāt sthāpayitvā ghaṭaṃ prāgvat samastābhyudayāya vai dharādhanapaśuprāptyai naranārīnṛpādinām dhārayet siddhavajrantu samasteṣu prasiddhaye

yantramanyat samaṃ vetti yo'sau syānmūḍhacetanaḥ taistatra koṣṭhāni tathā navāśītiśatadvayam anyeṣāmadhikatvena vedanāt kiṃ punarityarthaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśacchiṣṭavajre tu caturbhirdiktrikoṇakam vilikhettaddvitīyārddhebhedāttu vilikhettataḥ navasu vilikhedvidyākūṭatrayamatha triśaḥ vāmatraye dvitīyañca likhet sādhye tṛtīyakam phalāni sarvayantrāṇāṃ paṭale'smin śṛṇu priye proktaṃ tadeṣāmekaikaṃ yojayet sarvameva ca phalāni vāñchayāvāpnotyayatnānnāmayojanaiḥ sarvañca sarvadā sarvasamīhitaphalāptikṛt sūtraiḥ koṣṭhāni jāyante ṣaṭśataṃ pañcaviṃśati devīsambuddhiḥ | iha paṭale | sarvaṃ yantraṃ śiṣṭe caturbhistryasrañca vidadhyāddikṣu pūrvavat śiṣṭeṣu saptanavati dviśate madhyatastathā koṣṭhāni trīṇi tiryyak ca samīkṛtya tayostathā tayoradhorddhaṃ ca tathā dve dve kuryyādathaikadhā ekīkṛtya punaścorddhe dve dve tu mārjayettathā daśakhaṇḍāni śiṣṭaistu madhye liṅgo bhavettathā śiṣṭāni koṣṭhavajrāṇi dviśataṃ daśa pañca ca tasya liṅgasya madhyasthapaṅktyāṃ tārttīyamālikhet sarvatra tārttīyā vidyā lekhanaṃ samudīritam vidyāśeṣaṃ samālikhya prāgvadārambhatastathā dviśastatra yajeddevīmāvāhya parivārakaiḥ

nāsādhyamasti bhuvane yantrairetairmayoditaiḥ ekonaviṃśakoṣṭhāntaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ tathopari teṣu mūlādiparito madhyāntaṃ vinyaset kramāt devīsambuddhiḥ liṅgasya madhyakoṣṭhāntaṃ śiṣṭaṃ koṇeṣu saṃlikhet sarvavāhye tadāvaddhaṃ tasyopari samālikhet nityāparyyāyajanite pārśvayordakṣavāmayoḥ liṅgāgramadhyādabhitaḥ piṇḍikāyāñca saṃlikhet kṛtvaivaṃ meruliṅgantu yantraṃ tatraiva tāṃ likhet paṭādau tat samālikhya pūjayennityaśaśca tām catuḥśatāni koṣṭhāni bhavanti susamāni vai nityaśaiḥ anudinaṃ | tāṃ lalitāṃ prāgvat tataścopari ṣaṭsaptetyevamekādaśāvadhi tathā kuryyāt pārśvayośca tenādhiṣṭhānapiṇḍike liṅgamanyāni pārśvasthamārjanādbhavati priye liṅge prathamabhedotthastanmadhyasthe svavāñchitam mahāliṅgābhidhaṃ yantraṃ tatra pūjākhileṣṭadā tattatsūtravaśāt kuryyāddaśa triṣu tathā samam śiṣṭamadhyatrikoṇe tu likhedvāñchitamātmanaḥ dinanityāñcālikhediti tatra sveṣṭamavāpnoti yonicakrānubhāvataḥ tatra tiryyak catuḥsūtrapātanādanyatastathā praveśagatyā vilikhettāścaturvviṃśatiṃ kramāt tatra tāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ pūrṇāsviṣṭārthasiddhaye caḥ samuccaye | tathā tathā yathā yathā prayuktaṃ tathā tathetyarthaḥ

| tatra vajravajrayantra | pūrṇāsu pañcamīdaśamī pañcadaśīṣu dvitīyabhedāḥ vilikhettathā sādhyasamanvitāḥ evamūhyaṃ tṛtīyotthavidyābhirapi kalpayet koṣṭhayantravibhedāni śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhi evāvadhāraṇe teṣvaṅkāni samaṃ kṛtvā paṃktau teṣu samālikhet manīṣitañca saṃlikhya teṣāṃ madhyasthakoṣṭhataḥ vaśyākarṣaṇavidveṣastambhanoccāṭanādikam sthāpanāddhāraṇāccānyairupāyaiḥ sādhakoniśam aśeṣaṃ devi te proktaṃ yantrasiddhyabhidhāgame iti ṣoḍaśanityātantre śrīkādimate trayastriṃśat paṭalam || 33 āgame || 100 parāmṛṣṭam || 33 || oṃ tatsat || camatkārakarīṃ vidyāṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu sundari aśvārūḍhāmannapūrṇāṃ navātmānaṃ navātmikām niṣkatrayapradāmiṣṭadāyinīñca mataṅginīm gopālabhedānauṣadhān vadāmyuktakrameṇa vai haṃsahṛttejasāṃ yogāddyutidāhacarasvakaiḥ sakalabhujaṅgamaviṣaharāṇi svecchotkrāntikaraṇāni ca samāyairuditā vidyā pañcārṇāmṛtavigrahā māyayā vā vidadhyācca dhyānaṃ cādyānudīrite dhyātvā siddhamanuḥ paścādvidadhyādviniyogakam pāyayitvā ca tāṃ brūyāt ślokayeti samāhitaḥ dhyānaviśeṣaḥ proktaśca tatraivetyarthaḥ dhyānamamṛteśvarīdhyānameveti

ācaṣṭe ca trikālasthānarthān pṛṣṭā mahādbhutam pālayeti dviruktvā tat pratilomamudīrayet vidyayāṅgāni niyataṃ svātmānaṃ cintayediti samāsīnaṃ sudhārdrāṅgaṃ maulābindukalāyutam kanyetyarthaḥ | mahādbhutaṃ mahācamatkārabhūtaṃ yathā vyutkrameṇādyakṣaratrayañcoccarediti sampradāyārthaḥ nijavigrahaṃ cintayediti vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa svaikyena bhāvayennityaṃ jayadīrghāyuredhate rasāvahnisvasahitaprāṇāstaistripuṭoditā japedahno mukhe svaikyaṃ bhāvayaṃstrisahasrakam naranārīnṛpāṇāñca vāllabhyaṃ labhate naraḥ puṣpeṣvaṅkuśapadmāni padmapāśekṣucāpakān śṛṅgārabhūṣāpikavākcāmarādarśapīḍakāḥ vyākhyānamudrā | svaikyena svāpṛthaktvena parivāryya sthitāstābhirvṛtāṃ tāṃ svaikyataḥ smaret vairimohītyakṣarāṇāṃ catuṣkaṃ garuḍeti ca svāhānto gadito mantrastārkṣasyākhilarakṣituḥ phaṇidaṣṭān piśācādyaiḥ kliṣṭānanyāṃśca rogiṇaḥ tāṃ devīṃ | svaikyataḥ apṛthagbhāvena pālayecchatajaptena toyenābhyukṣaṇāt kṣaṇāt ahitāni ca khādantaṃ smaraṃstārkṣamanuṃ japet garalaṃ bhujagānāñca samastānāmayatnataḥ śūnyāmbu rasadāhognihṛdambumarudanvitaḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ māyayā kṛtvā japedakṣaralakṣakam prāguktaviṣādīni

gurumukhādavagantavyaḥ haṃsaḥ hakāro marutāyuktaḥ ākārasahitaḥ samānayet svagehe tamānāśāt proktakāriṇam prāpnotyayatnādanayā vidyayā siddhayāniśam caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ prasannavadanāmbujām anyābhyāṃ hemapāśena kaṇṭhe vaddhvā svasādhyakam dāsohamiti bhāṣantaṃ patitaṃ nijapādayoḥ samastaṃ jīvabhuvanamaśvārūḍhākhyavidyayā māheśvarīti proktvānnapūrṇe svāheti tanmanuḥ tayordakṣiṇakarasthahemavetrāhataṃ | smaran uktarūpāṃ devīṃ annapūrṇāvidyā sahasravāraṃ niyataṃ na tasya syāddaridratā smitavaktrāṃ hemapātrāt pāyasaṃ dadhatīṃ kare bubhukṣito bhavedeva na kadācicca kutracit ābhyāṃ bhajennityaśo yo mantrābhyāṃ yācate varam tiṣṭheccopari sarveṣāṃ sarvathā sarvataḥ sadā kṣmāsvayogānnāmataśca navātma navabhiśca taiḥ vidyājapavān annapūrṇāyāḥ navātmikā tu te vidyā dvāvetau sarvasiddhidau devīhṛdayasaṃjñāsau vidyā sarvārthasiddhidā sitakuṣṭhaṃ svarṇapuṣpīmūlaṃ tatpatravāriṇā bhumau śayīta tāṃ rātriṃ vijane suśubhe gṛhe ājñāsthitaṃ (tā) tathā sā taṃ vahedasyābhivāñchitam | navātmikā prāgvat | turviśeṣe | te vidyā devyāstava vidyā tṛtīyacaturthākṣarabhūtena caturakṣarī sambhūyeti yāvat

saubhāgyalakṣmīkīrtyāyurārogyavijayāvahā svāhāntikā tu vidyeyaṃ kathitā dvādaśākṣarī dhyātvā prāgvaddhayārūḍhā devī sādhayatīpsitam sādhyanāmasamopetāmālikhyaitāntu tanmanāḥ nānayā sadṛśī vidyā vidyate vanitāvaśe na vidyāḥ santi bhuvane hayagaurīmanudvayāt | taṃ sādhakaṃ | asya sādhakasya saubhāgyādiphalaṣaṭkaproktaphalam svāhetyakṣaradvayaṃ dvādaśākṣarī sambhūyeti yāvat gaurīvidyādvayataḥ adhikāśca sadṛśāśceti yāvat etaddvitīyaṃ tau syātāṃ kākaṇṭheti tataḥ param kṛtāṅgo māyayā dhyātvā tāṃ devīṃ sarvamaṅgalām trisandhyārccāsamopetaṃ sā prītā lakṣadā dinaiḥ svāhāntaṃ dvādaśārṇeyaṃ vidyā niṣkatrayapradā catvāryyakṣarāṇi pañcadaśākṣarā | sambhūyeti yāvat kriyāviśeṣaṇam | sā devī lakṣadā lakṣasvarṇapradā | dinaiḥ prāgvat prāgvannāmataścārthataśca japitvā varṇaśo vidyāṃ phalamuktamavāpnuyāt vyomadvayaṃ marudyuktaṃ rayaśca dharayā yutaḥ jātipuṣpairniśāmadhye pūjitā maṅgalākṛtiḥ mātaṅginyai tathā svāhā punastrīṇīti tanmanuḥ gānābhiyogaṃ viśveṣāṃ mānyatāñca prayacchati svarṇamityarthaḥ | avāpnuyādityasya nityaśa ityanena ca sambandhaḥ sarvamaṅgalādevyāḥ proktavigrahā pratilomāni | tanmanuḥ mātaṅgeśvarīvidyā sahasravāraṃ tenāsau siddhā sarvaṃ prayacchati

pralambaveṇīsannaddhasaugandhikasamujjvalām ūrmmikāvīrakaṭakanūpurairmaṇḍitāṅghrikām stūyamānāñca parito dhyāyeddevīṃ śucismitām rasācarasvairambu syādvātāgnī tadanantaram vidyāsau rājyalakṣmyāstu ṣoḍaśārṇā samīritā pṛthak pṛthagiti yāvat yāvat rājyaṃ prayacchati prītā sādhakāyāvilambitam kamalāto laye paścāt prasīdadvitayaṃ punaḥ vidyā te saptaviṃśārṇā samastābhīṣṭadāniśam dhyānañca vijayārūpaṃ prajapāddinaśastathā tulāsthe bhāskare pūjā pūrṇāyāṃ sakaleṣṭadā vijayānityāsamānavigrahāṃ sambhūya iti yāvat pūrṇāyāṃ paurṇamāsyām caṇḍatejaśca saṅkarṣaṇavarṇāḥ syustadanantaram siddhalakṣmyādividyeyaṃ proktā saptadaśākṣarā prātaḥ sahasravārantu tarpayettaddaśāṃśakam prayacchati jayaṃ yuddhe śriyaṃ sarvātiśāyinīm karoti mārge kāntāragirikṛcchrebhirakṣati yuddhamārgādirakṣāsu śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhi hakāraḥ | saptadaśākṣarā sambhūya iti yāvat hastadviśatasaṃyuktāṃ svasamākāraśaktibhiḥ dhyātvaivamarccayediṣṭamavāpnotyakhilaṃ dhruvam mārjayedbāhyavīthīṣu pañcapañca tathaikadhā

madhyādi vilikhenmantravarṇān ṣoḍaśa nāma ca tattatprayogānuguṇamiti yāvat samastābhīṣṭasaṃsiddhyai siddhalakṣmī tu nityaśaḥ sarvanārīsamārambhādakarodvivaśaṃ jagat tadā tena vinodāya svaṃ ṣoḍhākalpayadvapuḥ tairyantrapūjāhavanajapatarpaṇasecanaiḥ śṛṇu tān ṣaṭkramānmantrān dhyānārccāviniyogakaiḥ praṇavadvayamadhyasthaḥ siddhagopālakābhidhaḥ vidyāyāḥ saptadaśārṇān krameṇa vilikhediti tvakṣarādhikyaṃ divyatvāt praṇavadvayamadhyasthaḥ praṇavapuṭitaḥ puṭanānnāmatastasmādvāṇaistaiḥ puṭanādbhavet ādyaḥ pañcāṅgako mantrastvitare syuḥ ṣaḍaṅgakāḥ aṣṭapatrāvjamadhyasthaṃ pūjayet saptātikramāt vāreṣu bhāskarādyeṣu teṣāṃ pūjā krameṇa vai saptasvanyatamāṃ pāyasairnārikelaiśca sasitaiḥ kadalīphalaiḥ itīritaiḥ saptabhistaiḥ sarvamiṣṭamavāpnuyāt puṇḍrekṣucāpapuṣpeṣūn dadhānaṃ śaktibhiḥ smaret hṛtkaṇṭhājñālepanato devatādarśanaṃ bhavet āragvadhaṃ muṇḍinīṃ ca śākoṭaṃ jambumūlakam nārikelaiḥ dugdhādyaiḥ | śaktibhirgopīveṣadharābhiriti yāvat gurumukhādavagantavyam koraṇṭaṃ pippalaṃ mūlaṃ triphalaṃ cūrṇayet samam

bhāvayaṃstanmayo bhūyāddivasaiḥ kaiścidātmavān asyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtam bhāvanāsthairyyāt parāmṛṣṭam || 34 || oṃ tatsat || yayā tanmayatāsiddhiḥ pratyakṣā bhavati dhruvam navatvaṃ tasya dehasya randhratvenāvabhāsate kurukullā bhavenmātā puruṣārthāstu sāgarāḥ saṅkalpāḥ kalpataravaḥ svādhārā ṛtavaḥ smṛtāḥ tena pūrvvābhimukhyaṃ syādanyatte kathitaṃ mithaḥ śrīcakraṃ pūjanaṃ teṣāṃ ekīkaraṇamīritam navadhātvavāsanā pañcame paṭale vyākhyātā ūrmmayaḥ puṇyapāpe ca brāhmyādyā mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ karmmendriyārthā doṣāśca jñeyāḥ syuḥ śaktayoṣṭa vai vāyavo daśa saṃproktāḥ sarvasiddhyādiśaktayaḥ śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkhecchā guṇāḥ proktāḥ krameṇa vai mano bhavedikṣudhanuḥ pāśo rāga udīritaḥ avyaktāhaṅkṛtimahadākārāḥ pratilomataḥ svātmaiva devatā proktā lalitā viśvavigrahā siddhistvananyacittatvaṃ mudrā vaibhavabhāvanam prayogāstu vikalpānāṃ hetoḥ svātmani nāśanam rāgatattvarūpa iti yāvat tayorvandhakatvaṃ sāmānyāt sandhyāsu bhajanaṃ devyā ādimadhyāntamajjanam tāstu viśvavikalpānāṃ hetavaḥ samudīritāḥ japastanmayatārūpabhāvanaṃ samyagīritam [teṣāmanyonyasambhedabhāvanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ bhavet

abhiṣekastu vidyā syādātmā sarvvāśrayo mahān dakṣiṇā bhedaśūnyatvaṃ śuśrūṣā sthairyyamucyate nityā pañcadaśaitāḥ syuriti proktāstu vāsanāḥ teṣāmanyonyasambhedaprakāraistatprapañcatā ntu de rū ṣe pa ṇa vī śe taṃ di mī na ri syā da te taḥ rtha ka syā thi ścā stu ta taḥ ntre go rva pi ta ṣu sa ro ma ī yo kā rvi rśa ta naṃ ta phā ndu la nā nni vi mudrāparamārtharūpabhedayogaviśeṣaḥ prapañcatā taddvaividhyapratītirāhityāt tadaikyanirṇītiśca kriyata iti mantravīryyasusiddhānāmitareṣāṃ viśeṣakṛt varṇatrayaṃ samārabhya navārṇāvadhi vījakāḥ tata ūrddhaṃ gatā mālāstāsu bhedo na vidyate padairmmantreṣu bhedaḥ syāt teṣāṃ saṃkhyāḥ śṛṇu kramāt saviṃśati saptaśataṃ catvāriṃśadbhiranvitam tryakṣaramantrabhedādinavākṣaramantrabhedāntamiti śeṣaḥ triśata viṃśati tatastrilakṣeṇa samanvitam bhedasaṃkhyetthaṃ saptānāṃ tābhiranyāḥ samunnayet etairevonnayenmantrapadabhedānanukramāt rekhāścatasraḥ pañcaivamṛjvākārā daśāvadhi saṃkhyābhiḥ | anyā daśākṣarādibhedasaṃkhyāḥ tiryyagrekhāstāvatīśca kṛtvā teṣvaṅkamālikhet ādye dvidvikramādaṅkān pūrayettatra coditān dvitīyapaṃktau prathame khaṇḍe śeṣāṃstu pūrayet [tṛtīyapaṃktau tu śeṣaistvevameva samālikhet tiryyakpaṃktiṣvanabhyastakramamaṅkāstu sarvataḥ

sarvvādhastādvilomā sā madhyasthā vyākulakramāḥ lalitābhedajātāni tadyantroktānyaśeṣataḥ anyāstu tatra tatraiva draṣṭavyā yatra coditāḥ samyaktvameṣāṃ kena syāt sarveṣāmapyayatnataḥ kāni siddhasya cihnāni kā vā siddhirudāhṛtā ekādaśa tataścakraṃ pañcāśatkoṣṭhakaṃ bhavet | vā samuccaye prāṇāgnīlāmbukhātmānaḥ paṃktayaḥ pañca kīrttitāḥ tasmāttasyātra vinyāso naikadeśaḥ śivātmanaḥ ni rśa nā ptaḥ mā spa śca vyā śa ma tāṃ rṇā da nāṃ ru va ni sa nā ho mā grā śca dā pi tai sā rṇā ma nāṃ ja va nāṃ tā va mā rṇā nye ni nā maṃ syu thā mā kra nāṃ rya bhau nā tā va mā rṇā nye ni nā maṃ syu thā pyā kra nāṃ ryya mā ni nā nye sa tā śca mā haṃ ṇāṃ vyo rū me pi ṇa ma kra daśadaśorddhvapaṃktyādhaḥpaṃktiparyyantaṃ kramādvilikhediti tasmādatīva gopyāni nāmānyetāni sarvadā padyamekaṃ vadet karṇe śiṣyasyaivoktarūpiṇaḥ ryyāt yo ne rbhe ku da ja tai tarṇāśeṣarbhāmasaṃ (?) trayoviṃśādiślokadvayeneti yāvat nānāvṛttānabhīṣṭārthānnihnavāya tu deśikaḥ gṛhe vā maṇḍape sthitvā pīṭhaṃ dhavalitodaram kucandanaiḥ kuṅkumairvā daradairvopadeśataḥ nityaśo mātṛkāṃ japyāt sampradāyānusārataḥ tantre'smin vyākulān ślokānvācayennaiva kevalaḥ || iti kuryyānmantramabhīṣṭārthagamakaṃ proktayogataḥ

bhūtoyapracurāḥ saumyāḥ sevyāḥ siddhikarā matāḥ taiḥ tathā bhajanāt siddhāḥ phalanti saikyayogataḥ pūjāpaṭalasamproktāstrividhāḥ syurupāsakāḥ proktayogataḥ vakṣyamāṇa mantravīryyasvarūpānusandhāna yogataḥ siddhāḥ svasvakrūrasaumyamiśrādi svabhāvānuguṇaṃ phalantīti ekonyaḥ sarvataḥ siddhavyutpattyarthābhivīkṣaṇam eṣāṃ pañcaprakārāṇāmaśeṣeṇeṣṭasiddhidāḥ yena jñānānubhūtena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ tadanusandhānena yathoditeneti yāvat guṇatrayamamīṣāñca yat kāraṇamudāhṛtam tanmantravīryyamuddiṣṭaṃ mantrāṇāṃ jīva īritaḥ praṇavāvayavabhūtairapi prāgvadekīkuryāditi sampradāyaḥ sadā prayogādbhajanādakāle saṃśayādbhavet devatādrohataḥ sarvaparivādānavasthayā tatsamyaktvaṃ yena bhavet kāryyaṃ tat pūrvamīritam nātiśoko nātiharṣo nātisneho na matsaraḥ svadehamātrayātrecchā paracintāvivarjanam tattanmantravidyānusandhānamityarthaḥ bhoktṛtvaṃ śaktito dānamiti siddhasya lakṣaṇam rājñaḥ prasādaḥ sarveṣāṃ mānyatvaṃ puṇyasiddhayaḥ ārogyamavisaṃvādaḥ sacchiṣyatvaṃ kṛtajñatā pratyakṣāḥ siddhayaḥ proktā manoḥ siddhasya sarvataḥ siddhamantreṇa karttavyāḥ prayogā nānyathā priye anyonyavairamastyeva guṇabhūtasamanvayāt vāyavyānāṃ jalānāñca bhaumānāṃ syāt parasparam

proktānigamanañca asiddhamantreṇa na karttavyā iti yāvat | priye iti devīsambuddhiḥ strīdaivatyeṣu saumyānāṃ krūrāṇāṃ syāt parasparam śastrānuyakṣiṇīnāṃ syādaghorāstrasya cakrataḥ kathayāmi śṛṇu prājñe yena lokotisīdati tena mantrā devatāśca kruddhā hanyurupāsakam yanniṣṭhānāmamī doṣā na spṛśanti kadācana śāstrānuyakṣiṇīnāṃ vairamiti | cakrataḥ sudarśaneneti yāvat yāvat | yanniṣṭhānāṃ divyatvānmantravīryaniṣṭhānityarthaḥ tadājñayā bhajedekarūpaṃ mantraṃ svasiddhaye dāridryāddīrgharogādvā vyasaneṣvatisarjanāt tattadvarṇotthasaṃkhyābhirgulikā mantrasiddhidā tatpūjā ca tathā siddhilābhāya syānna cānyathā | vā vikalpe | vyasaneṣu stryādiṣu saptastrityarthaḥ yāvat | gulikā mantrasiddhidā tattanmantrasiddhidā ityarthaḥ divyatvāt lajjātukā śikhiśikhā darbhāḥ pātalabhṛṅgakau kramāddaśānāṃ varṇānāṃ taiḥ kuryāttattadarccanam kṛṣṇaśaṅkhaprasūnañca citrāphāntā iti kramāt taisteṣāmarcanaṃ kuryyādgurupādārccane rataḥ rohiṇastulasī potrī sadāmadreti ca kramāt tattatkāryyārthasaṃsiddhyai kuryyāt sadgurudakṣiṇām kuśo vṛhatī drulatā dūrvvā lakṣmīriti kramāt teṣāṃ samarccanaṃ kuryyādoṣadhairebhirādarāt siṃhī dundūkayugalamapāmārgāñjaliḥ saha

taisteṣāmarccanaṃ kuryyāttattatkāryyārthasiddhaye tatra yathāsiddhi prāguktavidhānenetyarthaḥ kathitāni mayā tāni śrutāni ca maheśvara svarūpaṃ kiṃ kathaṃ viśvaṃ kimākārañca dṛśyate maheśvaretīśvara sambuddhiḥ kimākāramiti | eṣa tṛtīyaḥ praśnaḥ teṣāṃ janmāni kena syuḥ kā muktiḥ saṃsṛtiśca kā kiṃ mūlaṃ saṃsṛterasyāḥ kāni tattvāni kā ca dhīḥ kaḥ kālaḥ ke grahāḥ sarvaṃ yathāvanme vada prabho kathyate tat sphuṭaṃ brūhi nātisaṅkocavistaram saptamaḥ praśnaḥ | saṃsṛtiśca kā ityaṣṭamaḥ praśnaḥ prabho itīśvara sambuddhiḥ atisaṅkocātivistārābhyāṃ jñātumaśakyatvāt teṣāmuktakrameṇaiva kathayāmi tavottaram yadito'nyatra sarvatra proktaṃ nihnavacakrataḥ tairmmayoktakramājjitvā durjayāṃ vāsanāṃ śanaiḥ guhyaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ gopayet sarvataḥ sadā gopayet abhaktebhya ityarthaḥ | sarvataḥ prakārata iti yāvat dvayorapi ca yajjñānaṃ tajjñānaṃ viddhi me vapuḥ lābhādevaṃ vāsanāyā vināśādanyathā tathā nityāhṛdayasaṃproktasphuṭopāyena vā bhavet devatānāmiti yāvat | caitanyātma caitanyasvarūpaṃ vapuriti śeṣaḥ dvairūpyamanayoruktaṃ satyāsatyasama(maya)tvataḥ yathātmajānato'rtheṣu vyāpāraḥ puṇyasaṃjñakaḥ janmāni nānārūpāṇi yairnityaṃ kleśabhājanam

yāvat | etadupāyasyādyupaskaratvāt ārādhyamukhādavagantavyam prapañco nāmarūpābhyāṃ prakāśate iti puṇyapāpātmakatvamiti saṃsṛtirmmocanaṃ buddhervvāsanā vandha īritaḥ mocanaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ netaraiśca kadācana bandhaḥ ayathātmajñānamanādidurvāsanayaiveti yāvat yadāyattamidaṃ jīvabhuvanaṃ parivarttate jñātṛjñānajñeyamayānyanyathānyāni sarvadā kathayāmi śṛṇu prājñe yadāyattā ca viṃśatiḥ yāvadāhūtasaṃplavamiti yāvat janmajarāmaraṇādyāvṛttibhrāntirūpeṇeti yāvat taditarātmakatvena pratītāni anyāni asatyānīti yāvat vastubhedādabhedācca yaduktaṃ sarvataḥ sadā viṣamañca samaṃ viśvaṃ viśvātītamanāmayam sarvatṛṣṇākaraharaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvataḥ sadā saṃsārarūpamurttīrṇavigrahaṃ susthiraṃ calam atīndriyaṃ cendriyātmānirdeśyaṃ (vaṃ) sarvadaivatam yadityasya vastvitthanenānvayaḥ | sarvvata āgamāditaḥ sarvataḥ prakārata iti yāvat yāvat yāvat sadayañcāvivekātma vivekaparamārthakam śokātmakañca niḥśokaṃ sakautukamakautukam amarśarūpamakṣobhyaṃ sarvakṣobhyaṃ sukhāsukham aspṛṣṭaṣaḍguṇaṃ ṣaṇḍaḥ vanitā puruṣastathā

agādhamatigambhīramudāraṃ kṛpaṇantathā anicchamicchārūpañca kātaraṃ vīravigraham saṅkocarūpaḥ sarveṣāṃ tathā sarvaprakāśakaḥ vivekaparamārthasvarūpam parājayarūpam sukharūpaṃ duḥkharūpañceti aspṛṣṭaṣaḍguṇaṃ krodhādiṣaḍguṇarahitam duravagāhaṃ bhāgyemityādinā ślokenāṣṭaguṇāḥ vātāditridoṣātmā sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmiti yāvat sarasaṃ virasaṃ krūraṃ saumyaṃ tairbahubhistu kim ubhayaikyādvivekātma jīvo'nyastadvivekavān sāmarthyaṃ svāvibheditvaṃ siddhe prāpyaphalāni ca tenaiva vihitaṃ sarvaṃ prapañcātmaikyavigraham sṛṣṭāni bhūtaśaktyātmavigrahāṇīndriyāṇi tu tairguṇaiḥ buddhyadhīnamiti yāvat | tena buddheryāyātmyavidā | evāvadhāraṇe prāṇāstatsākṣibhūto hi jīvastattvātmakaḥ paraḥ kāla ityakṣaradvandvādyadvācyaṃ tadvapurmmama tathāpi tava yatkiñcidvyākaromi samañjasā tena tanmayatārūpakathanaṃ nocitaṃ tataḥ kālasya rūpaṃ tat proktaṃ yadanādyantavigraham nalinyā patranicaye sūcīviddhe'tha tasya vai tattriṃśadguṇitaṃ proktaṃ truṭītyādiśarīravān iti pṛṣṭena tadvaktuṃ śakyate susphuṭaṃ mayā

tattasya vapuruddiṣṭaṃ nānyāsti gatiratra vai svarūpaṃ tattasya kālasya svarūpamiti yāvat | atra kālasvarūpakathane bhūtādīni samastāni vikṛtāni vitanvate taireva teṣāṃ nāśaśca maruteva havirbhujaḥ tathāpi me prapañcātmaviveko'bhūnna me'dhunā arūpasya vibhostasya jīvaścettat kathaṃ sthitiḥ bhūtādivikārāṇāṃ | deva vibho iti dvayamapīśvarasambuddhiḥ karoti | tatra tathāpi me kathitamapi | adhunāpīti śeṣaḥ | adyāpīti yāvat mukto vā jāyate kintu pare vā sambhavanti kim deheṣu jīvasaṃprāptiḥ kīdṛśītyādi me vada tathā me sarvasandehāṃśchindhi pūrṇopadeśataḥ jananaṃ maraṇañceti dvayaṃ dehaparigrahāt avasthā kālaparayostādātmyādeva varttanam anyasya praśnasyeti śeṣaḥ dehābhimānamātrameveti na vāpūrvvāḥ sambhavanti buddheḥ kṛtyamaśeṣataḥ jīvādirūpato buddhirviśeṣayati tatparam jalāgnyostatra cānyatra vyaktāvyaktasthitiḥ sadā tādātmyādeva varttanamiti kathitamiti buddheḥ kṛtyamiti vyoma sarvagameva syāt kālatādrūpyataḥ sadā jīvānāmāgatirdehe mātāpitrostu vīryyataḥ tatra prāravdhaviramānmaraṇaṃ nidrayā samam prāgeva tasya dehātmavivekānmanasi svage kālatādrapyataḥ kālātmakatveneti yāvat

iti yāvat | dehe jīvānāmāgatiḥ seti puṣyādiṣu tu māseṣu ṣaṭsu rākopakaṇṭhataḥ siddhastu pūrvato mukto dehendriyamanaḥsthiraḥ sugatitvaṃ vyanyaktyeva jīvanmukto yatastvayam buddhervaividhyarūpasya kāraṇaṃ kiṃ vada prabho jāyate tvāśrayavaśāt sa ca karmmabhireva vai nopalabhyo bhavet śuṣkamathanavyāpṛtiṃ vinā | ayaṃ siddhaḥ itīśvarasambuddhiḥ sthalaviśeṣavaśādbuddheḥ kāryaireva prakṛtiviśeṣo bhavatīti na kasyāpi bhavedeṣā pratijñā viśvato'niśam tathā sadgurusaṃsevāṃ saṃprāpya svasvarūpakam viśeṣaḥ ko bhavedanyadurlabhaḥ satyavigrahaḥ dayārdracittatā rāgadveṣāviṣayacittatā kṛtajñatā satyatā ca paracintānivarttanam pratijñeti yāvat | viśvataḥ hetoḥ | svasvarūpakaṃ ātmajñānaṃ sulabhatvamityādinā ślokena lakṣaṇaṣaṭkam adairghyasūtryamakṣaudryaṃ nātyagādhāśayātmatā vṛthāvinodarāhityaṃ jihmacittairasaṅgatiḥ asteyaśaktirāstikyaṃ paralokānucintanam pāpānāṃ varjanaṃ puṇyakaraṇe kautukaṃ sadā nispṛhatvamalolatvamanākṣepo'jaḍātmatā saulabhyāditi yāvat dṛṣṭādṛṣṭānupayogitvamuktaṃ | jihmacittaiḥ kapaṭahṛdayaiḥ yāvat

parastavaneṣu paranindāsu ca guruvidyāgamācārastavanaṃ tatpravarttanam na bhavantītareṣāntu pradviṣantyeva tāṃśca te nirastāśeṣasaṃsāramaurkhyājñānāvivekavān pālayan susmitamukhaḥ pūjāpūjanakautukī patitānvandhucittājñādurlaṅghyān svacayasthitīn muhurmuhuśca vimṛśedviramedaśubhātmanaḥ stavanaṃ evāvadhāraṇe | tān ātmajñānavataḥ | te ātmajñānarahitāḥ gamayeddevatāpūjājapayogastavādinā gamayedaniśaṃ kālaṃ na vadet paradūṣaṇam tadguṇaistatkṛpādhikyaiḥ puṇyaiśvaryyaiśca satyataḥ santoṣācāranityamaśāntijñānādibhistathā nityācintā svātmaśuddhiḥ kṛtyamātmavatāṃ sadā svātmaśuddhiḥ svavāṅmanaḥkāyānāṃ śuddhiriti yāvat yoniṃ tanmadhyato devīṃ lalitāṃ pṛṣṭhato gurūn kāmeśvaryyādikāstatra tadvahirdvādaśasvapi tannāmavidyābhirvā tāḥ pūjayet sārghakalpanam nānyat kṛtyaṃ bhavettasya nityanaimittikādikam pūjayet prāgvadubhayaprakārādekayogataḥ siddhānāmapi sarveṣāṃ yenāsau svātmavānabhūt yatparāmarśato bhāvastvāvayoraikyamaśnute nāśiṣyāya na dambhāya pracchrannānayaśīline na pāpāya na vittāya nādakṣāya ca bhedine svarūpajñānavān

bhedine dvidhābhāvaśīlāya śaktyā saṃgṛhya vidhivadbhajate sa madaṃśakaḥ asyā niphālanāccitte tattattvaṃ svātmasāt kṛtam || 36 || oṃtatsat || madaṃśakaḥ citsvarūpa īśvara iti yāvat ṣaṭtriṃśatpaṭalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ parāmṛṣṭam || 36 || oṃ tatsat || adhyarddhasaptaṣaṣṭiśca vyākhyāgranthāḥ śatatrayam śatānāṃ navakaṃ tvekatriṃśatā ca samanvitam
